17a57efd.title: Technical Program Manager
17a57efd.description:
We are looking for a Technical Program Manager to lead the execution and delivery of DrishtiNova’s Product \& Technology roadmap.

This role acts as the operational backbone of the technology organisation by coordinating engineering, QA, infrastructure, vendors, and product initiatives. The Technical Program Manager is responsible for ensuring projects are delivered on time, risks are proactively managed, and progress is visible through effective planning, governance, and reporting.

**Role Summary**

The Technical Program Manager owns the day\-to\-day execution of the Product \& Technology function.

The role is responsible for delivery planning, Agile execution, vendor management, release coordination, backlog governance, technical reporting, documentation management, and cross\-functional communication. The successful candidate will work closely with engineering, QA, infrastructure, product management, and external technology partners to ensure predictable and high\-quality delivery.

**Key ResponsibilitiesDelivery \& Program Management**

* Own the overall Product \& Technology delivery roadmap.
* Track milestones, dependencies, and delivery risks.
* Drive execution across multiple concurrent initiatives.
* Escalate blockers and ensure timely resolution.
* Maintain overall visibility of project health.

**Agile Delivery**

* Own and administer Jira projects and workflows.
* Facilitate Sprint Planning, Daily Stand\-ups, Sprint Reviews, Retrospectives, and Backlog Refinement.
* Ensure backlog items are prioritised, estimated, and ready for development.
* Track sprint progress and delivery metrics.

**Vendor Management**

* Act as the primary point of contact for external technology vendors.
* Coordinate daily follow\-ups and delivery reviews.
* Track action items, timelines, and open issues.
* Escalate delivery risks where required.
* Ensure vendor commitments are achieved.

**Release \& Defect Management**

* Coordinate release planning and deployment activities.
* Manage defect triage and prioritisation.
* Track defect resolution until closure.
* Maintain release readiness and launch checklists.

**Product \& Backlog Governance**

* Coordinate backlog grooming sessions.
* Ensure requirements are complete before development.
* Track roadmap progress.
* Manage dependencies between teams and initiatives.

**Reporting \& Governance**

* Publish weekly Product \& Technology status reports.
* Maintain project dashboards and executive summaries.
* Track risks, issues, decisions, and action items.
* Prepare progress updates for leadership.

**Documentation**

* Own Confluence documentation standards.
* Ensure technical documentation, meeting notes, release notes, and SOPs remain up to date.
* Maintain governance documents and project artefacts.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Coordinate communication between Product, Engineering, QA, Infrastructure, Content Operations, and Vendors.
* Organise regular project reviews and governance meetings.
* Ensure action items are tracked through to completion.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Improve delivery processes and team workflows.
* Drive adoption of automation and best practices.
* Recommend process improvements to increase delivery efficiency.

**Required SkillsTechnical \& Delivery Skills**

* Strong understanding of Agile and Scrum methodologies.
* Experience managing software delivery programmes.
* Excellent knowledge of Jira and Confluence.
* Experience coordinating engineering, QA, infrastructure, and product teams.
* Strong understanding of SDLC, release management, and defect management.
* Experience managing third\-party technology vendors.
* Excellent reporting and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects.

Pay: ₹70,000\.00 \- ₹90,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

Job Category


Customer Success
Job Details


**About Salesforce**

Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.


Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Leading with our core values, we help companies across every industry blaze new trails and connect with customers in a whole new way. And, we empower you to be a Trailblazer, too — driving your performance and career growth, charting new paths, and improving the state of the world. b304069e.title: Principal Platform Architect
b304069e.description:
**Company Description**  

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI\-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.


Join us to put AI to work for people.

 **Job Description**  

The Platform Architect is a trusted advisor for enterprise platform strategy and governance. You define platform standards and guide technical decisions to ensure ServiceNow remains healthy, scalable, and aligned to customer goals.


Your purpose is to establish governance models, anticipate risks, and enable sustainable growth. You engage across CxO, enterprise architects, and platform teams to influence decisions and ensure consistency across the program.


What You Will Do

* Define and maintain platform vision and strategy aligned to enterprise IT and business objectives.
* Provide architectural guidance to ensure designs align with platform standards and leading practices.
* Shape governance frameworks covering instance strategy, integrations, and data models.
* Facilitate platform governance forums to drive consistent decisions across partners and teams.
* Anticipate and mitigate platform risks (scalability, performance, technical debt).
* Influence adoption of leading practices across customer, partner, and ServiceNow teams.
* Provide structured feedback to ServiceNow product and engineering teams.
* Travel of up to 50% annually may be expected.

  

What Success Looks Like

* ServiceNow is embedded as a strategic enterprise platform with clear governance models in place.
* Platform standards are consistently applied across all delivery teams.
* Technical risks are reduced, and scalability is maintained.
* You are recognised as a trusted advisor on platform strategy and governance, complementing the CSE’s business\-value leadership.

  

**Qualifications** **To be successful in this role you have:**

* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision\-making, or problem\-solving. This may include using AI\-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI\-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
* 10\+ years of experience in enterprise architecture, solution strategy, and program leadership.
* Proven experience engaging at Executive level to influence platform direction and business outcomes.
* Track record of defining multi\-workflow, enterprise\-scale architectures and governance models.
* Strong ability to operate as a program\-level architect, guiding multiple teams and partners toward a unified vision.
* Expertise in platform strategy, integration patterns, and complex delivery governance.
* ServiceNow Certified Master Architect (CMA) plus other architecture and governance framework certifications are highly desirable.

84bb6639.title: Senior Architect, Solutions
84bb6639.description:
Arise® connects enterprises with a global network of entrepreneurial service partners. You will own the architecture of the agent and client global websites and mobile apps — the systems our partners use every day.  



  

This is a hands\-on architecture role, not an advisory one. Roughly 60% of your week is architecture: high\-level solutioning and writing the solution stories your developers build from. About 20% is development sprint work in our .NET services, and 20% is production support — analyzing issues, writing solutions for the team, and coding the fix yourself when that is the fastest path. On\-call support for production issues is part of the role.  



  

**Reports to:** Senior Manager of Engineering


**Team:** Three engineers — two .NET, one mobile


**Core hours:** 7:00 AM – 1:00 PM US Eastern


**Travel:** None  



  

**What you'll do**

* Own architecture across web, mobile, and integration platforms — web and mobile are designed in sync, so you will architect both even though you will code only in .NET
* Lead the modernization of legacy portals into scalable, cloud\-native solutions on AWS
* Architect and develop enterprise portals using ASP.NET MVC and React
* Define architecture standards, coding practices, and governance; lead design and code reviews
* Design REST\-based services, API governance, and integrations with enterprise platforms
* Mentor .NET engineers and build skill and growth plans for the team
* Look for ways to make development more efficient, including with AI tooling — we already use it and want to go further

**What success looks like**

* First 3 months: functional command of all Arise portals, websites, mobile apps, and .NET APIs; the agent registration and enrollment site upgraded to current React; performance and memory\-leak work moving so the portals can migrate to AWS
* By 6 months: architecture options proposed for transforming the legacy portals into modern, cloud\-enabled systems
* By 12 months: those modernized portals implemented, and growth plans in place for the .NET engineers you mentor
**What we're looking for**

* 10\+ years of software development experience, with 5\+ years in solution architecture or technical leadership
* Deep C\# and .NET expertise — .NET Framework and .NET 8\+, ASP.NET MVC, and Web APIs
* A track record modernizing legacy .NET applications at scale
* Microservices, event\-driven design, REST APIs, and API gateway patterns
* AWS cloud architecture; SQL Server and Entity Framework; OAuth2, JWT, and SSO
* React and TypeScript
* Experience architecting both web and mobile applications
* Experience mentoring engineers
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science , Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

**Nice to have**

* Hands\-on Flutter and Dart — a plus, not a requirement
* Salesforce or MuleSoft integration experience
* AWS Solutions Architect certification
* Experience with globally distributed teams and Agile/Scrum delivery

**Equal opportunity**

Arise is an equal opportunity employer. We assess every applicant against the job\-related criteria above, without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable law. Tell your recruiter if you need an accommodation at any point and we will arrange it. Please do not include a photograph, date of birth, or marital status in your application — we do not require them and do not consider them.

In this role, you will design and implement solutions that connect our Retail ERP system with POS, and other platforms, bridging business requirements and technical implementation to ensure efficient data flow, real\-time synchronisation, and optimal performance across our global systems.

528f037f.title: Senior Security Consultant – Cloud And AI Security
528f037f.description:
**Company Description** 
 Network Intelligence is a cybersecurity firm that combines a team of 500\+ security professionals with Transilience, its advanced AI\-driven security platform. The organization focuses on owning end\-to\-end security and compliance outcomes for clients, including certification\-ready support for frameworks such as SOC 2\. Network Intelligence manages complete vulnerability management programs rather than just performing scans, and operates comprehensive security detection and response programs instead of simply raising alerts. The company emphasizes long\-term, trust\-based relationships and is driven by a mission to defend organizations against cyber threats. Team members work in an environment that values collaboration, accountability, and purpose\-driven security work.
 



  





**About the Role** 





  
 





 We are looking for a seasoned Senior Security Consultant –
 
**Cloud \& AI Security** 

 to provide senior consulting and technical leadership across our cybersecurity practices.
 





  
 





 The person will be expected to operate as a senior subject\-matter expert for Cloud \& AI security — leading complex client engagements, providing direction to consulting teams, reviewing critical deliverables, resolving escalations, developing people, supporting business development and ensuring consistently high\-quality outcomes for clients.
 





  
 





 The ideal candidate should have strong experience in cybersecurity consulting, excellent stakeholder management skills and the maturity to operate with both technical depth (in at least 2 cloud environments) and business understanding.
 





  
 




**Key Responsibilities** 





  
 




**1\. Practice \& Delivery Leadership** 



* Lead complex consulting and advisory engagements from inception through delivery.
* Provide technical and consulting directions to teams across multiple engagements.
* Review and provide quality assurance for critical client deliverables, assessments, reports and recommendations.
* Ensure projects are delivered within agreed scope, timelines, quality and commercial commitments.
* Act as the senior escalation point for complex delivery, technical and client issues.
* Establish and continuously improve delivery methodologies, assessment approaches and delivery standards.
* Maintain overall visibility of project portfolio, delivery risks, resource requirements and priorities.
* Mentor and develop consultants and senior consultants, strengthening the technical and consulting capabilities of the team
* **Compliance, risk management, assurance \& audit, privacy, HITRUST, SOC audit and payment security** 

 , making broad cybersecurity exposure particularly relevant for this position




  
 




**2\. Practice Growth \& Innovation** 



* Identify opportunities to improve delivery through technology, automation and AI\-enabled capabilities.
* Drive adoption of automation and continuous compliance practices.
* Keep the practice aligned with evolving cybersecurity regulations, frameworks and industry expectations.
* Identify emerging services and capabilities that can strengthen Network Intelligence's market proposition.
* Work closely with other cybersecurity practices to develop integrated cybersecurity solutions.
* Understand how emerging technologies, particularly cloud adoption and AI, are changing cybersecurity risk, governance and compliance requirements.
* Contribute to the development of new services, methodologies, frameworks and consulting accelerators.




  
 
**3\. Client \& Executive Stakeholder Management** 



* Establish and maintain trusted relationships with client stakeholders.
* Lead discussions with CISOs, CIOs, CTOs, Risk Heads, Compliance Heads, Internal Audit, Information Security and senior management.
* Lead client workshops, risk discussions, assessment meetings and executive presentations.
* Understand the client's business and technology environment and translate cybersecurity requirements into practical and business\-aligned recommendations.
* Provide advisory considering risks arising from cloud environments, AI adoption and other emerging technologies.
* Handle difficult client conversations and escalations with maturity and professionalism.




  
 
**4\. Pre\-Sales \& Business Development** 



* Partner with Sales on opportunities, client discovery and solution discussions.
* Provide technical and consulting inputs for proposals, RFP/RFQ responses, Statements of Work and project estimations.
* Lead technical presentations, workshops and solution discussions with prospective clients.
* Identify opportunities for account expansion and development of new cybersecurity services.
* Contribute to the development of new offerings and consulting capabilities.



  






  
 
**Mandatory Knowledge \& Technical Exposure** 




  






 The candidate must have strong and demonstrable knowledge of
 
**Cybersecurity** 

 and should also possess an excellent working understanding of:
 



* **Cloud Security** 

 – cloud security principles, risks, governance, controls, shared responsibility models and compliance considerations across cloud environments.
* **AI Security** 

 – key security and governance risks associated with AI/ML, AI adoption, data protection, model risks and emerging AI regulatory requirements.
* The ability to evaluate
 
**Cloud and AI\-related risks from a GRC, governance, risk and compliance perspective** 

 .



  





**Cloud Security and AI Security knowledge is mandatory for this role.** 









**Preferred Certifications** 





 CISSP, CISM, CISA, CRISC, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor / Lead Implementer, ISO 22301, PCI DSS, HITRUST, CCSP, AZ500/SC500, AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner or other relevant cybersecurity / GRC certifications would be an advantage.
 





  
 




**Required Experience \& Qualifications** 



* 10–15 years of relevant experience in Cybersecurity , Information Security, Risk, Compliance, Audit or Cybersecurity Consulting.
* Minimum 3–5 years of experience in a team leadership, practice leadership or senior engagement leadership role.
* Demonstrable understanding of
 
**Cloud Security and AI Security** 

 .
* Strong experience managing multiple client engagements simultaneously.
* Proven experience managing and mentoring consulting teams.
* Strong client\-facing and stakeholder management experience.
* Strong understanding of cybersecurity governance, risk management and compliance.
* Excellent report\-writing and presentation skills.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving and decision\-making capabilities.
* Ability to independently manage priorities, escalations and complex client situations.

 The Data cloud team is seeking a highly skilled architect with expertise in Snowflake, Azure, and Databricks to join our dynamic team. As a key member of our global Data Engineering department, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and managing our global cloud\-based data architecture. This role requires a deep understanding of modern data management practices, infrastructure services, role\-based security models, and a proven track record in architecting scalable, efficient data solutions.
 



**Responsibilities:** 



* Design end\-to\-end data architecture solutions on cloud platforms such as Snowflake, leveraging services like Azure Data Factory, Databricks for data integration.

* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure solution designs meet business needs as well as in alignment with the set architecture and guiding principles.

* Establish and maintain monitoring frameworks and processes to proactively identify and address performance and cost related concerns, and service availability
* Escalate architecture and design deviations to the Senior Architect for prompt review and addressing.

* Evaluate new technologies and tools to drive innovation and improve data architecture capabilities.



**Knowledge, Skills and Experience** 
 :
 


* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or related field
* 7\+ years as a Data Architect or similar role, with a focus on cloud\-based data solutions.
* 7\+ years of expertise in data warehouse architecture, including data modeling, optimization, ETL/ELT, and administration.
* In\-depth knowledge of cloud architecture patterns and solution design principles
* Expert in working with large databases, BI applications, data quality, and performance tuning
* Expert in Azure devops setup, CI/CD pipelines configuration and automated scripts
* Hands\-on experience with Azure cloud services (Azure Data Lake, Azure SQL Data Warehouse, etc.) and Databricks for data processing and analytics.
* Strong understanding of Snowflake and Azure Infrastructure services, as well as platform limitations and capabilities
* Good knowledge of Snowflake warehouse security and RBAC models
* Good knowledge and experience with Snowflake database administration and monitoring
* Strong background in relational database concepts with a solid knowledge of star schema, Oracle, SQL, PL/SQL, SQL Tuning, OLAP, Big Data technologies (HANA, Snowflake, or any modern database).
* Experience in designing and implementing scalable, reliable, and high\-performance data solutions in a cloud environment.
* Experience with hands\-on implementation of Microsoft Azure cloud solutions, including but not limited to the following tools is a plus
* Data Factory
* Data Bricks / Spark
* Azure SQL
* Snowflake
* Logic Apps / Flow / Power Automate



  




* Experience in configuring \& monitoring different attributes and handling scale up and scale down scenarios for the application in Azure
* Solid understanding of the Microsoft stack and the toolsets (Fabric, Synapse, Cognitive Services is a plus)
* Strong knowledge of cloud networking and security principles
* Have good understanding of implementation of advanced security, authentication, and single sign on across cloud and on premise
* Familiarity with data security, encryption methods, and compliance standards (GDPR, CCPA, etc.).
* Proficiency with Infrastructure as code (Azure Resource Management, Terraform, etc) to automate infrastructure management is a plus
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams and articulate complex technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Architect certifications in Snowflake, Azure, or Databricks are a plus.



  





**Notes based on client expectations:** 




  




* Position is for a hands\-on Environment Support architect compared to strategy architect
* Existing Data environment is in Snowflake and data transformation, and ML Processing happens on Databricks.
* Good experience in RBAC implementations on Snowflake
* Ability to work with source application team, security, infrastructure teams to set up new data pipelines by configuring/troubleshooting connections, ensuring data models, data pipelines follow standards and best practices,

We set a unified, scalable operating model—covering governance, standards, architecture, service delivery, and reuse—so our business units can deliver at speed and scale.

 India delivery center is one of our global delivery and capability hub. We bring together experts in AI, engineering, analysis, quality, and architecture to deliver product \& process solutions, application run services, change and transformation initiatives, and centralized platform services across both on prem and Guidewire Cloud environments. Our teams operate from multiple global delivery centers, supporting Zurich’s business units worldwide.

 The role provides technical leadership across operations, engineering, and architecture, ensuring secure, scalable, and resilient authentication services across Okta (Workforce IAM), Okta Access Gateway, Auth0 (CIAM), and Microsoft Entra ID (Azure SSO \& Conditional Access).

 of IAM and CIAM platforms, ensuring high availability, scalability, and reliability

* Govern SLAs, KPIs, and service health metrics, ensuring alignment with business and security expectations
* Drive release planning, deployment governance, and platform lifecycle management, incorporating AI\-driven insights to optimize release impact and reduce operational risk

* Lead global L2 / L3 IAM support teams, ensuring effective incident management and service continuity
* Oversee resolution of authentication, access, provisioning, and policy\-related incidents, leveraging AI\-assisted diagnostics, log analytics, and pattern recognition to improve response times
* Define and enforce operational standards, runbooks, and escalation procedures across support teams
* Drive continuous improvement of operations through AI\-enabled monitoring, predictive alerting, and automation, reducing MTTR and increasing service stability
* Manage a global operating model, including on\-call rotations, shift\-based delivery, and critical incident management

* Contribute to and influence target IAM and CIAM architecture, working closely with enterprise and solution architects

* Ensure solutions are aligned with Zero Trust architecture, enterprise standards, and security policies, leveraging AI\-assisted insights to validate design decisions and identify optimization opportunities
* Support architecture governance activities, including solution reviews and design approvals

* Drive implementation and optimization of Zero Trust identity controls, including:
* Okta adaptive authentication and policy\-driven enforcement
* Microsoft Entra Conditional Access for device, risk, and contextual access
* Establish and maintain consistent access control patterns across workforce and customer platforms
* Leverage AI insights to improve risk\-based access decisions, anomaly detection, and policy tuning

08f92993.title: Digital Solutions Consultant II
08f92993.description:
* We deliver the world’s most complex projects.
* Work as part of a collaborative and inclusive team.
* Enjoy a varied \& challenging role.


**Building on our past. Ready for the future**
 Worley is a global professional services company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia.
   

  

 Right now, we’re bridging two worlds as we accelerate to more sustainable energy sources, while helping our customers provide the energy, chemicals and resources that society needs now.
   

  

 We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value over the life of their portfolio of assets. We solve complex problems by finding integrated data\-centric solutions from the first stages of consulting and engineering to installation and commissioning, to the last stages of decommissioning and remediation. Join us and help drive innovation and sustainability in our projects.
   

  

**The Role**
***As a Digital Solutions Consultant II with Worley,***
 you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc….
   

  

* Lead technical discussions and solution design sessions with Marketing, Sales, and internal teams.
* Design and implement Account Engagement solutions, including lead lifecycle management, scoring \& grading models, and nurture journeys using Engagement Studio.
* Develop and configure both out\-of\-the\-box and custom Account Engagement features such as automation rules, dynamic lists, email templates, and landing pages.
* Collaborate with project managers, business analysts, and cross\-functional teams to ensure successful delivery of marketing automation initiatives.
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior developers and marketing operations team members.
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to campaign execution, data sync, and automation processes.
* Perform quality reviews of configurations, assets, and campaigns to ensure adherence to best practices.
* Stay updated with Salesforce Account Engagement releases and marketing automation trends.
* Contribute to technology architecture and marketing automation strategy.


**About You**
 To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:
   

  

**Required Qualifications And Background**
* Overall, 6\+ years of Salesforce implementation experience with exposure to marketing automation
* Minimum of 3 years of experience working with Salesforce Account Engagement (Pardot) or similar marketing automation platforms
* Minimum of 2 years of experience in web technologies (HTML, CSS, basic JavaScript) for email and landing page development
* Minimum of 3 years of experience working in Agile methodologies (user stories, sprint cycles, backlog management)
* Experience with data management, segmentation, and campaign lifecycle management
* Strong understanding of Salesforce and Account Engagement integration, connectors, and data synchronization
* Experience with Azure DevOps or similar CI/CD tools is a plus
* Strong knowledge of marketing automation best practices, email deliverability, and campaign performance optimization
* Experience working in enterprise environments involving release management, version control, and governance
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work collaboratively and guide teams
* Certifications such as Salesforce Pardot Specialist / Pardot Consultant / Platform Developer I are desirable


**Knowledge Preferred**
* The candidate should have 6–8 years of experience in Salesforce implementations with a strong focus on Account Engagement (Pardot)/Marketing Automation/CRM solutions.
* Strong experience in HTML/CSS for email templates and landing pages, with working knowledge of Salesforce platform (Flows, Apex as needed)
* Experience implementing integration solutions between Account Engagement and Salesforce CRM, as well as external systems (e.g., Zapier or APIs)
* Experience with CI/CD and deployment processes in Salesforce environments


**Moving forward together**
 We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values\-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation.

42208b73.title: Sr. Solution Consultant, Enterprise Scheduling
42208b73.description:
**About Kinaxis**
 Elevate your career journey by embracing a new challenge with Kinaxis. We are experts in tech, but it’s really our people who give us passion to always seek ways to do things better. As such, we’re serious about your career growth and professional development, because People matter at Kinaxis.
   

  

 In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers based in Ottawa, Canada. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, and support 40,000\+ users in over 100 countries. As a global leader in end\-to\-end supply chain management, we enable supply chain excellence for all industries. We are expanding our team in Chennai and around the world as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.
   

  

 Our journey in India began in 2020 and we have been growing steadily since then! Building a high\-trust and high\-performance culture is important to us and we are proud to be Great Place to Work® Certified TM . Our state\-of\-the\-art office, located in the World Trade Centre in Chennai, offers our growing team space for expansion and collaboration.
   

  

**Location**
 Chennai, India
   

  

**About The Team**
 As a member of our Consulting Team, you understand our customers’ most pressing business performance challenges and you are committed to helping our customers solve complex challenges in the distributed value chain that is prevalent in manufacturing today.
   

  

****What you will do****
* Participate in in the end\-to\-end deployment of production scheduling tool including deep\-dive customer business requirements discovery sessions and develop requirements specifications documentation.
* Collaborates closely with agile team members to support the configuration, implementation of Maestro software to enable the solution according to our customers distinct needs
* Translate business requirements into Kinaxis Maestro software specifications, following supply chain industry trends and best practices.
* Support senior team members in providing creative solutions to complex business problems while maintaining best practices.
* Participate in data management and data integration activities, including source systems data transformation, data loading, data cleanup and validation.
* Perform training of customer end users on the configured solution.
* Provide technical support to end users and resolve issues of the configured solutions, escalating to senior team members as needed.
* Support the validation and testing of the solution and capture user feedback.
* Actively engage, guide and mentor to develop the skills of junior consultants on projects.
* Any other reasonable project related tasks as assigned by the Project Manager.


****What we are looking for****
* Candidates with results\-oriented mindset, focusing on improving client satisfaction and providing a very high standard of service, driving towards Kinaxis’s success.
* Sound knowledge in Supply Chain concepts especially scheduling with 6\+ years of experience.
* Strong intent to learn our first in class product “Maestro”
* Work in a fast\-paced project environment and co\-ordinate with members at all levels in an organization
* Highly adaptable professional, able to embrace teamwork in diverse and evolving work environments.
* Capability to lead by example, having the drive to think in an innovative way and have passion about new challenges
* Ability to solve complex problems, think critically and make sound judgement decisions.
* A passion for working in customer facing roles that require high level of interpersonal, communication, facilitation and presentation skills.
* Ability to communicate complex ideas effectively in English, both verbally and in writing
* Technical skills such as SQL, R, Java Script, Python, etc.
* Experience with manufacturing planning solutions such as Kinaxis, SAP, JDA, etc. is an added advantage


 \#Senior
   

  

**Work With Impact:** 
 Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day—when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more.
   

  

**Work with Fortune 500 Brands:** 
 Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Some of our customers include Ford, Unilever, Yamaha, P\&G, Lockheed\-Martin, and more.
   

  

**Social Responsibility at Kinaxis:** 
 Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Committee weighs in on hiring practices, talent assessment training materials, and mandatory training on unconscious bias and inclusion fundamentals. Sustainability is key to what we do and we’re committed to net\-zero operations strategy for the long term. We are involved in our communities and support causes where we can make the most impact.
   

  

 People matter at Kinaxis and these are some of the perks and benefits we created for our team:
   

  

* Flexible vacation and Kinaxis Days (company\-wide day off on the last Friday of every month)
* Flexible work options
* Physical and mental well\-being programs
* Regularly scheduled virtual fitness classes
* Mentorship programs and training and career development
* Recognition programs and referral rewards
* Hackathons


 For more information, visit the Kinaxis web site at www.kinaxis.com or the company’s blog at http://blog.kinaxis.com .
   

  

 Kinaxis welcomes candidates to apply to our inclusive community. We provide accommodations upon request to ensure fairness and accessibility throughout our recruitment process for all candidates, including those with specific needs or disabilities. If you require an accommodation, please reach out to us at recruitmentprograms@kinaxis.com. Please note that this contact information is strictly for accessibility requests and cannot be used to inquire about application statuses.
   

  

 Kinaxis is committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process. We use artificial intelligence (AI) tools in the initial step of the recruitment process to compare submitted resumes against the job description, to identify candidates whose education, experience and skills most closely match the requirements of the role. After the initial screening, all subsequent decisions regarding your application, including final selection, are made by our human recruitment team. AI does not make any final hiring decisions.

202c8a5b.description:
This role leads architecture for cloud\-native AI applications leveraging Microsoft Azure, Azure Databricks, LLMOps/MLOps, and enterprise system integrations, ensuring solutions meet standards for security, scalability, governance, and business value.
  

The architect partners closely with AI engineers, data teams, platform teams, product owners, and business stakeholders to translate complex business problems into referenceable, reusable AI architectures.


  
**Required Qualifications**

* 10\+ years of IT experience with 4\+ years in enterprise architecture or AI architecture roles.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Microsoft Azure cloud architecture.
* Deep expertise in AI/ML platforms, especially Azure Databricks.
* Proven experience designing GenAI solutions (RAG, embeddings, LLM fine\-tuning).
* Strong understanding of agentic AI concepts (task agents, orchestration, memory, feedback loops).
* Solid background in distributed systems, APIs, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Experience defining reference architectures and technology standards.

  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Enterprise AI Architecture \& Strategy
* Define and maintain enterprise\-wide architecture standards for AI/ML, GenAI, and Agentic AI platforms across Azure and Databricks.
* Own reference architectures for:
* GenAI applications (RAG, fine\-tuning, prompt engineering)
* Agentic AI systems (multi\-agent orchestration, agent\-to\-agent communication)
* AI platform services (model serving, vector search, AI gateways).
* Guide long\-term AI platform roadmaps aligned to business strategy and cloud architecture principles.
* AI / GenAI / Agentic AI Solution Design
* Architect end\-to\-end AI solutions including:
	+ Data ingestion and feature pipelines
	+ Model training, evaluation, and deployment
	+ Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) using vector databases
	+ Agent frameworks for task orchestration and enterprise workflows.
	+ Design multi\-LLM strategies (Azure OpenAI, open\-source, and commercial LLMs) with abstraction layers and fallback patterns.
	+ Define agent registry, agent orchestration, and governance models for enterprise\-scale usage.
	+ Azure \& Databricks Platform Architecture
	+ Lead architecture for Azure\-native AI stacks
	+ Architect Azure Databricks for: ML training and inference, LLM fine\-tuning and evaluation, Vector search and embedding pipelines, MLflow\-based lifecycle management.
	+ Define cost\-optimized, secure, and scalable cloud reference patterns.
	+ Enterprise Integration \& Interoperability
	+ Define integration patterns between AI platforms and: ERP, CRM, PLM, HCM systems. APIs, event\-driven architectures, and messaging platforms.
	+ Architect AI Gateway and API management patterns for GenAI and agent access.
* Governance, Security \& Compliance
	+ Establish AI/GenAI governance frameworks covering:
		- Data privacy
		- Model risk management
		- Responsible AI principles
		- Auditability and traceability.
		- Ensure architectures integrate with enterprise IAM, RBAC, and SSO.
		- Define guardrails for safe LLM usage, prompt leakage prevention, and data isolation.
* MLOps / LLMOps / AgentOps
	+ Define standards and patterns for:
	+ CI/CD for AI and GenAI workloads
	+ Model versioning, evaluation, and drift monitoring
	+ LLMOps and agent lifecycle management.

As a trusted partner, we provide actionable solutions and innovation through our Aerospace Technologies, Building Automation, Energy and Sustainability Solutions, and Industrial Automation business segments – powered by our Honeywell Forge software – that help make the world smarter, safer and more sustainable.

deae2183.title: Manager - Data Platform & Architecture Lead
deae2183.description:
**Position \- Data Platform \& Architecture Lead**

**Role Summary**


The Data Platform \& Architecture Lead will own the architecture, design, and modernization of Riveron’s enterprise data foundation. This role will be responsible for building scalable, governed, and AI\-ready data infrastructure across Snowflake, Power BI (Microsoft Fabric experience a plus), Salesforce, Alteryx migration, APIs, and shared data access patterns.


This role is central to Riveron’s future\-state data strategy. The person should be both a hands\-on architect and a platform owner who can create durable enterprise patterns rather than one\-off reporting solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the architecture and technical roadmap for Riveron’s enterprise data platform.
* Lead Snowflake data warehouse / lakehouse design, including data modeling, ingestion, transformation, access controls, performance tuning, and cost optimization.
* Design reusable data models, semantic layers, and governed datasets for enterprise reporting and AI\-enabled use cases.
* Partner with reporting and analytics teams to modernize Power BI models (Microsoft Fabric experience a plus) and reduce dependency on manual or fragmented reporting processes.
* Support Alteryx modernization and migration where appropriate, replacing manual workflows with scalable data pipelines.
* Design data integration patterns across Salesforce, SharePoint / Microsoft 365, finance systems, operational platforms, spreadsheets, APIs, and third\-party data sources.
* Establish data quality, lineage, reconciliation, documentation, and observability standards.
* Partner with AI product engineers to make Riveron’s data architecture AI\-ready for pilots, agents, retrieval\-augmented generation, and natural language analytics.
* Provide technical leadership to data engineers, BI developers, analysts, and AI engineers.

**Required Experience**

* 6\-9 years of experience in data architecture, data engineering, cloud data platforms, or analytics engineering.
* Deep hands\-on experience with Snowflake, SQL, data modeling, ELT / ETL, and enterprise data warehouse design.
* Experience with Power BI semantic models required; Microsoft Fabric or similar enterprise BI platform experience a plus but not required.
* Strong understanding of data governance, security, role\-based access, data quality, and lifecycle management.
* Experience integrating data from SaaS platforms, APIs, finance systems, Salesforce, and flat\-file sources.
* Ability to design scalable architecture while still contributing hands\-on when needed.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience with SQL, Python, Airflow, Azure Data Factory, Fivetran, Matillion, or similar tools.
* Experience modernizing Alteryx or spreadsheet\-heavy processes.
* Exposure to AI / ML data readiness, vector databases, semantic search, RAG architecture, or LLM application patterns.
* Experience in finance, consulting, professional services, or Office of the CFO analytics.

**About Riveron:**


At Riveron, we partner with clients—from global multinationals to high\-growth private entities—to solve complex finance challenges, guided by our DELTA values: Drive, Excellence, Leadership, Teamwork, and Accountability. Our entrepreneurial culture thrives on collaboration, diverse perspectives, and delivering exceptional outcomes. We are committed to fostering growth, both for our clients and our people, through mentorship, integrity, and a client\-centric approach. This inclusive environment offers flexibility, progressive benefits, and meaningful opportunities for impactful work that supports well\-being in and out of the office.


Want to stay connected with Riveron? Join our Talent Community to learn more about our growing firm and be considered for future opportunities.


Check us out on social media:


LinkedIn Glassdoor Instagram Facebook

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law.*


Full time roles are eligible for a full range of benefits including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) with company match, and PTO. A complete description of all available benefits can be found at Riveron's Benefits page at https://riveron.com/riveron\-life/. Contract roles are not eligible for benefits.

### **Fraud Alert**


Please beware of fraudulent schemes or impersonations when going through the job application process. A Riveron employee will never recruit via text or extend unsolicited employment offers. Additionally, a Riveron employee will never ask you to exchange money or purchase anything as part of the recruiting process.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. c0d1bfb6.description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
 The role of IT Solution Designer / Solution Architect for Deloitte Technology supports digital transformation by designing and introducing new solutions, IT assets and services sustainably and securely across all layers of IT.
   

  

**Work you'll do**
 Support by working closely with project stakeholders and requestors, gathering requirements for an agnostic technical solution, translating them into technical requirements, creating solution architecture and documentation, estimating effort with project managers, and coordinating implementation with domain experts and operations teams.
   

  

* Requirements: work closely with project stakeholders and requestors to gather all requirements for an agnostic technical solution and translate them into technical requirements
* Design: create architecture for digital services covering hosting, network, user access, data retention, security and sustainable operations
* Analyze: assess design patterns, suppliers and products for effectiveness against functional and quality requirements

cfcd0496.title: Solution Architect (Java OR Python Application Architecture & GitHub Copilot)
cfcd0496.description:
**Role Description**
 Job Description
   

  

**Solution Architect \- Java, Python \& AI Engineering**
**Job Title**
 Solution Architect
   

  

**Experience**
 12\+ years overall; 5\+ years in architecture or technical leadership
   

  

**Location**
 India / Client Location, as applicable
   

  

**Employment Type**
 Full\-time
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are seeking an experienced Solution Architect with strong hands\-on expertise in Java, Python, and AI\-enabled software engineering. The architect will define scalable application and platform architectures, guide engineering teams, and accelerate delivery through GitHub Copilot and agentic AI practices. The role combines enterprise architecture, modern application development, cloud\-native engineering, technical governance, and customer\-facing advisory responsibilities.
   

  

 Proven experience with GitHub Copilot and agentic AI solutions is mandatory. Exposure to GitHub administration and at least one major cloud platform is preferred.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities Architecture \& Technical Leadership**
* Define end\-to\-end solution architectures for enterprise applications and digital platforms using Java, Python, APIs, microservices, event\-driven patterns, and cloud\-native services.
* Create architecture blueprints, reference patterns, technology standards, non\-functional requirements, and implementation roadmaps.
* Lead technical discovery, architecture reviews, design decisions, proof\-of\-concepts, and engineering governance across the delivery lifecycle.
* Provide hands\-on technical direction to development teams, resolve complex design challenges, and ensure alignment with security, performance, scalability, resilience, and maintainability goals.
* Assess existing application landscapes and recommend modernization, re\-engineering, integration, and migration approaches.


**Java Engineering**
* Architect scalable Java solutions using modern Java, Spring Boot, RESTful services, microservices, messaging, persistence frameworks, and automated testing practices.
* Define standards for application layering, API design, exception handling, observability, configuration, dependency management, and secure coding.
* Guide performance engineering, JVM optimization, concurrency, distributed transaction patterns, and production troubleshooting.
* Promote reusable frameworks, engineering accelerators, and quality gates for enterprise Java delivery.


**Python \& AI Engineering**
* Architect Python\-based services, automation components, data\-processing workloads, AI integrations, and intelligent developer tooling.
* Design modular and production\-ready Python solutions using appropriate API frameworks, testing practices, packaging standards, asynchronous processing, and observability.
* Define solution patterns for integrating large language models, enterprise data sources, retrieval\-augmented generation, tool use, and AI\-enabled workflows.
* Guide model and service evaluation, prompt design, grounding, responsible AI controls, quality validation, security, operational monitoring, and cost\-aware implementation.
* Collaborate with data, security, platform, and product teams to transition AI prototypes into governed, supportable production solutions.


**GitHub Copilot \& Agentic AI**
* Lead adoption of GitHub Copilot across Java and Python engineering teams, including use\-case identification, enablement, workflow integration, coding standards, and measurable adoption outcomes.
* Design and implement agentic AI workflows that can reason over context, invoke approved tools, coordinate multi\-step tasks, and operate within defined human oversight and security boundaries.
* Establish patterns for AI\-assisted coding, code explanation, refactoring, unit\-test generation, documentation, code review, troubleshooting, and software delivery automation.
* Define guardrails for prompt handling, sensitive data protection, access control, auditability, human\-in\-the\-loop approvals, responsible AI, and output validation.
* Evaluate Copilot and agentic AI solutions through structured pilots, engineering feedback, quality indicators, productivity measures, risk assessments, and continuous improvement plans.


**DevSecOps, Platform \& Cloud**
* Define CI/CD, build, test, security, release, and deployment patterns for Java and Python workloads using GitHub\-centric engineering practices.
* Promote Infrastructure as Code, containerization, Kubernetes, automated policy enforcement, software supply\-chain security, and environment standardization.
* Architect deployment models for public cloud, private cloud, hybrid, or multi\-cloud environments based on business and technical requirements.
* Collaborate with platform, SRE, operations, and security teams to establish monitoring, logging, tracing, reliability, recovery, and operational support standards.


 Stakeholder \& Delivery Management
   

  

* Partner with customer stakeholders, product owners, enterprise architects, security leaders, and engineering teams to translate business needs into implementable architecture.
* Facilitate architecture workshops, technical assessments, solution walkthroughs, and decision forums.
* Prepare architecture documents, diagrams, solution options, estimates, risk registers, technical proposals, and executive presentations.
* Support pre\-sales, solution shaping, effort estimation, delivery planning, technical interviews, and capability development.


**Required Qualifications \& Experience**
* 12\+ years of overall IT experience, including substantial experience in solution architecture, application architecture, technical leadership, or enterprise software delivery.
* Strong hands\-on expertise in Java and the Spring ecosystem, with experience architecting enterprise applications, APIs, microservices, and distributed systems.
* Strong Python experience for application development, automation, AI integration, or data\-processing solutions.
* Demonstrated experience using GitHub Copilot in software engineering workflows and enabling its adoption across development teams.
* Demonstrated experience designing or implementing agentic AI solutions, including tool integration, orchestration, grounding, guardrails, and human oversight.
* Good understanding of generative AI, large language models, retrieval\-augmented generation, embeddings, prompt engineering, evaluation, responsible AI, and AI security considerations.
* Experience with software architecture principles, design patterns, API management, event\-driven architecture, relational and NoSQL data stores, caching, messaging, and integration patterns.
* Experience defining CI/CD, DevSecOps, automated testing, code quality, security scanning, observability, and release governance practices.
* Strong communication, consulting, documentation, and stakeholder\-management skills, with the ability to present complex technical concepts to technical and business audiences.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Exposure to GitHub administration, including enterprise or organization settings, repositories, teams, permissions, policies, branch protection, rulesets, integrations, APIs, and governance.
* Exposure to GitHub Actions, GitHub Advanced Security, reusable workflows, self\-hosted runners, and GitHub platform automation.
* Experience with at least one cloud platform: Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform or similar Infrastructure as Code tools, and cloud\-native application platforms.
* Experience in application modernization, platform engineering, internal developer platforms, developer experience, or large\-scale technology transformation programs.
* Knowledge of identity and access management, secure software development, threat modeling, compliance controls, FinOps, and AI cost governance.


**Preferred Certifications**
* GitHub Copilot certification.
* GitHub Administration, GitHub Actions, or GitHub Advanced Security certification.
* Cloud architect or developer certification from Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Java, Kubernetes, security, or architecture certification such as TOGAF, where relevant.


**Key Competencies**
* Enterprise solution architecture and technical decision\-making.
* Hands\-on Java, Python, AI, Copilot, and agentic solution capabilities.
* Systems thinking, structured problem\-solving, and risk management.
* Customer advisory, facilitation, technical storytelling, and executive communication.
* Ability to balance innovation, delivery speed, security, quality, cost, and operational sustainability.


**Skills**
 Python, Cloud\-Native Development, GitHub Copilot

10eb142f.title: Solutions Development Architect
10eb142f.description:
**Meet the Team**
 Security at Cisco is no longer a product you bolt on — it is table stakes, and it is a lifecycle, and our Customer Experience (CX) Professional Services team in Asia Pacific \& Japan is where that belief meets our largest Service Provider customers. We help Tier\-1 carriers, national operators, mobile network operators, and telco\-cloud/webscale providers across Japan, Australia/New Zealand, ASEAN, and India transform their security architecture — infusing protection into the network fabric, embedding zero trust by design, and standing up a modern, AI\-driven Security Operations Center. We are a small, senior, high\-trust group of architects of record who operate at the intersection of deep networking and security, and who are trusted by CISOs and CTOs to set the security direction for some of the region's most complex networks. What is exciting is the scope: you own the security agenda for an entire vertical across four diverse markets, and you get to shape how an agentic, AI\-powered SOC and security\-by\-design come to life at carrier scale.
   

  

**Your Impact**
 As a senior Security Solutions Development Architect, you will drive the CX Security pre\-sales architecture and delivery strategy for highly complex, large\-scale groundbreaking engagements across APJ Service Provider accounts, acting as the security architect of record. You will influence security, network, and operations decisions at executive and C\-levels (CISO, CTO, SVP and above) and translate security architecture into measurable outcomes — risk reduction, faster mean\-time\-to\-detect/respond, lower threat dwell\-time, stronger compliance posture, and analyst productivity — so customers can see the business value, not just the technology. You will architect zero trust transformations and security\-by\-design controls (segmentation, secure connectivity, policy\-based isolation) that embed protection into routing, transport, data center, edge, and peering layers, then develop the observability framework and high\-fidelity detections that power an agentic, AI\-driven SOC. You will uncover new and expansion security opportunities, lead CX security RFI/RFP responses, and scope and price cross\-architecture proposals so they can be cleanly delivered by CX's technical delivery teams — staying lightly engaged post\-sale to ensure realization and bring together reference wins. Success looks like a growing, balanced CX Security business across APJ SP, with customers advancing along zero trust, security\-by\-design, and SOC\-modernization journeys that Cisco helped them design and deliver.
   

  

**Security \& Service Provider Technical Domains**
 You Are Expected To Bring Architect\-level Expertise Across At Least Two Domains — Networking And Security Architecture — With Cross\-domain Fluency Over The Following
   

  

* Zero Trust Architecture — zero trust design principles, identity and access, least\-privilege/segmented access, and assume\-breach patterns at SP scale.
* Security\-by\-Design \& Infrastructure Controls — segmentation/micro\-segmentation, secure connectivity, DDoS protection, secure firewalling, and SP edge/peering security embedded in the fabric.
* Networking Foundation — SP routing, transport, data center, and edge architectures as the substrate into which security is infused.
* Observability \& Telemetry Engineering — data collection, parsing, ingestion, normalization, enrichment, and federated search across distributed, multi\-cloud data estates.
* Modern SOC \& Agentic Operations — high\-fidelity, actionable detection use cases, agentic investigation and response, advanced analytics, and SOC modernization.
* AI\-Driven Security — embedding AI and agentic capabilities across the security lifecycle to accelerate detection, investigation, and response.


**APJ Regional Context**
 This role drives and grows the CX Security business across the APJ Service Provider vertical — operating across Japan, Australia/New Zealand, ASEAN (Singapore, Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, Philippines, Vietnam), and India — markets with varying security maturity and regulatory environments. You will account for the global nature of strategic SP customers while navigating multi\-country deployments, data sovereignty, in\-country data residency, and security/privacy compliance requirements specific to APJ, and partner with the regional SI and channel\-partner ecosystem to orchestrate large\-scale transformations. Preferred hiring locations: Indonesia, Malaysia, India.
   

  

**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree \+ 12 years of related experience, OR Master's degree \+ 8 years, OR PhD \+ 5 years, OR equivalent relevant work experience.
* Deep networking expertise with demonstrated ability to apply zero trust security design principles (verify explicitly, least\-privilege access, assume breach) to transform customer security architectures at Service Provider scale.
* Shown mastery of security\-by\-design (network segmentation/micro\-segmentation and infrastructure controls) AND the design of observability frameworks and a modern SOC for detection and response (data collection, ingestion, normalization, enrichment, federated search, and high\-fidelity detection use cases).
* Practical AI fluency for security: demonstrated experience designing AI\-driven detection, investigation, and response and building high\-fidelity, agentic/automation\-led SOC workflows.
* Deep technical pre\-sales experience AND professional services/delivery experience, holding required certifications: CCNP Service Provider (or CCNP Enterprise/equivalent) AND CCNP Security (or equivalent) AND CISSP (or equivalent senior security architecture certification).


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Expert\-level certifications such as CCIE Service Provider, CCIE Enterprise, or CCIE Security; and/or security architecture frameworks such as SABSA or TOGAF.
* Zero trust / SOC and security\-analytics certifications (e.g., Splunk certifications, SANS/GIAC such as GCIH/GCDA), AI\-security credentials, and/or cloud\-security specializations (AWS / Azure / GCP).
* Strong, fluent English (written and spoken) with the executive presence to influence at CISO/CTO/SVP\-and\-above level across diverse APJ markets.
* Recognized strategic influencer, comfortable shaping customer security vision and representing Cisco in industry forums and strategic alliances.
* Skilled at orchestrating the SI and channel\-partner ecosystem to deliver large\-scale, multi\-country Service Provider security transformations.


 Why Cisco?
   

  

 At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
   

  

 Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
   

  

 We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

**About the Team**

The Identity and Access management team manages the identity suite including Okta, Delinea, AD, Entra ID and KeyFactor. Team manages employees, customers and partners identity in IAM system.
**About the Role**

We are seeking a skilled **Active Directory (AD), Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure Active Directory), and Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) Architect** to design, implement, operate, secure, and continuously improve our enterprise identity and certificate services. This role will own engineering activities across on\-premises and cloud identity platforms, with a strong focus on availability, security, automation, governance, and a seamless user experience.
  

The ideal candidate brings deep hands\-on expertise in Windows Active Directory, Entra ID, hybrid identity, authentication and authorization protocols, certificate lifecycle management, and identity\-related incident resolution. They will partner with infrastructure, security, application, endpoint, and service\-management teams to deliver resilient, scalable identity services.
  

Key Responsibilities
  

Active Directory and Hybrid Identity Engineering
* Design, deploy, configure, and maintain enterprise Active Directory Domain Services, including forests, domains, sites, organizational units, trusts, DNS integration, Group Policy, replication, and domain controller lifecycle management.
* Engineer and support hybrid identity integration between on\-premises AD and Microsoft Entra ID, including Microsoft Entra Connect Sync or Cloud Sync, password hash synchronization, pass\-through authentication, federation where applicable, and seamless single sign\-on.
* Develop and maintain logical AD designs, delegation models, administrative tiering, privileged access controls, naming standards, and lifecycle processes.
* Monitor and troubleshoot AD replication, DNS, authentication, domain controller health, Group Policy processing, directory synchronization, and identity\-related service degradation.
* Plan and execute upgrades, migrations, consolidations, domain controller replacements, disaster\-recovery testing, and capacity improvements with minimal business disruption.
* Implement secure configuration baselines and hardening controls aligned to organizational standards and recognized security practices.

Microsoft Entra ID / Azure AD Engineering
* Administer and engineer Microsoft Entra ID capabilities, including users, groups, administrative roles, enterprise applications, app registrations, service principals, managed identities, and directory settings.
* Design and operate identity access patterns for cloud and hybrid applications using SSO, SAML, OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect, SCIM provisioning, and modern authentication.
* Implement and maintain Conditional Access policies, multifactor authentication, passwordless authentication, authentication methods, self\-service password reset, Identity Protection, and risk\-based access controls.
* Support privileged identity management processes, role activation, access reviews, entitlement management, and least\-privilege access models.
* Partner with application owners to onboard applications to Entra ID, resolve authentication and provisioning issues, and improve the security posture of enterprise applications.
* Manage directory synchronization and identity lifecycle workflows, including joiner, mover, leaver, group management, and access\-provisioning integrations.
* Evaluate and implement relevant Microsoft Entra capabilities to enhance identity security, governance, and operational efficiency.

PKI and Certificate Services Engineering
* Design, deploy, administer, and support enterprise PKI services, including Microsoft Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS), certification authorities, certificate templates, enrollment policies, CRL and AIA distribution points, OCSP, and key archival/recovery where required.
* Manage the complete certificate lifecycle for internal and public certificates: request, issuance, renewal, revocation, discovery, inventory, monitoring, and retirement.
* Engineer certificate\-based authentication and encryption solutions for users, devices, servers, applications, network infrastructure, and services.
* Configure and support auto\-enrollment, certificate template permissions, certificate policies, enrollment agents, and secure key\-management practices.
* Maintain root and subordinate CA hierarchy, offline root CA procedures, CA backup and recovery processes, HSM integrations where applicable, and documented key\-ceremony controls.
* Resolve certificate\-chain, trust, revocation, TLS/SSL, smart\-card, device, application, and network authentication issues.
* Establish proactive certificate\-expiry monitoring and automation to reduce service interruption risk.

Security, Automation, and Operational Excellence
* Identify identity and PKI risks, lead remediation activities, and support security audits, vulnerability management, compliance assessments, and incident investigations.
* Analyze identity, authentication, directory, and certificate logs to investigate incidents and provide root\-cause analysis and corrective actions.
* Build and maintain automation using PowerShell, Microsoft Graph API, REST APIs, and other appropriate tooling for administration, reporting, provisioning, compliance checks, and operational tasks.
* Develop operational dashboards, health checks, alerting, and reporting for AD, Entra ID, synchronization services, authentication, and certificate infrastructure.
* Produce and maintain high\-quality architecture diagrams, technical standards, runbooks, knowledge articles, implementation plans, and recovery procedures.
* Participate in on\-call support, major incident response, change management, problem management, and post\-incident reviews as required.
* Collaborate with cybersecurity, cloud engineering, endpoint engineering, network, application, and service\-management teams to deliver integrated solutions.
**About You**

Required Skills \& Qualifications
* **Active Directory (AD DS):** Multi\-forest/multi\-domain topologies, Group Policy Architecture, Trust relationships, Sites \& Services, Kerberos/NTLM authentication flows, and AD security hardening (Tiered Administration model).
* **Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD):** Advanced Conditional Access, Entra Connect/Cloud Sync, Entra ID Protection, PIM, Workload Identities, B2B/B2C, and Microsoft Graph.
* **Keyfactor Ecosystem:** Deep hands\-on experience with **Keyfactor Command** , Orchestrators, Certificate Managers, and Keyfactor API integration.
* **PKI \& Cryptography:** Deep understanding of Public Key Infrastructure principles, X.509 certificates, CRL/OCSP validation, CA hierarchy design, SSH key governance, and HSM management.
* **Automation \& Scripting:** Expert level in **PowerShell** , Python, or Bash, alongside RESTful API integration for identity and PKI orchestration.
* **Protocol Mastery:** Deep knowledge of SAML, OAuth, OIDC, Kerberos, LDAP, SCEP, EST, ACME, and TLS/SSL.
* **Experience:** 10 **\+ years** in Enterprise IAM/Infrastructure Engineering, with at least 5 **\+ years** in a dedicated Lead or Solution Architect capacity.
* **Communication:** Ability to articulate complex cryptographic and identity concepts to C\-level executives, security teams, and application developers.
* **Strategic Problem Solving:** Proven track record of executing large\-scale PKI transitions and AD/Entra ID modernizations in complex, global environments.

Preferred Certifications
  

* **Keyfactor Certifications:** Keyfactor Certified Professional / Engineer.
* **Microsoft Certifications:**

Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate (SC\-300\).
  

Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert (SC\-100\).
  

Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ\-305\).
  

* **Industry Security Certifications:** CISSP, CISM, or Certified PKI Professional (CPKIP).
  

  

**Our Approach to Flexible Work**  



With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in\-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in\-office each week, we simply **spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field** with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter.

0a89b486.title: Software Engineering Senior Manager : Google Cloud Platforms
0a89b486.description:
**About this role:**

* Wells Fargo is seeking a **Software Engineering Senior Manager** to lead the delivery and support of strategic technology solutions.
* This role drives engineering excellence, operational effectiveness and technology modernization while partnering across product, architecture, infrastructure, risk and business teams to deliver secure, scalable and resilient capabilities.

 **In this role, you will:**

* Manage, coach, and develop a team or teams of experienced engineers and engineering managers in roles with moderate complexity and risk, responsible for building high quality capabilities with modern technology
* Ensure adherence to the Banking Platform Architecture, and meeting non\-functional requirements with each release
* Partner with, engage and influence architects and experienced engineers to incorporate Wells Fargo Technology technical strategies, while understanding next generation domain architecture and enable application migration paths to target architecture; for example cloud readiness, application modernization, data strategy
* Function as the technical representative for the product during cross\-team collaborative efforts and planning
* Identify and recommend opportunities for driving escalated resolution of technology roadblocks including code, build and deployment while also managing overall software development cycle and security standards
* Determine appropriate strategy and actions to act as an escalation partner for scrum masters and the teams to meet moderate to high risk deliverables and help remove impediments, obstacles, and friction while encouraging constant learning, experimentation, and continual improvement
* Build engineering skills side\-by\-side in the codebase, conduct peer reviews to evaluate quality and solution alignment to technical direction, and guide design, as needed
* Interpret, develop and ensure security, stability, and scalability within functions of technology with moderate complexity, as well as identify, manage and mitigate technology and enterprise risk
* Collaborate with, partner with and influence Product Managers/Product Owners to drive user satisfaction, influence technology requirements and priorities in the product roadmap, promote innovative and intelligent solutions, generate corporate value and articulate technical strategy while being a solid advocate of agile and DevOps practices
* Interact directly with third party vendors and technology service providers
* Manage allocation of people and financial resources to ensure commitments are met and align with strategic objectives in technology engineering
* Hire, build and guide a culture of talent development to have the skills required to effectively design and deliver innovative solutions for product areas and products to meet business objectives and strategy, as well as conduct performance management for engineers and managers

 **Required Qualifications:**

* 7\+ years of Software Engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
* 3\+ years of management or leadership experience

 **Desired Qualifications:**

* Experience leading software engineering teams delivering cloud\-native solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Strong understanding of Platform Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), cloud infrastructure and developer enablement practices.
* Experience building and operating highly available, scalable, secure and resilient enterprise platforms and services.
* Experience with Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD pipelines, automation frameworks and cloud operations.
* Experience establishing observability, monitoring, incident management, capacity management and operational excellence practices.
* Experience driving resiliency, disaster recovery, business continuity and production support strategies for critical enterprise applications.
* Experience partnering with Product Managers, Architects, Infrastructure, Security, Risk and Operations teams to deliver technology solutions aligned to business objectives.
* Experience developing technology roadmaps, engineering standards, reusable platform capabilities and cloud adoption strategies.
* Knowledge of cloud security, risk management, regulatory requirements and governance practices within large financial institutions.
* Experience supporting enterprise Data, Analytics, AI/ML or cloud transformation initiatives.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to influence technical and non\-technical stakeholders at multiple organizational levels.
* Demonstrated ability to attract, develop, mentor and retain engineering talent while fostering an inclusive and high\-performing culture.
* Experience managing vendor relationships, technology service providers and strategic technology partnerships.
* Proven ability to lead multiple concurrent initiatives, balance competing priorities and deliver results in a complex enterprise environment.
* Google Cloud certifications such as Professional Cloud Architect, Professional Cloud Developer or equivalent cloud certifications.

 **Job Expectations:**

* Provide leadership for engineering delivery, operational stability and technology modernization initiatives supporting enterprise cloud platforms.
* Drive adoption of engineering best practices across software development, platform operations, reliability engineering and automation.
* Establish a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, innovation and operational excellence.
* Collaborate across organizational boundaries to remove impediments, accelerate delivery and improve customer outcomes.
* Participate in major incident management, production escalation support and executive communications as needed.
* Ensure technology solutions meet enterprise standards for security, resiliency, scalability, availability and risk management.
* Support workforce planning, talent development, succession planning and organizational capability building.
* Influence strategic technology decisions and contribute to the long\-term evolution of cloud platform capabilities.

**Posting End Date:**


24 Aug 2026* ***Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.***

**We Value Equal Opportunity**


Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.


Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance\-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. There is emphasis on proactive monitoring, governance, risk identification and escalation, as well as making sound risk decisions commensurate with the business unit’s risk appetite and all risk and compliance program requirements.
