e859eb76.title: Solution Engagement Lead
e859eb76.description:
### **Job Type:**


Permanent


### **Experience:**


12 \- 15 Years


### **Location:**


Bangalore


#### **Life at EvoluteIQ:**


We at EvoluteIQ believe in the power of transformation. We are committed to building a industry\-leading technology that will revolutionize the way enterprises conduct business.


To make that happen, we need people who are generous, genuine, self\-driven and collaborative. People who not only want to be a part of a fast\-growing and radical thinking company, but who are kind and care—about each other. We at EvoluteIQ thrive in the company of each other and make each other a better version of ourselves every day.


**Could that be you?**


#### **The EIQ Mission:**


Our culture is who we are, and it defines us. We are nimble, fast, dedicated, humble and bold. We see opportunities everywhere around us to make a **“dent in the universe”.** Our core fabric is Innovation! And this is not just a word, but the way of life within EvoluteIQ.


Changing the way business is done, reimagining the future of work, and enabling people to improve their quality of work every day, is a daunting task. That is what we all strive every day at EvoluteIQ. To enable everyone to automate complicated processes with their instinct and knowledge.


We make building of automation simple for everyone, so that it is not mystery for a few.


**Would you like to be part of this journey?**


We are seeking a seasoned **Solution Engagement Lead** with deep expertise End\-to\-end planning and delivery of PS engagements on the EIQ agentic automation platform, ensuring on\-time, on\-budget, and high\-quality delivery directly to customers or with partners. Ability to collaborate with Product, Architecture, and Engineering leaders. This role requires hands\-on Technology led transformation delivery with hands on experience across planning, execution, reporting, risk and change management, budget control, and people leadership in a low\-code/no\-code, AI\-native product environment.


#### **What you'll do at EvoluteIQ:**


* Lead end\-to\-end planning and execution of large\-scale enterprise transformation programs, partnering closely with C\-level stakeholders and business leaders.
* Define program scope, milestones, dependencies, and execution roadmaps while leveraging platform capabilities and technical initiatives.
* Own program governance through integrated project plans, executive dashboards, KPIs, and regular stakeholder reporting.
* Drive delivery excellence by enforcing SDLC, release governance, and best practices across complex programs valued at USD 10M\+ with 100\+ member cross\-functional teams.
* Proactively identify, assess, and manage program risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies (RAID), ensuring timely mitigation and executive escalations.
* Govern changes to scope, timelines, and budgets through structured change management, impact assessments, and stakeholder approvals.
* Plan and optimize program budgets, resource capacity, and workforce allocation across multiple engineering squads and delivery streams.
* Collaborate with Architecture, Engineering, DevOps, QA, and Product teams to deliver high\-quality releases, ensuring robust testing, deployment planning, and rollback strategies.
* Partner with Customer Success, Implementation, and Support teams to manage production releases, hotfixes, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Leverage AI\-powered project management and delivery tools (e.g., Jira, Azure DevOps with AI capabilities) to enhance planning, forecasting, risk prediction, and execution efficiency.
* Foster a high\-performance, collaborative engineering culture by providing leadership, coaching, and guidance to project managers, architects, and engineering teams.
#### **What will you bring to the team?**


* 12\-15 years of experience in software program delivery, including 8–10 years managing multi\-squad projects or programs.
* Strong hands\-on expertise in project planning, execution tracking, status reporting, risk and issue management, and structured change control.
* Proven Agile delivery experience in delivering automation programs
* Deep working knowledge of Jira, MS Project, including boards, workflows, reports, and dashboards.
* Experience with low\-code/no\-code, workflow automation, integration platforms, or AI/ML products
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with distributed teams (India, UK, US and other regions).
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and conflict\-resolution skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority.
#### **Must to Have:**


* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with proven experience working directly with international clients and global teams.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Sass/SCSS for building scalable, maintainable, and responsive styling architectures.
* Good understanding of Automation Technologies, Cloud Infrastructure, and core Cloud Computing concept
#### **What We Offer:**


* Opportunity to shape the strategy of a next\-gen hyper\-automation platform.
* Work with a cross\-disciplinary team in a fast\-growing, innovation\-driven environment.
* Competitive compensation and growth opportunities.
* A culture of innovation, ownership, and continuous learning.
Ready to take the next step in your career journey with us? Apply now and become part of a dynamic team that values expertise, collaboration, and a positive work culture!


Don’t Meet Every Requirement? We Still Want to Hear From You!


Please go ahead and apply anyway.


We know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes and passion can’t be learned. If you believe, then we would like to meet you and explore that belief!


We value a range of diverse backgrounds, experiences, and ideas. We pride ourselves on our diversity and inclusive workplace that provides equal opportunities to all persons regardless of age, race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, national origin, disability, neurodiversity, military and/or veteran status, or any other protected classes.

9428b21c.title: Oracle Cloud Technical Consultant – Managed Services
9428b21c.description:
Huron is a global consultancy that collaborates with clients to drive strategic growth, ignite innovation and navigate constant change. Through a combination of strategy, expertise and creativity, we help clients accelerate operational, digital and cultural transformation, enabling the change they need to own their future.  

  

Join our team as the expert you are now and create your future.


At Huron, our consultants lead with expertise and collaboration, partnering with client leaders to create sustainable solutions that drive meaningful results. As an Oracle Cloud Technical Consultant within our Managed Services team, you will design, build, and support integrations and extensions across Oracle Cloud applications, keeping clients' critical Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Human Capital Management (HCM), and Supply Chain Management (SCM) environments running smoothly and evolving with their needs.  

  

Your role will foster a supportive, inclusive environment, empowering team members and creating a workplace where diverse perspectives are valued.1 If you are passionate about driving impactful solutions and believe in the power of collaboration, Huron offers a rewarding path forward.
As the Oracle Cloud Technical Consultant, you will:

* Design, develop, and troubleshoot integrations using Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), covering Cloud\-to\-Cloud and On\-Premise\-to\-Cloud scenarios across Financials, HCM, and SCM
* Build Platform\-as\-a\-Service (PaaS) for Software\-as\-a\-Service (SaaS) extensions and bulk integrations, implementing end\-to\-end data flows with strong error\-handling mechanisms
* Develop SaaS extensions and customize Oracle Redwood pages using Visual Builder Cloud Service (VBCS), delivering responsive web and mobile experiences
* Utilize File\-Based Data Import (FBDI), Representational State Transfer (REST) Application Programming Interfaces (APIs), and Simple Object Access Protocol (SOAP) web services for Oracle Cloud ERP
* Build reports and analytics using Oracle reporting tools such as Business Intelligence (BI) Publisher, Oracle Transactional Business Intelligence (OTBI), and Oracle Analytics Cloud (OAC)
* Provide Level 2 managed\-services support, resolving issues and maintaining service quality across event\-based integrations and online workflows
* Support Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) services, including compute, storage, networking, and databases, applying security and deployment best practices

### **Requirements Required**

* 6\+ years of experience in Oracle Cloud Technical services, including hands\-on work with Oracle SaaS applications and web technologies such as REST/SOAP, JavaScript Object Notation (JSON), Extensible Markup Language (XML), OAuth, JavaScript, HyperText Markup Language (HTML), and Cascading Style Sheets (CSS)
* Proven expertise in Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), Oracle Autonomous Database, FBDI, REST APIs, and SOAP web services, including PaaS\-for\-SaaS extensions and bulk integrations
* Proficiency in Structured Query Language (SQL) and Procedural Language/SQL (PL/SQL), with a strong understanding of Oracle modules and Fast Formulas
* Experience with Visual Builder (VBCS/VBS) to enable and customize Oracle Redwood pages
* Strong problem\-solving, analytical, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate in teams and manage time effectively

**Preferred**

* Experience with Oracle reporting tools (BI Publisher, OTBI, OAC) and proficiency in data modeling, warehousing, and Extract\-Transform\-Load (ETL) processes
* Working knowledge of Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) architecture, security features, and service management, along with familiarity with ITIL or other service management frameworks

**Position Level**
------------------


Senior Associate**Country**
-----------


India

01629e86.description:
Bei Roche kannst du ganz du selbst sein und wirst für deine einzigartigen Qualitäten geschätzt. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen. Hier wirst du für das, was du bist, wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert. Dies schafft ein Umfeld, in dem du sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich wachsen kannst. Gemeinsam wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und in Zukunft. Werde Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.
  
  

Die Position
  
  

P Technology Innovation\& Solutions Engineer
  
  

The P Technology Innovation\& Solutions Engineer will be a key member of the People\& Culture (P) Engineering team within Roche Digital Technology (RDT). Operating at the intersection of public cloud infrastructure and core HR SaaS platforms, the P Engineering team provides the technical enablers and hands\-on validation required to realize P strategic objectives.
  
  

As the P Technology Innovation\& Solutions Engineer, you will act as a hands\-on technical partner to Product Delivery Leads (PDLs) and work alongside Solution Architects. In this role, you will evaluate technology roadmaps, assess feature feasibility, write serverless glue code, and build cloud\-native prototypes and integration adapters for our P platform ecosystem.
  
  

The Opportunity
  
  

In this role, you will drive hands\-on technical execution, rapid prototyping, and architecture validation across our HR technology landscape. You will:
  
  

* Partner daily with Product Delivery Leads and Solution Architects to evaluate feature feasibility, latency, rate limits, and integration impacts across platforms like Workday, ServiceNow, and Cornerstone.
* Engineer lightweight, serverless cloud glue code using services like AWS Lambda and API Gateway to connect core SaaS platforms with internal cloud environments.
* Build rapid Proofs\-of\-Concept (PoCs) to validate integration feasibility and streamline real\-world data flow across cloud ecosystems.
* Lead deep\-dive technical discussions with prospective vendors, inspecting API/SDK capabilities, payload schemas, and authentication models beyond high\-level product demonstrations.
* Drive technical Security Risk Assessments (SRAs) and detailed data\-flow mappings for new tools and integration patterns in close coordination with Cybersecurity teams.
* Analyze existing P system capabilities and cloud resources to eliminate redundant middleware, optimize runtime performance, and ensure full utilization of tools.
* Test API payloads, webhooks, and modern authentication protocols in real\-world cloud environments to ensure robust execution before squad deployment.
* Translate complex cloud and API performance parameters into clear technical trade\-offs to help business stakeholders and product leads make informed decisions.


Who you are
  
  

We are looking for an accountable, self\-driven engineer who thrives on solving technical roadblocks and inspecting cloud capabilities. To excel in this role, you bring:
  
  

* Experience: 4–6 years of hands\-on experience in cloud engineering, integration engineering, or senior technical systems analysis within an enterprise setting.
* Education\& Certifications: A degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, alongside active certification in a major public cloud platform (AWS certified like Solutions Architect Associate/Developer preferred, or Azure/GCP).
* Cloud Infrastructure Proficiency: Hands\-on experience building and managing core serverless cloud services, including AWS Lambda, API Gateway, S3, IAM, EventBridge, CloudWatch, and Secrets Manager.
* APIs\& Integration Expertise: Deep understanding of RESTful APIs, GraphQL, webhooks, JSON/XML payloads, and modern authentication protocols like OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, and SAML.
* Scripting Skills: Proficiency in modern scripting languages, such as Python or Node.js/TypeScript, for rapid PoC creation and automated data transformations.
* Security\& Risk Assessment: Practical experience conducting Security Risk Assessments (SRAs), data flow modeling, payload schema validation, and technical risk reviews.
* Proactive\& Collaborative Mindset: Strong self\-driven curiosity to write PoC code without waiting for exhaustive specs, combined with the ability to collaborate seamlessly with cross\-functional teams.


Call to Action
  
Ready to bring your unique qualities to Roche and make an impact? Apply now and join us in our mission to shape the future of healthcare.
  
  

\#RDT2026
  
  

Wer wir sind
  
  

Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation an. Mehr als 100\.000 Mitarbeiter weltweit arbeiten gemeinsam daran, wissenschaftliche Fortschritte zu erzielen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und für zukünftige Generationen. Durch unser Engagement werden über 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt und mehr als 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostik\-Produkten durchgeführt. Wir ermutigen uns gegenseitig, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und hohe Ziele zu setzen, um lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen zu liefern.
  
  

Gemeinsam können wir eine gesündere Zukunft gestalten.
  
  

Roche ist ein Arbeitgeber, der die Chancengleichheit fördert.

Job Description
  
  

The Opportunity
  
  

* Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130\- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.
* Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data\-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.

Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our companys’ IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
  
A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well\-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. We are seeking a hands\-on Technical and Data Architect to join the Central Data Analytics team supporting the Commercial domain. Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. You can put your empathy, creativity, digital mastery, or scientific genius to work in collaboration with a diverse group of colleagues who pursue and bring hope to countless people who are battling some of the most challenging diseases of our time. The Practice Head is accountable for establishing how Sanskar Technolab designs and delivers integrated ERPNext solutions across functional configuration, Frappe customization, integrations, data architecture and cross\-module business processes.

Plan recruitment, allocation, mentoring, certification and career development.
Build strong expertise across ERPNext modules, Frappe Framework and key industry domains.
Review team utilization, capacity and project allocation.
Solution Governance

Review high\-risk, fixed\-price, multi\-company, multi\-country and integration\-heavy solutions.
Ensure that solutions follow ERPNext and Frappe best practices.
Ensure appropriate separation between standard configuration, custom development and process change.
Review architecture, data strategy, integration design, security, scalability and upgrade impact.
Own major solution escalations and recovery planning.
Presales Governance

Ensure assumptions, exclusions, risks and client dependencies are clearly documented.
Protect delivery from unrealistic estimates and unclear commitments.

Work with Growth leadership while maintaining solution quality and delivery feasibility.
Sales remains responsible for pricing, negotiation, revenue targets and deal closure. ERPNext Solution Consulting is responsible for discovery depth, solution fitment, scope, estimates, assumptions, risks and solution confidence.

Support Lead Consultants with major functional\-technical decisions.
Work with the CTO on complex architecture, framework, performance and engineering matters.
Work with PMO on delivery risks, estimate variance, scope leakage and corrective actions.
Lead resolution of critical cross\-functional and technical escalations.
Review implementation outcomes and ensure lessons are captured.
Capability and Intellectual Property
Build reusable ERPNext industry solutions, templates, accelerators and demo environments.
Develop standard estimation models and solution\-design templates.
Maintain solution patterns for integrations, data migration and cross\-module architecture.
Encourage internal knowledge creation and contribution.
Identify opportunities for reusable products, custom applications and AI\-enabled ERP solutions.
People Management
Conduct capability and performance reviews for ERPNext Solution Consulting team members.
Define individual development plans and training needs.
Mentor Lead and Senior Consultants.
Support recruitment, interviews and technical\-functional assessments.
Build succession plans for critical solution\-leadership positions.
Create a culture of ownership, consulting excellence and continuous learning.
Required Experience and Skills
Extensive leadership experience in ERPNext and Frappe implementation.
Deep hands\-on knowledge of ERPNext modules and Frappe architecture.
Strong understanding of Python, JavaScript, SQL, APIs, integrations and data architecture.
Experience managing complex, multi\-module and multi\-company ERP implementations.
Strong presales, estimation and solution\-governance experience.
Experience leading and developing techno\-functional consulting teams.
Strong commercial awareness and understanding of project profitability.
Ability to communicate with CXO\-level client stakeholders.
Strong escalation management and decision\-making capability.
Ability to collaborate effectively with Delivery, PMO, Functional Consulting, Engineering, QA, DevOps and Growth teams.
Key Performance Indicators
ERPNext solution acceptance rate.
Estimation accuracy and reduction in estimate variance.
Reduction in functional and technical rework.
Presales solution quality and handover completeness.
Implementation and go\-live success.
Scope\-leakage reduction.
Project\-quality and profitability outcomes.
Consultant utilization and capacity effectiveness.
Consultant capability and certification development.
Client and internal stakeholder confidence.
Reusable solution and intellectual\-property contribution.
Successful resolution of major solution escalations.

-------------------------------------------


Culture at the core


Our ERPNext implementation company in India promotes an uplifting culture where we learn, have fun, and grow together!


Converse \& Grow


The management and employees are always up for collaboration and conversation. Don't hold back—ask questions, seek clarity, and share your ideas freely.


Collaborative Growth


You grow. We grow! We thrive on a culture of shared learning. Together, we'll embark on a journey of continuous growth where knowledge is shared, skills are honed, and success is celebrated.

Embrace the true you


Embrace your inner trailblazer and unleash your creativity. We foster an environment encouraging bold ideas, out\-of\-the\-box thinking, and relentless innovation.

* Quality: You will ensure that all integration workstreams delivered by internal squads and external partners meet our uncompromising standards of excellence. By implementing strict governance, testing standards, and validation protocols, you will safeguard the integrity of our digital ecosystem.
* Responsibility: You will take full ownership of the US integration pipeline, budgets, and project timelines. You will manage delivery risks proactively and act as the ultimate regional escalation point, resolving issues with decisiveness and accountability.

* Efficiency: You will optimize project resources, streamline cross\-charging processes across business segments, and eliminate delivery bottlenecks. By leveraging Agile methodologies, you will ensure our integration investments yield maximum business value with minimal waste.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Timeline Execution: Define, track, and manage complex, end\-to\-end integration delivery timelines for regional and global digital initiatives, ensuring critical milestones are met.
* Agile Governance: Lead agile execution across squads using Scrum and Kanban methodologies; facilitate sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, backlog grooming, and retrospectives.
* Dependency \& Risk Management: Proactively identify, analyze, and mitigate cross\-project and cross\-squad technical dependencies, ensuring potential timeline slip risks are addressed before impact occurs.
* Scope Control: Rigorously manage integration project scope, ensuring any changes are clearly documented, evaluated for timeline/cost impact, and formally approved through established Change Request channels.

### **2\. Segment \& Stakeholder Management**

* Segment Partnership: Act as the primary Integration Hub liaison to regional business segments (such as Snacking, Food, and Petcare), aligning the integration pipeline with specific segment priorities and commercial goals.

* Proactive Visibility: Maintain clear, transparent communication channels with business partners and digital leadership, delivering regular, data\-driven status updates on commitments, targets, and execution velocity.

### **3\. Vendor, Resource \& Financial Management**

* Cross\-Charge Administration: Oversee the financial management of integration deliveries, including tracking project budgets, estimating efforts, managing statement of works (SOWs), and executing financial cross\-charges/chargebacks to participating business segments.
* SLA \& Assurance: Provide assurance to the Global Integration Director that external partners are delivering to agreed\-upon service levels, cost parameters, and architectural standards.

8d42657c.title: Senior Solution Architect
8d42657c.description:
**The Role**
 We are looking for a Senior Solution Architect who is a genuine technical generalist: someone who reasons from first principles, is insatiably curious about how things work under the hood, and can move fluidly between low\-level implementation detail and high\-level business narrative. You will own the technical shape of diverse client engagements \- from cloud and full\-stack platforms to modern AI and inference systems \- and remain hands\-on through delivery rather than handing designs over the wall.
   

  

*This is a role for a builder\-architect: equally comfortable whiteboarding a system with a principal engineer, debugging an inference bottleneck, or explaining a trade\-off to a customer and internal teams in plain language.*
**What You'll Do**
* Own end\-to\-end solution architecture for client engagements across cloud, data, full\-stack, and AI/ML workloads, balancing technical rigour with cost, security, and time\-to\-value.
* Design from first principles — decompose unfamiliar problems, evaluate options on their merits, and justify decisions rather than defaulting to patterns or hype.
* Stay hands\-on through delivery: prototype, review code and infrastructure, unblock engineering teams, and ensure what was designed is what actually ships.
* Simplify complex technical concepts for business, leadership, and customer audiences — translate architecture into outcomes, risks, and options stakeholders can act on.
* Lead client conversations, discovery workshops, and solution presentations; act as a trusted technical advisor and the bridge between engineering and the business.
* Architect AI\-centric solutions — reason about model selection, inference architecture, tuning/optimization, and the systems that serve models in production.
* Coach and uplift teams — mentor engineers and associate architects, run design reviews, and raise the technical bar through teaching, not gatekeeping.
* Explore and prototype emerging technologies, bringing a spirit of creative, spontaneous problem\-solving to engagements where the right answer isn't yet obvious.


**Core Technical Competencies**
 You Should Bring a Strong Working Foundation Across The Following — Breadth As a Generalist, With The Ability To Go Deep Wherever a Problem Demands It
   

  

* System design fundamentals — scalability, reliability, data modelling, consistency, latency, and the trade\-offs between them.
* Cloud architecture and services — ideally AWS — including compute, storage, networking, serverless, and well\-architected design principles.
* Full\-stack development — backend and frontend, APIs, and the ability to read, write, and review production code with credibility.
* Software engineering best practices — version control, testing, design patterns, and maintainable, observable systems.
* DevOps and platform engineering — CI/CD, IaC, containerization, orchestration, and operational concerns across the delivery lifecycle.


**AI \& Inference Systems**
 A solid, current understanding of how modern AI systems are built and operated — not just how to call an API:
   

  

* Underlying architecture of AI systems and inference pipelines — how models are served, scaled, and integrated into broader applications.
* Model lifecycle fundamentals — how model development, fine\-tuning, and optimization work, and when each is appropriate.
* Practical grasp of inference economics and performance — latency, throughput, cost, quantization, and the levers that move them.
* Familiarity with GenAI patterns — retrieval\-augmented generation, agentic workflows, evaluation, and grounding/guardrails.


**Who You Are**
 Beyond the skills, we're looking for a particular mindset:
   

  

* A first\-principles thinker who questions assumptions and reasons up from fundamentals rather than relying on received wisdom.
* A curious generalist and technology enthusiast with a genuine drive to understand how things work under the hood.
* A creative, spontaneous problem\-solver — comfortable improvising, prototyping, and finding non\-obvious paths when the textbook answer falls short.
* A clear communicator who is well\-spoken and equally effective with deeply technical engineers and non\-technical executives.
* A natural teacher — someone who enjoys explaining, simplifying, and helping others level up.
* Strong attention to detail paired with the judgment to know when to zoom out to the bigger picture.


**Experience \& Qualifications**
* 6–8 years of professional experience, with a strong foundation as a software developer/engineer.
* Demonstrated progression into solution architecture — associate, and ideally senior\-associate level, exposure.
* A track record of delivering technical solutions in client\-facing or product environments.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Relevant cloud certifications (e.g., AWS Solutions Architect) are a strong plus.


**Nice to Have**
* Prior consulting or professional\-services delivery experience.
* Hands\-on experience with Bedrock, SageMaker, or comparable ML/GenAI platforms.
* Experience presenting at workshops, enabling teams, or producing technical thought\-leadership content.

**Requirements**

* Experience in integrating third\-party systems and API architecture.

* Knowledge of regulatory standards and certifications applicable to sensors and devices.
* A minimum of 4 years of experience in a similar role or a technical environment related to system integration.

Through industry\-defining brands including Kidde, Kidde Commercial, Edwards, GST, Badger, Gloria, and Aritech, we provide advanced solutions and services to protect people and property in various applications worldwide.
   

  

**World Leaders in Fire and Life Safety**

Through iconic, industry\-defining brands including Kidde, Kidde Commercial, Edwards, GST, Badger, Gloria and Aritech, we provide residential and commercial customers with advanced solutions and services to protect people and property in a wide range of applications, all around the globe.

69541259.title: Solutions Architect
69541259.description:
**Solution Architect – Microsoft Business Applications** 




**Role Overview\-** 




 We are seeking a Solution Architect who can take business requirements and rapidly convert them into working solutions across the Microsoft ecosystem — Dynamics 365, Power Platform, and the underlying data and AI layer. This is a fast\-moving, hands\-on role: the person will not just design architecture on paper, but actively build and ship solutions. Equally important: this person must stay ahead of the Microsoft ecosystem on their own initiative — new product releases, AI capabilities, platform shifts — and proactively bring relevant innovations into Starlink and StarCent without being asked. We are not looking for someone who waits for direction; we're looking for someone who arrives with the direction already scoped out.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 • Translate business requirements directly into working solutions using Dynamics 365, Power Apps, and Power Automate — with a bias toward speed of solutioning, not just design documentation.
 



 • Own end\-to\-end delivery of automated workflows and low\-code applications that extend or fill gaps around D365\.
 



 • Architect how D365 and business data flows into Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory/Synapse, and how AI services (Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI) can be layered on top to unlock new use cases.
 



 • Continuously track the Microsoft product roadmap and emerging AI capabilities — Copilot Studio, Azure AI, Power Platform updates — and proactively propose where these should be adopted internally, without waiting for a business ask.
 



 • Bring industry best practices into the organization unprompted; act as the internal expert who raises the bar rather than one who waits to be pushed.
 



 • Partner with Product, Engineering, and Business stakeholders to ensure solutions are grounded in real business outcomes, not just technical elegance.
 



 • Provide architectural guidance and hands\-on support to implementation teams — this role builds, not just advises.
 



 • Evaluate emerging Microsoft technologies and lead their adoption where there's a clear business case.
 



  





**Required Qualifications \& Experience (Must\-Haves)\-** 




  





 • 5\+ years hands\-on Solution Architecture experience within the Microsoft Dynamics 365 ecosystem. Deep, hands\-on expertise in:
 



 • Dynamics 365 (relevant modules — CE/F\&O/CS) • Power Apps — building and shipping custom low\-code applications
 



 • Power Automate — designing and deploying automated workflows as core infrastructure, not an afterthought
 



 • Demonstrated track record of converting business requirements into deployed solutions quickly — not just architecture diagrams.
 



 • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills; able to work directly with business teams to scope requirements without heavy translation layers.
 



  





**Highly Valued (Good\-to\-Have — a candidate strong across all three is exceptional) \-** 




  





 • Microsoft Fabric — understanding how D365/business data lands, gets modeled, and becomes usable.
 



 • Azure Data Factory / Synapse — data integration and pipeline experience.
 



 • Azure AI Foundry / Azure OpenAI Service — experience designing solutions that call into AI services from within business workflows. A candidate who combines strong Power Platform/D365 delivery skills with genuine Fabric \+ AI services experience is the ideal profile — this combination is rare and should be weighted heavily in evaluation.
 



  





**Ideal Candidate\-** 





 A self\-directed technologist who treats staying current on the Microsoft ecosystem as part of the job description, not an extracurricular. Someone who has already been the person in their last organization who said “we should be using this” before anyone asked — and who can prove it with a specific example, not just a claim. Combines fast, hands\-on solutioning with genuine curiosity about where Microsoft's AI and platform investments are heading next, and the judgment to know which of those are actually worth bringing into Starlink and StarCent.

**Positions \-**

 Full\-time
   

  

**About The Company And The Product**
**India Health Link** 
 is building a new multi\-tenant Hospital Management Information System (HMIS) — one platform serving many hospitals — with Artificial Intelligence (AI) features delivered as optional plug\-ins on top of a core that works fully without them. It is a greenfield build, and the first pilot hospital goes live in month 6\.
   

  

**Our stack** 
 : Amazon Web Services (AWS), Terraform, GitHub Actions, Docker, TypeScript and NestJS services, PostgreSQL 16, Python for the AI services.
   

  

**What You Will Build**
* The whole AWS footprint as Terraform code: Virtual Private Cloud (VPC), Elastic Container Service (ECS) Fargate, Relational Database Service (RDS) PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, Simple Storage Service (S3\), OpenSearch, Redis, EventBridge and CloudFront.
* Continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) on GitHub Actions: build, test, migrate, deploy, roll back. Deployment must be boring.
* Environments: development, staging, pre\-production with anonymised data, and production.
* Monitoring and alerting that a twelve\-person team can actually respond to, with centralised logs and traces.
* Backup and disaster recovery with a tested restore, not a documented one.
* The on\-premise edge gateway image that runs inside a hospital's local network for analyser connectivity and Local Area Network mode when the internet is down.


**Responsibilities**
* Own infrastructure cost, keep it inside the agreed monthly budget, and report it monthly.
* Own security hygiene: least\-privilege identity and access management (IAM), secrets management, encryption at rest and in transit, patching, and network boundaries.
* Own remediation for the Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Test (VAPT) in month 5 — coordinate the external firm and drive every finding to closure.
* Make the developer experience good. A new engineer should be productive on day two.
* Set up data\-residency arrangements appropriate to Indian health data.
* Be the person who can tell, at 2 am, whether the problem is our service, the database, or the hospital's internet connection.


**Requirements**
* Four or more years on AWS in production, including ECS or equivalent container orchestration, RDS, IAM and VPC networking.
* Terraform written and maintained by you, with proper modules and state management.
* Ownership of a CI/CD pipeline, including the database migration step.
* Observability in practice: you have been on call, and you have tuned alerts that were too noisy.
* Linux and networking fundamentals — you can debug why a device inside a hospital cannot reach a service.


**Good to have**
* Compliance work: ISO 27001, SOC 2, or Indian health data regulation.
* On\-premise or hybrid deployments, and hardware appliances in the field.
* Real cost optimisation on a live bill.
* Experience supporting customers with unreliable connectivity.


**Your first 90 days**
* Month 1 — all environments live, CI/CD running, the walking skeleton deployed automatically.
* Month 2 — monitoring, alerting and centralised logs in place; backups running with a tested restore.
* Month 3 — the edge gateway image built and running against analyser simulators.


**How We Work**
 Two\-week sprints. Everything is code — infrastructure included. Code review on every pull request.

 Experience 10 years of proven program and project management experience with a successful track record delivering largescale complex programs multimillion dollar budget multiphase projects of 1 year duration on time and within budget13

c6aec82e.title: Technical Program Manager, Network Capacity Planning
c6aec82e.description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following:
 **Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Hyderabad, Telangana, India; Mumbai, Maharashtra, India** 
 .
 **Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in program management.
* 5 years of experience designing, constructing, or managing infrastructure projects.
* Experience creating infrastructure designs (e.g., telecom, electrical, mechanical), drawing sets for builds, and remodels of data center networking spaces.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Experience partnering with Data Science teams or directly leveraging machine learning and AI\-driven methodologies to scale forecasting models, automate anomaly detection, and simulate capacity scenarios.
* Experience in network capacity planning, demand forecasting, inventory optimization, or supply\-demand matching.
* Proficiency in data modeling, trend analysis, statistics, and data tools (e.g., SQL, spreadsheet software) to synthesize complex capacity metrics and performance loops.
* Strong foundational knowledge of network infrastructure concepts, including network routing, peering, cache infrastructure (CDN), or capacity placement.


**About The Job**
 A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.
   

  

 As a Network Capacity Planner, you will ensure Google Cloud’s growth by guaranteeing network capacity is delivered efficiently and on time to support products and customers. Operating across critical planning and execution horizons, you will blend a deep understanding of network fundamentals with machine learning and AI\-driven methodologies to scale forecasting, automate anomaly detection, and simulate complex capacity scenarios.
   

  

 Acting as a key technical collaborator alongside Technical Account Managers, Customer Engineers, and Product Managers, you will navigate customer requirements, mitigate supply stockouts, and manage inventory buffers. Your work will directly balance resource efficiency with high availability, safeguarding infrastructure performance and driving strategic demand attainment across the global network fleet.
   

  

 Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Leverage deep knowledge of network fundamentals to understand critical paths, skillfully navigate complex customer requirements, and co\-develop tailored solutions alongside Technical Account Managers, Customer Engineers, and Product Managers.
* Own the execution window, capturing large agreement requirements and navigating network lead times.
* Build forecasting models leveraging machine learning and AI to improve predictive accuracy, automate anomaly detection, and simulate capacity scenarios.
* Mitigate supplies shortages, maintain optimal inventory levels, manage policy\-based buffers, and plan for major peak traffic events.
* Collaborate to build AI\-assisted automation for ordering and resource fulfillment while designing metrics to track fleet efficiency and demand attainment.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

**Job Description**
**Program Manager (Technical)**
**Location:** 
 Bangalore (Domlur)
   

  

**Experience:** 
 10–15 Years
   

  

 We are looking for a highly technical, business\-orientated programme manager who can own complex software delivery from concept to production.
   

  

 This is not a traditional project coordination role. We need someone who takes complete ownership of delivery, works directly with customers, challenges requirements, manages risks, and drives cross\-functional teams to successful outcomes.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is comfortable working across Engineering, Product, QA, DevOps, Business, Operations, and Customer stakeholders while ensuring programs are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned to business objectives.
   

  

 Candidates from technology services organizations who have delivered enterprise software implementations in fast\-paced environments will be preferred.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**End\-to\-End Program Ownership**
* Own the complete Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) from requirement gathering to production release.
* Translate business requirements into actionable engineering workstreams.
* Drive planning, execution, testing, deployment, and post\-production support.
* Ensure successful delivery across multiple parallel initiatives.


**Stakeholder Management**
* Act as the bridge between customers, business teams, engineering, QA, DevOps, and operations.
* Build credibility with senior stakeholders and influence decisions without formal authority.
* Manage expectations, resolve conflicts, and drive alignment across functions.
* Escalate issues effectively while maintaining strong working relationships.


**Technical Program Management**
* Work closely with architects and engineering teams to understand technical dependencies.
* Review solution approaches with engineering.
* Understand APIs, cloud platforms, system integrations, databases, and enterprise architecture.
* Be hands\-on enough to install, configure, demo, and explain the product to customers when required.


**Delivery \& Governance**
* Drive program governance, planning, RAID management, dependency tracking, and release readiness.
* Monitor delivery milestones, risks, blockers, and resource planning.
* Lead steering committee meetings and executive status reviews.
* Ensure predictable and high\-quality execution.


**Business Ownership**
* Understand customer business problems instead of simply collecting requirements.
* Challenge unclear requirements and recommend better approaches.
* Balance technical feasibility with business priorities.
* Drive adoption and business outcomes after implementation.


**Required Skills**
* 10–15 years of experience in Program Management, Technical Program Management, or Enterprise Delivery.
* Strong understanding of Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC).
* Experience managing enterprise software implementation programs.
* Strong stakeholder management across Engineering, Product, QA, Business, and Customers.
* Excellent communication and executive presentation skills.
* Strong risk management, dependency management, and release planning experience.
* Ability to influence senior leadership across multiple functions.
* Comfortable working in fast\-paced, ambiguous startup environments.


**Technical Knowledge**
**Good Understanding Of**
* Cloud Platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP)
* APIs \& System Integrations
* Databases
* Enterprise Applications
* Agile / Scrum
* JIRA / Confluence
* Release Management
* DevOps concepts
* Software Architecture fundamentals


**Preferred Background**
* Services company experience is highly preferred.
* Experience managing enterprise software implementations.
* Experience in Retail, Insurance, BFSI, or Digital Transformation programs is a strong advantage.
* Candidates who started their career as Software Developers and transitioned into Program Management are highly preferred.
* Experience working with globally distributed teams is desirable.


**What We're Looking For**
 We are looking for someone who:
   

  

* Owns delivery end\-to\-end rather than simply coordinating tasks.
* Can confidently interact with CXOs and senior customer stakeholders.
* Thinks like a business owner, not just a project manager.
* Can challenge requirements when necessary.
* Handles multiple complex programs simultaneously.
* Is technically sound enough to earn the respect of engineering teams while keeping business objectives at the center of every decision.

* Email Security

* Cloud Security

Experience with technologies and solutions from:

* Palo Alto Networks
* Fortinet

* CrowdStrike
* Microsoft Security

* Trend Micro

* CEH

* Security\+
* CCNA / CCNP Security
* NSE Certification
* Palo Alto Certifications
* Microsoft Security Certifications

Required Skills

* Strong communication and presentation skills.
* Excellent customer handling and consulting abilities.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively with sales and technical teams.
* Experience in enterprise customer engagement is preferred.

Preferred Experience

* Experience working with System Integrators (SI), Value Added Resellers (VAR), or Managed Security Service Providers (MSSP).
* Exposure to enterprise and government security projects.
* Experience handling large\-scale cyber security deployments and tenders.

Compensation \& Benefits

* Career advancement opportunities

cb612f7c.description:
About This Role
**10 to 15 years of experience**  

**Skills: DevOps**

DevOps Architect — India


Location: India (Hybrid/Remote, overlap hours with US\-based Architect(s) and Delivery Lead)


Experience: 10\+ years overall, 6\+ years in DevOps/infrastructure architecture


Role Summary


The DevOps Architect owns CI/CD, environment, release, and infrastructure architecture across the account's delivery pods, ensuring every workstream can build, test, and ship reliably regardless of which technology stack is ultimately selected. This role designs the automation and quality gates that both human engineers and AI coding agents build against, and is accountable for the pipeline and infrastructure practices that keep an agent\-orchestrated development model safe and predictable in production.


Key Responsibilities


* Own CI/CD pipeline architecture, branching strategy, and release automation across all workstreams, repeatable per delivery pod.
* Own environment strategy: provisioning, configuration management, and refresh cadence for development, test, and staging environments across workstreams.
* Design automated quality gates (build, test, static analysis, security scanning) that apply consistently to both human\-written and AI\-agent\-generated code before it merges or deploys.
* Own infrastructure architecture, including cloud resource design, monitoring, logging, alerting, and reliability/SRE practices.
* Partner with the Principal Architect(s) to ensure DevOps and infrastructure decisions align with the overall solution architecture, once the technology stack is confirmed.
* Own release management practices — versioning, rollback procedures, deployment windows — sized to support the delivery cadence of an agent\-orchestrated build workflow.
* Direct and prompt AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code or equivalent) for infrastructure\-as\-code, pipeline configuration, and automation scripting, then review and harden the output.
* Own incident response and root\-cause analysis processes for production issues, driving remediation and preventive fixes.
* Own security and compliance practices for infrastructure — secrets management, access controls, and audit logging — in coordination with the client's security team.
* Evaluate and integrate new CI/CD, infrastructure, and AI/agentic tooling into the delivery model.
* Set and enforce DevOps standards and mentor DevOps engineers embedded within each workstream's delivery pod.

Required Qualifications


* 10\+ years in enterprise technology roles with 6\+ years specifically in DevOps or infrastructure architecture.
* Deep expertise in CI/CD tooling (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or similar) and Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar).
* Strong background in cloud platform architecture (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and monitoring/observability tooling.
* Experience designing environment and branching strategies for multi\-workstream delivery programs.
* Technology\-agnostic release management experience — comfortable integrating CI/CD with either platform\-specific deployment tooling (e.g., Salesforce release tools such as Copado/Gearset) or standard web\-application deployment pipelines, depending on final stack selection.
* Hands\-on experience directing or prompting AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code or an equivalent agentic development tool) — required, as this engagement uses an agent\-orchestrated development model.
* Security\-conscious approach to infrastructure design: secrets management, access control, and compliance awareness.

Preferred Qualifications


* Relevant certifications (e.g., AWS/Azure/GCP DevOps Engineer or Solutions Architect, Terraform Associate).
* Experience setting up quality gates or guardrails specifically for AI\-agent\-generated code.
* Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) background.

The SAP Solution Architect will support the SAP Platform Architect in delivering the Finance Systems roadmap whilst ensuring SAP solutions remain aligned to business priorities, enterprise architecture standards and operational support requirements.


The role will contribute to solution design, application configuration, integration design and continuous improvement activities, whilst helping to ensure the Finance platforms remain secure, reliable and fit for future business growth.

**Solution Design**

* Produce solution designs and technical documentation that align with enterprise architecture standards.

 **Integration**

* Support troubleshooting of integration issues and identify opportunities to improve performance and resilience.
* Ensure appropriate documentation is maintained for integrations and technical designs.

 **Product \& Change Delivery**

* Contribute to backlog refinement, solution estimation and technical planning.
* Work with Business Analysts to translate business requirements into solution designs.
* Support the successful delivery of projects, enhancements and continuous improvement initiatives.

 **Stakeholder Engagement**

* Participate in workshops with business stakeholders to understand requirements.
* Explain technical solutions in business\-friendly language.
* Work collaboratively across Architecture, Infrastructure, Security and Service Management teams.

 **Service Improvement**

* Contribute to root cause analysis for recurring issues.
* Support the development of standards, documentation and best practice.

**Qualifications**  

* Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science or related discipline (or equivalent experience).


SAP certifications in SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud, SAC, CIM or Concur would be advantageous but are not essential

 **Additional Information*** **Skills \& Experience**

9f3d8d8f.title: Solutions Architect (Java / Microservices / GenAI)
9f3d8d8f.description:
About This Role
**10 years of experience**  

**Skills: Solution Architecture, Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, REST APIs, GenAI, LLMs, RAG, React.js / Angular, AWS / Azure / GCP, System Design, Enterprise Solutioning, Domain\-Driven Design, Client Communication, Stakeholder Engagement**

**About the Role**
  

We are looking for a highly accomplished Solution Architect with 10\+ years of experience. You will lead the architecture and solutioning of complex, enterprise\-grade technology programmes for our clients; spanning Java\-based backend systems, modern frontend applications, microservices platforms, and cutting\-edge GenAI solutions.


This role demands not just technical depth but exceptional communication and client engagement skills. You will regularly interface with C\-suite executives, enterprise architects, and business leaders — translating complex technical concepts into clear, compelling narratives and actionable solution strategies. You will be the face of our technical practice to clients, and your ability to listen, articulate, influence, and inspire confidence will be as critical as your architecture expertise.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Lead end\-to\-end enterprise solution architecture — defining architectural vision, patterns, and standards across Java backend, frontend, microservices, and GenAI technology layers.
* Produce comprehensive architecture artefacts — solution designs, architecture decision records (ADRs), high\-level and low\-level design documents, data flow diagrams, and technical roadmaps.
* Architect and govern microservices\-based platforms — defining service decomposition strategies, API contracts, event\-driven communication patterns, and service mesh configurations.
* Design and integrate GenAI and LLM\-powered capabilities — including RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, and AI\-augmented features — into enterprise product architectures responsibly and at scale.
* Provide architectural oversight across frontend implementation — governing micro\-frontend strategies, component design systems, and API integration patterns using React.js, Angular, or equivalent.
* Lead enterprise product solutioning — conducting build vs buy analysis, vendor evaluation, technology selection, and total cost of ownership assessments aligned with business objectives.
* Define and enforce non\-functional requirements — scalability, resilience, performance, security, and compliance — across all solution designs and technical deliverables.
* Engage and present to senior stakeholders, including C\-suite, executive sponsors, and Architecture Review Boards — communicating complex technical concepts with clarity, confidence, and business relevance.
* Collaborate closely with Engineering Leads, Product Managers, Data Architects, DevOps teams, and Business Analysts to ensure architectural intent is understood and faithfully implemented.
* Champion cloud\-native architecture principles — designing solutions on AWS and / or Azure using infrastructure\-as\-code, containerisation, and serverless patterns.
* Establish and evolve architecture governance frameworks, review processes, and technical standards across the engineering organisation.
* Evaluate and adopt emerging technologies — GenAI, AI agents, edge computing, and platform engineering — to continuously advance the organisation's technology capability.
* Mentor and guide senior engineers and technical leads, growing architectural thinking and design capability across the engineering community.
* Support pre\-sales, RFP responses, and client\-facing solutioning activities where required.

**What We're Looking For**


* 10\+ years of experience in software engineering and solutions architecture, with a demonstrable track record of leading enterprise\-scale product solutioning from concept to delivery.


* Deep expertise in Java / Spring Boot and designing production\-grade, cloud\-native microservices architectures at scale.


* Proven experience architecting and delivering GenAI / LLM\-powered solutions — including RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, and responsible AI implementation.


* Strong architectural knowledge across frontend technologies — React.js, Angular, or equivalent — with the ability to govern frontend architecture and micro\-frontend patterns.


* Solid cloud architecture experience on AWS and / or Azure — designing scalable, secure, and cost\-optimised cloud\-native solutions.


* Expertise in system design fundamentals — distributed systems, event\-driven architecture, API\-first design, Domain\-Driven Design, and CQRS / Event Sourcing.


* Strong experience with enterprise product solutioning — requirements analysis, technology selection, vendor assessment, and architecture roadmap development.


* Exceptional communication and presentation skills — proven ability to engage, influence, and align C\-suite executives, senior stakeholders, and cross\-functional delivery teams.


* Experience contributing to or leading Architecture Review Boards (ARBs) and governance processes across large technology organisations.


* Strong understanding of security architecture — OAuth2, Zero Trust, IAM — and regulatory compliance frameworks including GDPR.


* Demonstrated ability to mentor senior engineers and instil architectural thinking and engineering excellence across delivery teams.


**Nice to Have**


* TOGAF 9 / 10 certification or equivalent enterprise architecture framework knowledge.
* Experience with multi\-cloud or hybrid cloud architecture strategies.
* Exposure to platform engineering and internal developer platform (IDP) design.
* Familiarity with graph databases (Neo4j, Neptune) for knowledge graph and Graph RAG use cases.
* Experience with edge AI, model compression, or on\-device AI deployment.
* Pre\-sales or client\-facing solutioning experience in a consulting or product organisation.
* AWS Solutions Architect Professional / Azure Solutions Architect Expert certification.
* Experience delivering architecture in regulated industries — Financial Services, Insurance, Healthcare, or equivalent.
* Knowledge of FinOps principles and cloud cost governance frameworks.

 Airtel Africa is committed to enabling possibilities through innovative solutions. Our mission is to connect people and ideas by building advanced systems that enhance the quality of life for millions across more than 14 countries.

* AADL serves 14 Airtel entities (OpCos) across African continent. In other words, there are 14 large customers for AADL
* Common Products: AADL builds common products that are deployed at each of these 14 entities

 : Manage delivery of new platforms and products, including feature enhancement for deployed solutions. The coding, implementation etc is taken care of by respective engineering teams within AADL. Any new enhancement or product involves deliveries from one or more engineering teams. This role requires planning, tracking with the engineering teams and presenting updates to the stakeholders within and outside engineering

 with respective Product Managers and Product Owners

 tracking, governance and MIS

* Facilitate alignment and communication between engineering, business, and local OpCo teams to achieve project objectives.

 : Apply domain expertise and analytical acumen to support successful feature deployment and adoption.

 and mitigation: Anticipate and mitigate project risks through proactive solution development.

 : Continuously enhance software development processes and team productivity.

* Promoting a collaborative team culture conducive to effective communication and strong working relationships.



**Core Competencies** 



* Exceptional Project Management capabilities.
* Understanding of Agile and SaFE methodologies.
* Previous experience in Tech Product or Engineering Management is advantageous.
* Proven ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders across different regions.

27273e9b.title: Staff Program Manager
27273e9b.description:
From Fivetran's founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We're proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data\-driven.
   

  

**About Us**
 Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry\-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.
   

  

 Together, we're delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.
   

  

 Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.
   

  

 As we bring our teams and technology together, we're building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It's an exciting time to join us: we're creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.
   

  

 During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.
   

  

**About the Role**
 We're looking for a Staff Program Manager for our Engineering Operations team to help us reach our goals and make our Engineering team the best it can be!
   

  

 The mission for the Staff Program Manager, Engineering Operations, is to maintain and accelerate the highest level of execution excellence of Fivetran engineering. Our Engineering organization comprises several global functional groups that use a range of processes, systems, tools, and KPIs to jointly deliver best\-in\-class data pipelines and drive innovation.
   

  

 The role focuses on increasing the efficiency and effectiveness of one or more of our Engineering functions in delivering our strategic objectives by streamlining engineering processes and leading major initiatives, such as process and efficiency improvement projects \& programs.
   

  

 As the majority of the processes are in the software development industry, the role assumes you have broad experience in software development and have led multiple programs that shipped software from start to finish. You have worked closely with cross\-functional teams with design, research, product, and engineering. Preferably, you work at a tech company and are heavily involved in engineering operations, with a deep understanding of how engineering processes work under the hood and how to take them to the next level.
   

  

 We want you to bring your passion for problem\-solving, experience in the tech world, and the drive to help us get to the next level, and have some fun along the way.
   

  

 This is a full\-time position based out of our Bengaluru office.
   

  

**Technologies You'll Use**
* Jira, Google Workspace, Notion, Claude Cowork/Code, Slack, Lucidchart, Looker, BigQuery, ChatGPT/codex


**What You'll Do**
* Ensure operations and strategy execution work seamlessly and effectively, and streamline engineering processes so they are simple, value\-oriented, and scalable.
* Oversee operations for your respective global group, with a particular focus on increasing efficiency, stability, and effectiveness in delivering their strategic objectives.
* Act as a strategic partner for the global group leader regarding short and long\-term vision, planning (quarterly and annual), and execution, as well as establishing and tracking engineering OKRs and KPIs. All this with consistent alignment with engineering\-wide policies and practices.
* Maintain the engineering process library and improve it in collaboration with process owners, other operations managers, the PMO, engineering leadership, and leadership of partnering departments such as Product, Analytics, and Design.
* Lead and manage process and efficiency improvement programs aiming to set up or improve engineering and cross\-departmental processes, from problem definition and data analysis through solution proposal, stakeholder alignment, and execution — resulting in documented, repeatable, and measurable processes.
* Collaborate and openly debate with the team of operations managers to manage engineering initiatives, solve problems, discuss challenges, and learn more about critical issues as a group of Engineering Operations.
* Work with Engineering teams to ensure adherence to operational processes, conduct process audits and check\-ins, and discuss opportunities for improvement with senior engineers and engineering leadership, identifying opportunities to optimize and automate routine operations.
* Provide leadership, improvement, and support of our internal knowledge management process and information structure in collaboration with PMO, technical enablement teams, and technical writers.
* Support the coordination, preparation, and delivery of company\-wide engineering updates and events.
* Act as a role model and a champion for operational excellence, project management practices, risk management, and security practices.


**Skills We're Looking For**
* 10\+ years of experience in technical/operations management in the technology/software development industry.
* Ability to work directly with senior leadership on strategic programs, including leading cross\-functional R\&D initiatives from start to finish.
* Comfortable navigating ambiguity, working independently, and problem\-solving within fast\-paced and constantly changing environments.
* Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills with the ability to interact and collaborate with technical and non\-technical groups at all levels.
* A data\-driven and action\-oriented mindset with excellent planning, analytical, problem\-solving, project/program management, organizational, and leadership skills.
* Ability to identify and meet with key players and stakeholders to shape consensus collectively and engage in dialogue to reach a conclusion, compromising as necessary for results.
* You are fearless, goal\-focused, and pragmatic, and you understand the complexity of working with a multitude of different teams and people.
* You are recognized as a go\-to expert in one or more engineering operations domains (e.g., System Design, Data Architecture, Infrastructure Management, including cost management, Quality) and use that expertise to drive innovation in how your global group approaches them \- not just facilitate conversations, but shape and influence the technical direction of SDLC and process decisions.
* Stays current on industry trends and business developments relevant to engineering operations, and applies that context to inform recommendations and decisions.
* Ability to leverage AI to increase your own productivity and leverage it in the solutions you're building.


**(Optional)Bonus Skills**
* Experience driving projects end\-to\-end, and shipping complex, large\-scale software projects with global teams utilizing different SDLCs.
* Familiarity with project management tools like Jira, knowledge management tools like Notion, and analytical tools like Looker and Sigma.
* Experience working with cloud platforms and SaaS companies is a plus.
* Familiarity with the following technologies is a plus: Cloud service providers (AWS, GCP, Azure), ETL or ELT, modern data stack.


**Perks and Benefits**
* 100% employer\-paid medical insurance\*
* Generous paid time\-off policy (PTO), plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave policy, holidays (including a year end Global Week of Rest), and volunteer days off
* RSU stock grants\*
* Professional development and training opportunities
* Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team\-building activities
* Monthly cell phone stipend
* Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self\-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents.
* May vary by country and worker type \- please reach out to your recruiter for more information


*Click here to learn more about Fivetran's Benefits by Region.*
 We're honored to be valued at over $5\.6 billion, but more importantly, we're proud of our core values of Get Stuck In, Do the Right Thing, and One Team, One Dream. Read about us in Forbes.
   

  

 Fivetran brings together high\-quality talent across the globe to make data access as easy and reliable as electricity for our customers. We value and recognize that our customers benefit from having innovative teams made of people from many backgrounds, experiences, and identities. Fivetran promotes diversity, equity, inclusion \& belonging through attracting, recruiting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce, not only because it is the right thing to do, but because it helps us build a world\-class company to better serve our customers, our people and our communities.
   

  

 To learn more about Fivetran's culture and what it's like to be part of the team, click here and enjoy our video.
   

  

 To learn more about our candidate privacy policy, you can read our statement here.
   

  

*We are committed to ensuring that all candidates have an equal opportunity to participate in our interview process. If you require accommodations at any stage of the process due to a disability, medical condition, or any other circumstance, please don't hesitate to submit your request by filling out this form. We will work with you to provide reasonable accommodations to facilitate your participation and ensure a fair and accessible interview experience. Your request and any information provided will be kept confidential and will not impact your candidacy. We look forward to hearing from you and accommodating your needs to the best of our ability.*

9dbd239c.title: Program Manager
9dbd239c.description:
Be a part of our mission! As a world leader in creating comfortable, sustainable, and efficient climate solutions for buildings, homes and transportation, it's our responsibility to put the planet first. For us at Trane Technologies, and through our businesses including Trane® and Thermo King, sustainability is not just how we do business—it is our business. Do you dare to look at the world's challenges and see impactful possibilities? Do you want to contribute to making a better future? If the answer is yes, we invite you to consider joining us in boldly challenging what's possible for a sustainable world.
   

  

 Learn about our benefits designed for you to Thrive at work and at home.
   

  

 We boldly go.
   

  

**Where Is The Work**
 Monday to Thursday, work onsite with your colleagues. Fridays, choose your work location, balancing what your work requires.
   

  

**Program Manager**
 At Trane Technologies we Challenge Possible. Our brands – including Trane® and Thermo King® \- create access to cooling and comfort in buildings and homes, transport and protect food and perishables, connect customers to elevated performance with less environmental impact, dramatically reduce energy demands and carbon emissions, and innovate with a better world in mind. We boldly challenge what’s possible for a sustainable world.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 The Program Manager will manage complex projects or phases of a project to ensure the completion of milestones within budget, tracks performance and progress of project against committed timeline. Projects could be Manufacturing Automation, NPD, NTP, Productivity, RTS or QR type. This role calls for collaboration with multiple global plants, ETC teams, cross functional, external vendors \& multi\-location teams to ensure that the projects are accomplished to a high quality, adhering to our standard processes, systems and project management principles, while remaining aligned with strategy and goals of the organization. The Program Manager will also manage project portfolio/project agreements of the respective ETC teams. Resolves unique problems that could occur during the project to minimize delays \& provide timely status updates to the executive leadership team.
   

  

**Core Job Responsibilities**
* Fulfill the role of the Program Manager and all that it entails
* Understand project requirements, collaborate with project owners, leaders, various plants \& cross functional teams across the globe for delivery of projects, by adhering to standard processes, systems and project management principles.
* Ensure the completion of project milestones/deliverables within committed Quality (Q), Delivery (D), Project cost (C) \& Product cost (C), track performance and progress of project against committed QDC targets
* Adhere to general project management principles of Project scope management, time management, cost management, risk management, vendor / procurement management, and stakeholder management
* Lead/Assist Annual Operating Planning (AOP) discussions with respective SBUs/NOEs and corporate teams
* Report out project updates, risks and mitigations, productivity updates, QDC metrics, deployment efficiency, timesheet data, during the monthly Operations review meeting with ETC leadership team
* Lead International shipment process (air/sea) ensuring Import \& Export Trade compliance adhered.
* Collaborate with PMO team members to continuously improve process, systems and develop/refine standard works
* Project management of Strategic organization initiatives, deployment of BOS and coaching project teams
* Manage Engineering and Technology Center(ETC) project portfolio / Project agreements of respective teams and publish the monthly billing data for the respective teams
* Host monthly calibration meetings and publish monthly QDC metrics for the respective teams


**Key Competencies**
* Expertise in project management (Waterfall Model with Manufacturing background)Proven leadership, coaching and mentoring skills with exceptional attention to detailSelf\-starter with a desire to make a significant impact on the product development process Ability to drive program specific goals and actions to closureDevelops and manages projects budgets, schedules \& timelinesDemonstrated ability to work with all levels of management Understands the impact of a project to the overall businessLeads from the front, coaches project team members, takes initiative and effects change.Being bold and Courageous to raise issues to Senior Leadership Demonstrate patience during challenging circumstancesExcellent written and oral communication and facilitation skillsGood Interpersonal skills. Ability to learn and collaborate with cross cultural project teamsExceptional Influencing skills as project team members will not be one’s direct reports Manages \& resolves conflictsProficiency in MS projectExposure to JIRA / Confluence is beneficial undefinedMinimum Qualifications:4\-year degree from an accredited institution. Technical degree in Mechanical Engineering or Electrical Engineering preferred12\+ years’ experience of overall functional experiencePMP certified project management professional with 8\+ yrs. of Project managementundefinedundefined


**Why You Should Join Us**
* You should join us if you like a collaborative yet challenging team environment that directly drives business value for Trane’s customers and Trane through creating software and services that globally impact how buildings are turned into competitive advantages based on individual customer’s needs.
