d82845ee.description:
Bei Roche kannst du ganz du selbst sein und wirst für deine einzigartigen Qualitäten geschätzt. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen. Hier wirst du für das, was du bist, wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert. Dies schafft ein Umfeld, in dem du sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich wachsen kannst. Gemeinsam wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und in Zukunft. Werde Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.
  
  

Die Position
  
  

Job description
  
The SAP GBT (Global Batch Tracing) Solution Consultant leads complex ERP solution delivery, proactively solves product issues, and contributes to architecture. In this role, you will be the architect of our product genealogy, ensuring seamless end\-to\-end traceability across our complex global network. You will design, implement, and optimize SAP GBT solutions that allow Roche to respond with agility to regulatory requirements and quality events, ensuring our life\-saving medicines reach patients with uncompromised integrity.
  
  

Key Job Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead functional design, configuration, and implementation activities for SAP GBT solutions across manufacturing and supply chain operations.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into scalable SAP solutions.
* Configure and support SAP modules related to batch traceability, inventory management, warehouse management, procurement, and manufacturing integration.
* Support end\-to\-end batch genealogy, recall management, and product traceability processes.
* Ensure compliance with pharmaceutical industry regulations including FDA, GxP, DSCSA, and global serialization requirements.
* Conduct fit\-gap analysis, solution workshops, and process mapping sessions.
* Develop functional specifications and coordinate with technical teams for custom developments and integrations.
* Participate in testing activities including SIT, UAT, regression testing, and validation documentation.
* Provide production support, issue resolution, and continuous process improvement recommendations.
* Support data migration, cutover planning, and hypercare activities during deployments.
* Create user training materials and conduct knowledge transfer sessions for business users.


**Required Qualifications:**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, or related field.
* 7\+ years of SAP functional consulting experience with at least 3 years focused on SAP GBT or batch traceability solutions. including full\-cycle implementations.
* Strong experience with SAP ECC and/or SAP S/4HANA environments.
* Hands\-on expertise in SAP modules such as PP, SD, MM, QM.
* Experience with SAP WM/EWM and ATTP is highly preferred.
* Experience working in the pharmaceutical, biotech, or life sciences industry.
* Strong understanding of regulated manufacturing and compliance requirements.
* Experience with serialization, batch management, and product recall processes.
* Experience withSAP IDocs, ALE, and RFC for data transfer between multiple SAP and non\-SAP instances.
* Ability to lead workshops and communicate effectively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Experience working in global delivery or matrixed environments.


**Preferred Qualifications:**  

* SAP certification in relevant logistics or supply chain modules.
* Experience with SAP ATTP, SAP ICH, or other traceability and compliance platforms.
* Familiarity with validation processes and CSV documentation in regulated environments.
* Knowledge of Agile and SAP Activate methodologies.
* Experience integrating SAP with MES, LIMS, or third\-party warehouse systems.


Additional Qualifications
  
  

* Strong collaboration and inclusion mindset, capable of resolving conflicts at the team level and fostering effective teamwork across project work\-streams.
* High level of self\-direction and initiative, with the ability and willingness to learn in a self\-directed fashion to stay informed on new technologies and concepts.

fef10417.title: GN-I&E-Public Servies -Data Architect and Gov- Manager
fef10417.description:
**Public Services –** **Data Governance \- Consultant**

**Role Details**

* **Skill/Industry Group:** Public Services (PS) – Data Governance Support
* **Level:** Consultant
* **Location:** Gurugram/Bengaluru/Mumbai
* **Travel Requirement:** 0–100% (as per client/project needs)

**About the Practice**


The **Public Service (PS) team** is one of the industry programs within Accenture’s Global Network, under **Accenture Strategy \& Consulting**. Our practitioners bring the right blend of strategic and operational expertise to help clients solve their most critical challenges and deliver maximum stakeholder value.


The Public Service industry group spans the following sub\-sectors:

* Border services
* Cities, Transport \& Infrastructure
* Defense
* Education
* Non\-profit
* Post \& Parcel
* Public Health
* Public Safety
* Revenue
* Social Services

**Principal Duties and Responsibilities**


As a Consultant in Data Governance Support, you will play a key role in designing and implementing data governance frameworks to ensure data quality, integrity, and compliance across transformation programmes. You will work closely with business and technology teams to enable effective data management, analysis, and migration.

* **Data Governance Framework Design:**
	+ Conduct structured discovery interviews and workshops with a broad stakeholder group to baseline the current state of data governance, data quality, stewardship, and data management processes.
	+ Support the design and implementation of data governance frameworks, including policies, standards, roles, and processes.
	+ Develop and validate RACI matrices to individual job title level across multiple master data domains, facilitating workshops with data owners and stewards to confirm and refine accountability.
	+ Support the translation of the client's data strategy into an actionable implementation roadmap, sequenced against programme milestones and organisational dependencies.
	+ Contribute to benefits identification and success metric definition for the data governance and management programme.
* **Data Migration Planning:** Provide advisory support on the data migration approach, including review of data readiness, migration sequencing, parallel running governance, and pre\-migration quality gates.
* **Stakeholder Collaboration:** Work with business, IT, and data owners to define data requirements, governance structures, and ownership models.
* **Compliance \& Controls:** Ensure adherence to data governance standards, regulatory requirements, and internal policies.
* **Documentation \& Reporting:** Develop and maintain governance documentation, data dictionaries, and reporting artifacts to support transparency and control.

**Industry/ Functional Skills (Preferred)**

* Understanding of data governance principles, data quality management, and data lifecycle processes.
* Understanding of master data management concepts — data lifecycle, system of record, duplicate management, and reference data governance.
* CDMP Associate certification or active pursuit of CDMP is advantageous but not required.
* Knowledge of data migration concepts including mapping, cleansing, validation, and reconciliation.
* Ability to work with cross\-functional stakeholders to define and enforce data standards.
* Strong documentation, problem\-solving, and communication skills.

**What this role is not**


This is a governance consulting role, not a data engineering or technical data management role. The following skills are explicitly not required and should not be considered selection criteria:

* SQL query writing or database administration
* ETL tool development or data pipeline engineering
* Data science, machine learning, or statistical modelling
* Hands\-on configuration of Oracle ERP, Salesforce, or other enterprise platforms
* Data architecture design or enterprise solution architecture


Candidates with a pure technology background and no consulting or governance framework experience are unlikely to be a strong fit. Candidates with a consulting background who have supported data governance or data management engagements — even without deep technical data skills — are the primary target profile for this role.

**About Accenture**


Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps businesses, governments, and other organizations build their digital core, optimize operations, and accelerate growth. With approximately 791,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries, Accenture brings deep industry expertise together with capabilities across Strategy \& Consulting, Technology, Operations, Industry X, and Song. Its global footprint spans offices and operations in 52 countries and 200\+ cities, underpinned by a connected network of innovation hubs and a worldwide system of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations Centers that scale delivery across markets. Leveraging strong ecosystem partnerships—and leadership in cloud, data, and AI—Accenture delivers measurable value at speed and at scale


  

**Qualifications**

* MBA from a Tier 1 institution or Master’s degree in a relevant discipline

**Experience Requirements**

* 3–7 years of relevant experience in consulting, data governance, data management, or related roles.
* Experience supporting or implementing data governance frameworks and data management practices.
* Experience producing high\-quality written deliverables — frameworks, policies, operating models, presentations — to a standard suitable for executive audiences.
* Familiarity with data governance tools, frameworks, or platforms is desirable.

**Meet Our Team**
 Pegasystems is seeking a Lead Cloud Delivery Specialist (LCDS) to play a key hands ‑ on leadership role within the Cloud Acceleration Group (CAG). This is a senior, client ‑ facing position responsible for leading complex cloud implementations, supporting successful client outcomes on Pega Cloud, and contributing to the continuous improvement of Pega’s cloud delivery practices.
   

  

 As a Lead, you will act as a trusted technical partner to clients, a go ‑ to escalation point within delivery teams, and a strong collaborator with Consulting, Cloud Advisory, and Client Success . This role is delivery ‑ focused and impact ‑ driven, balancing process\-oriented execution excellence with thoughtful guidance and mentoring.
   

  

**Picture Yourself At Pega**
**Pega is changing the way the world builds software.**
 In this role, you work closely with clients and internal teams to deliver reliable, high ‑ quality cloud transformations. You’ll lead complex migrations and upgrades, help resolve challenging technical issues, and ensure environments are stable, secure, and production ‑ ready. As a Lead, you focus on strong execution while contributing to delivery best practices and supporting the growth of other Cloud Delivery Specialists.
   

  

 At Pega, we actively explore and embrace emerging AI capabilities with curiosity, responsibility, and a drive for meaningful innovation. You will work in an environment where AI\-enabled tools are used to enhance learning, improve engineering efficiency and support better decision\-making across the cloud platform.
   

  

 We expect professionals to apply critical thinking to all AI\-generated outputs, validating accuracy, quality, and relevance before applying them in production environments. We view AI maturity as a spectrum, progressing from foundational adoption toward more strategic, advocacy\-driven integration, and you will play an active role in that journey.
   

  

**What You'll Do At Pega**
**Client Transformation \& Technical Leadership**
* Lead complex client transformations, including legacy modernization and on ‑ prem ‑ to ‑ cloud migrations.
* Serve as a key escalation point for multi ‑ domain technical issues within cloud delivery engagements.
* Ensure environment readiness across development, test, and production.


**Delivery Execution \& Collaboration**
* Partner with client and internal stakeholders to align on scope, priorities, and success criteria.
* Execute delivery plans while balancing immediate client needs with long ‑ term platform health.


**Issue Resolution \& Operational Excellence**
* Drive resolution of high ‑ severity issues by coordinating with engineering, product, support, and cloud operations teams.
* Ensure timely diagnosis, recovery, and clear communication during incidents.
* Use monitoring and diagnostic tools (e.g., PDC) to identify recurring issues and support reliability improvements.


**Process, Quality \& Continuous Improvement**
* Apply established best practices, patterns, and standards for cloud delivery engagements.
* Capture client feedback and share insights with Product and Engineering.
* Mentor and support Cloud Delivery Specialists, helping build technical depth and delivery consistency.


**Who You Are**
**You are an experienced Pega cloud delivery professional** 
 with strong technical skills and a client ‑ centric mindset. You communicate clearly, operate effectively in complex environments, and take ownership of outcomes. You bring sound judgment, collaborative instincts, and a commitment to quality delivery and client success.
   

  

**What You've Accomplished**
**Required Experience \& Qualifications**
* 8\-12 years of relevant Pega experience , including experience in cloud delivery, technical consulting, or implementation roles.
* Strong Pega platform knowledge is a huge plus with ideally a CLSA, or a CSSA

About Lighthouse Communities Foundation

Lighthouse Communities Foundation (LCF) works to create pathways to **education, skilling, employment, and sustainable livelihoods for underserved youth**.

Through a pioneering Public\-Private Partnership (PPP) model, LCF brings together **Government, Corporates, NGOs, and Citizens** to create opportunities and enable socio\-economic transformation.

Our Lighthouse centres are supported through partnerships with government and corporate CSR stakeholders, while NGOs bring expertise in education and skilling to create meaningful opportunities for young people.

**Lighthouse Kiran** focuses on helping adolescents develop the skills, confidence, and agency needed to make informed decisions about their education, personal development, and future livelihoods.

The program focuses strongly on **Social and Emotional Learning (SEL)** and aims to create learning environments where adolescents feel secure, supported, and empowered to take ownership of their learning.

Through SEL, teacher capacity building, improved learning environments, and stronger educational engagement, Lighthouse Kiran seeks to:

* Strengthen adolescents' core competencies and agency.
* Develop self\-learning, creativity, and decision\-making skills.
* Support positive academic and social development.
* Reduce school dropout rates.
* Improve students' preparedness for future education and livelihoods.

The role will involve managing program implementation across **Pune, Pimpri Chinchwad, Hyderabad, Odisha, and Thane**, as well as supporting expansion into tribal locations and other geographies.

The ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in **education program management, Social Emotional Learning, teacher development, stakeholder engagement, impact measurement, and team leadership**.

The role requires the ability to work closely with schools, government departments, teachers, community stakeholders, donors, and internal teams to ensure high\-quality implementation and measurable outcomes.

* Track key program indicators and identify trends, gaps, and opportunities for improvement.
* Generate actionable insights and recommendations for continuous program improvement.
* Prepare impact reports and present findings to internal teams, donors, government stakeholders, and partners.

3\. Teacher Capacity Building

Design, coordinate, and facilitate capacity\-building initiatives for:

* Primary and secondary school teachers.
* Headmasters/Headmistresses.
* School leaders and other education stakeholders.

Key areas may include:

* Social Emotional Learning (SEL).
* Assessment for Learning.
* Positive School Climate.
* Adolescent development and well\-being.

* Pune Municipal Corporation (PMC).

* Ward\-level officers and supervisors.
* School leaders and teachers.
* Institutional and implementation partners.

Responsibilities include:

* Coordinating operational planning and implementation.
* Supporting scheduling, onboarding, and program rollout.

* Monitor team productivity and address operational challenges.
* Ensure adherence to organizational policies and processes.
* Support recruitment, onboarding, and retention of high\-quality talent.
* Facilitate regular team meetings, implementation reviews, and cross\-functional coordination.

**Required Qualifications \& Experience**

SSAs craft scalable, flexible, and resilient technical architectures that address those challenges. This might involve guiding customers as they refactor an application or design an entirely new cloud\-based system.

As domain experts, SSAs also participate in field engagement and enablement, producing content such as whitepapers, blogs, and workshops for customers, partners, and the AWS Technical Field.
   

  

 This role focuses on converting AI ambition into programs that can be delivered, operated, and scaled in production environments.

**Role Description**
 Solution Architect II – Enterprise Solutions Who We Look For We are looking for a Senior Solution Architect to raise backend engineering quality across delivery teams through daily hands\-on contribution, technical leadership, mentoring, and architectural execution. This is a senior hands\-on role, not people management—your influence comes from your code, design judgment, code reviews, and ability to mentor engineers toward production\-ready backend systems. You will guide backend implementation across teams, ensuring architecture becomes clean, maintainable, testable, observable, and scalable software—staying close to the code every day and setting a high bar for production readiness. The role suits someone combining excellent Java and Spring Boot skills with strong distributed\-systems understanding—building services that survive real production conditions. Technical leadership here means working in the details, not producing diagrams alone. In an AI\-assisted development environment, you apply engineering judgment to validate, refine, and sometimes reject generated output, ensuring it still meets strict standards for correctness, resilience, testability, security, and maintainability. We value a merit\-based culture where leads challenge weak designs, simplify complexity, and drive strong engineering practices. What You Will Do Provide hands\-on technical leadership for backend engineering across one or more delivery teams—writing production Java/Spring Boot code while guiding engineers through design, implementation, testing, review, and production readiness. Translate platform architecture and product requirements into well\-designed backend services, APIs, event\-driven components, integrations, and reusable engineering patterns. Review code daily, using reviews to improve correctness, maintainability, design quality, testing, observability, and engineering discipline. Mentor engineers through pairing, design discussions, debugging sessions, and refactoring work. Guide RESTful API design, asynchronous/event\-driven flows, data access layers, service boundaries, error handling, and operational controls. Guide distributed\-systems concerns: consistency, retries, idempotency, concurrency, transaction boundaries, backpressure, resilience, failure isolation, and performance under load. Define and promote testing strategies—unit, integration, contract, component, API, performance, and production validation. Identify and remove technical debt, weak abstractions, poor service boundaries, and fragile integrations. Support production readiness: observable, secure, scalable, resilient, deployable, diagnosable, and maintainable systems. Collaborate with architects, platform, QA, DevOps, product, and client\-facing delivery teams so speed never compromises engineering quality. Raise the engineering standard via reusable examples, reference implementations, coding guidelines, review checklists, and technical documentation. Reporting Line and Role Context This role reports directly to the CTO of UST FinX. You will act as one of the CTO’s senior technical lieutenants—creating engineering leverage while remaining deeply hands\-on: influencing multiple pods, establishing reusable standards, mentoring technical leaders, challenging weak designs, and turning technical direction into production\-quality execution. This is neither a passive advisory role nor traditional people management; your authority comes from technical credibility, judgment, and the ability to make other engineers better. As a force multiplier, you work with the CTO to define standards, identify engineering gaps, raise delivery quality, and ensure architecture is reflected in real code, platforms, and operational behavior across UST FinX. Skills and Experience We Are Looking For Minimum 8 years of professional backend engineering (ideally 10–12\), with meaningful hands\-on ownership of production backend systems. Excellent modern Java: language features, concurrency, collections, error handling, performance, modularity, and maintainable code design. Strong Spring Boot and broader Spring ecosystem: REST APIs, dependency injection, configuration, security, data access, testing, observability, and deployment. Strong distributed systems: latency, partial failure, retries, idempotency, consistency, concurrency, transaction boundaries, backpressure, and operational failure modes. Event\-driven architecture: producers, consumers, event contracts, schema evolution, async processing, replay, retries, dead\-letter handling, and eventual consistency. API design: RESTful design, versioning, validation, error models, pagination, security, documentation, and consumer\-oriented contract discipline. Testing strategies: unit, integration, contract, and component testing, test data management, mocking boundaries, and automated regression protection. Performance tuning: profiling, query optimization, JVM behavior, memory, threads, connection pools, serialization, caching, and high\-throughput behavior. Cloud\-native backend systems, preferably on AWS or equivalent: containers, managed services, CI/CD, observability, and automated deployment. Extensive code review: identifying design flaws, correctness, maintainability, security, performance, and operational risks, plus missing tests. Architecture executed through working code, strong service boundaries, and reusable patterns. Mentoring that raises standards without friction; clear communication of decisions, trade\-offs, and risks to distributed teams. Comfortable in a global, distributed organization with multiple pods, stakeholders, and time zones. Preferred Qualifications Financial services, banking, payments, lending, servicing, compliance, or regulated enterprise environments. Kafka, Redpanda, or equivalent messaging and event\-streaming platforms. Kubernetes and cloud\-native deployment: containerized workloads, autoscaling, service discovery, configuration management, and runtime operations. Observability stacks: Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, structured logging, and ing. Database design and tuning across relational and non\-relational systems: schema, indexing, transactions, and query performance. CI/CD, automated quality gates, static analysis, dependency scanning, deployment automation, and zero\-downtime practices. Domain\-driven design, clean and hexagonal architecture, modular monoliths, microservices, and service decomposition. Reusable backend frameworks, shared libraries, platform components, and reference implementations consumed by multiple teams. Security\-aware development: authentication, authorization, OAuth2/OIDC, secrets handling, input validation, auditability, and least\-privilege design. Large, complex, evolving codebases where maintainability and refactoring discipline matter—living with the long\-term consequences of engineering decisions: supporting, debugging, scaling, migrating, and evolving critical production systems.
   

  

**Skills**
 Code Review, Distributed Systems, Domain\-Driven Design, Java, Kubernetes, Microservices, Observability, OpenTelemetry, Performance Tuning, Event\-Driven Architecture, REST

dadac6c0.description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**


Lead Product Manager Technical (Dispute Lifecycle Solutions)
Job Title  

  

Lead Product Manager Technical (Dispute Lifecycle Solutions)  

  

Overview  

Who is Mastercard  

  

Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. We work to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart and accessible.  

  

Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.  

  

Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.  

  

Overview  

  

As a Lead Product Manager Technical within the Dispute Lifecycle Program, you will be responsible for driving the definition, prioritization, and delivery of dispute management capabilities supporting regional and global dispute processing needs.  

  

This role partners closely with Regional Product teams, Business Owners, Operations, Engineering, UX, and Architecture teams to translate business and regulatory requirements into scalable platform capabilities delivered through the Mastercard Dispute Resolution platform.  

  

The ideal candidate is passionate about solving complex business problems, navigating stakeholder needs across multiple regions, and converting strategic objectives into clear, actionable product requirements that enable successful delivery across multiple Scrum teams.  

  

Role:  

  

This position is a member of the Dispute Lifecycle EngineeringTeam.  

  

Partner with regional product and business stakeholders to understand dispute processing requirements, regulatory obligations, operational challenges, and market\-specific needs.  

Translate regional solution requirements into product initiatives, epics, features, user stories, business rules, and acceptance criteria.  

Own and maintain the product backlog for assigned Dispute Lifecycle capabilities, ensuring priorities align with product strategy and business value.  

Collaborate with UX, Engineering, and Architecture teams to define scalable user experiences and platform solutions that support global and regional dispute workflows.  

Lead requirements workshops, solution review sessions, and cross\-functional discussions to drive clarity and stakeholder alignment.  

Document complex workflows, state transitions, operational processes, and business rules to ensure implementation readiness.  

Drive prioritization and trade\-off decisions balancing customer value, compliance, operational efficiency, technical feasibility, and delivery commitments.  

Work closely with Engineering teams to support solution design, estimation, planning, dependency management, and release readiness activities.  

Coordinate with regional teams to identify opportunities for standardization and reuse while accommodating market\-specific requirements.  

Monitor delivery progress, manage risks and dependencies, and proactively communicate impacts and mitigation plans to stakeholders.  

Partner with Operations and Business teams to validate delivered solutions and measure business outcomes.  

Ensure proposed solutions satisfy Mastercard security, compliance, regulatory, and data privacy requirements.  

Support modernization initiatives including workflow automation, API\-based integrations, intelligent decisioning, and AI\-enabled dispute management capabilities.  

All About You:  

Strong experience in Product Management, Product Ownership, Business Analysis, or Technical Product Management within enterprise platforms.  

Demonstrated ability to gather, analyse, and translate complex business requirements into scalable product solutions.  

Experience working directly with business stakeholders, operations teams, and technology organizations to deliver customer\-focused products.  

Proven ability to manage competing priorities and drive alignment across geographically distributed teams and stakeholders.  

Strong knowledge of product management practices including roadmap planning, backlog management, prioritization, and Agile delivery.  

Ability to understand technical architectures and effectively collaborate with engineers and architects on solution design and implementation approaches.  

Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills.  

Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence outcomes across all organizational levels.  

High\-energy, detail\-oriented, and self\-motivated with a demonstrated ability to drive initiatives from concept through delivery.  

Experience documenting business processes, workflow models, decision trees, and user journeys.  

Familiarity with product governance processes including architecture reviews, privacy reviews, risk assessments, and release readiness activities.  

Preferred Qualifications:  

Experience in payments, dispute processing, chargebacks, fraud, claims management, case management, or financial services platforms.  

Experience working with regional or global product organizations supporting multiple markets.  

Familiarity with modern platform architectures, APIs, cloud\-native solutions, and workflow\-based applications.  

Experience collaborating with UX teams to deliver intuitive operational and customer\-facing experiences.  

Strong understanding of Agile methodologies and tools such as Jira and Confluence.  

Success Measures:  

Successful delivery of regional dispute capabilities aligned to business priorities and roadmap commitments.  

High\-quality requirements that enable efficient estimation, solution design, and predictable delivery outcomes.  

Effective stakeholder alignment across Product, Business, Operations, Engineering, and Regional teams.**Corporate Security Responsibility**

  

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

The Sr. Staff Consulting Architect will act as a **trusted technical advisor to senior customer stakeholders**, helping organizations define their AI platform strategy, target architecture, adoption roadmap, and operating model.

**Role Overview**


Nutanix is seeking a **Sr. Staff Consulting Architect – AI** to provide senior technical leadership in the architecture, design, and transformation of enterprise AI platforms based on the **Nutanix AI Platform (NAI)** and equivalent enterprise AI/ML platforms.


The role is intended for a highly experienced AI platform architect who can lead complex enterprise AI transformation initiatives spanning **AI infrastructure, GPU\-enabled Kubernetes, MLOps/LLMOps, Generative AI, RAG, model serving, data services, automation, security, and hybrid/multi\-cloud environments**.


The Sr. Staff Consulting Architect will act as a **trusted technical advisor to senior customer stakeholders**, helping organizations define their AI platform strategy, target architecture, adoption roadmap, and operating model.


The role requires a combination of deep hands\-on expertise and strategic architecture leadership across AI/ML platforms, Kubernetes, virtualization, GPU infrastructure, cloud\-native technologies, data platforms, and automation.


The architect will also provide technical leadership to Staff Consulting Architects and Consultants, establish reference architectures and reusable AI solutions, and collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and other technical organizations to influence the evolution and adoption of Nutanix AI solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Enterprise AI Strategy \& Architecture**

* Lead architecture strategy for enterprise AI/ML and Generative AI platform transformation programs.
* Define target\-state AI platform architectures aligned to customer business, data, application, security, and operational requirements.
* Architect enterprise AI platforms across:
	+ Nutanix AI Platform (NAI)
	+ Kubernetes\-based AI platforms
	+ Nutanix AHV
	+ Bare\-metal GPU infrastructure
	+ Hybrid and multi\-cloud environments
	+ Public cloud AI/ML platforms where applicable
* Develop phased AI adoption roadmaps covering:
	+ AI infrastructure
	+ Model development
	+ Model training and fine\-tuning
	+ Inference
	+ RAG
	+ MLOps/LLMOps
	+ Application integration
	+ Governance and operations
* Advise customer executives, enterprise architects, data scientists, ML engineers, platform teams, and application teams on enterprise AI adoption.
* Translate business use cases into scalable, secure, resilient, and operationally sustainable AI architectures.
* Evaluate architecture trade\-offs across performance, scalability, GPU utilization, cost, security, data locality, and operational complexity.

**2\. AI Infrastructure \& GPU Platform Architecture**

* Design enterprise AI infrastructure supporting:
	+ GPU\-enabled Kubernetes
	+ AI/ML workloads
	+ Model training
	+ Fine\-tuning
	+ Inference
	+ Vector search
	+ RAG workloads
* Define GPU architecture considering:
	+ GPU selection and sizing
	+ GPU scheduling
	+ GPU partitioning and sharing
	+ CPU/GPU topology
	+ NUMA
	+ Memory requirements
	+ Network bandwidth
	+ Storage throughput
* Architect high\-performance AI infrastructure across virtualized and bare\-metal environments.
* Design GPU\-enabled Kubernetes platforms using technologies such as:
	+ NVIDIA GPU Operator
	+ NVIDIA CUDA
	+ NVIDIA Container Toolkit
	+ NVIDIA Triton Inference Server
	+ KServe
* Evaluate and architect high\-performance networking for AI workloads, including where applicable:
	+ RDMA
	+ InfiniBand
	+ RoCE
	+ High\-speed Ethernet
	+ NVIDIA networking technologies
* Optimize infrastructure for GPU utilization, workload density, performance, availability, and cost.
* Define architectures for scalable AI compute pools and shared enterprise AI platforms.

**3\. Kubernetes \& AI Platform Engineering**

* Architect Kubernetes platforms optimized for enterprise AI workloads.
* Define AI platform architecture across:
	+ Kubernetes control plane
	+ GPU worker nodes
	+ Storage
	+ Networking
	+ Ingress
	+ Security
	+ Observability
* Design multi\-cluster and multi\-tenant AI environments.
* Define workload isolation across:
	+ Cluster
	+ Namespace
	+ Node
	+ GPU
* Architect integration with enterprise infrastructure and services including:
	+ Identity and access management
	+ LDAP/Active Directory
	+ DNS
	+ PKI/certificates
	+ Load balancers
	+ Storage
	+ Backup and DR
	+ Monitoring and logging
* Drive platform engineering and self\-service capabilities for data scientists and AI developers.
* Define standardized patterns for AI workspace provisioning and lifecycle management.

**4\. Generative AI, RAG \& AI Application Architecture**

* Lead architecture for enterprise Generative AI solutions and platforms.
* Design end\-to\-end RAG architectures covering:
	+ Data ingestion
	+ Document processing
	+ Chunking
	+ Embedding generation
	+ Vector databases
	+ Retrieval
	+ Re\-ranking
	+ Prompt orchestration
	+ LLM inference
* Architect enterprise AI application patterns using technologies such as:
	+ Large Language Models (LLMs)
	+ Embedding models
	+ Vector databases
	+ LangChain
	+ LlamaIndex
	+ NVIDIA NeMo
	+ NVIDIA NIM
	+ Triton
	+ KServe
* Define architectures for:
	+ LLM inference
	+ Model serving
	+ Fine\-tuning
	+ RAG
	+ AI agents
	+ Enterprise copilots
* Evaluate open\-source and commercial AI models and frameworks based on customer requirements.
* Design model deployment strategies considering:
	+ Performance
	+ Latency
	+ Throughput
	+ GPU utilization
	+ Model size
	+ Security
	+ Data privacy
	+ Cost
* Guide customers in moving AI prototypes and proof\-of\-concepts into production\-grade platforms.

**5\. MLOps, LLMOps \& Automation**

* Define enterprise MLOps and LLMOps architectures covering the complete AI lifecycle.
* Design workflows for:
	+ Data preparation
	+ Model training
	+ Fine\-tuning
	+ Model evaluation
	+ Model registration
	+ Model deployment
	+ Model monitoring
	+ Model retirement
* Integrate AI platforms with CI/CD and GitOps practices.
* Design automated AI platform provisioning using:
	+ Terraform
	+ Ansible
	+ Kubernetes operators
	+ APIs
* Establish automation for:
	+ GPU infrastructure provisioning
	+ Kubernetes clusters
	+ AI workspaces
	+ Model deployment
	+ Inference endpoints
	+ RAG pipelines
* Integrate automation with:
	+ Nutanix APIs
	+ NKP APIs
	+ Kubernetes APIs
	+ NVIDIA technologies
	+ Cloud provider APIs
* Develop repeatable, version\-controlled, auditable, and supportable AI platform delivery patterns.

**6\. Data, Storage \& AI Platform Integration**

* Architect data platforms supporting enterprise AI workloads.
* Define integration between AI platforms and:
	+ File services
	+ Object storage
	+ Databases
	+ Data lakes
	+ Vector databases
	+ Enterprise data sources
* Design storage architectures optimized for:
	+ Model datasets
	+ Training data
	+ Model artifacts
	+ Checkpoints
	+ Embeddings
	+ Vector data
	+ Inference workloads
* Address performance requirements across:
	+ IOPS
	+ Throughput
	+ Latency
	+ Metadata performance
	+ Network bandwidth
* Define data movement and data locality strategies for hybrid AI environments.
* Establish architecture patterns for data protection, backup, disaster recovery, and lifecycle management.

**7\. AI Security, Governance \& Responsible AI**

* Define security architecture across the AI infrastructure, platform, data, model, and application layers.
* Establish controls for:
	+ Identity and access management
	+ RBAC
	+ Secrets management
	+ Network security
	+ Data protection
	+ Model access
	+ API security
* Design secure multi\-tenant AI platforms with appropriate isolation.
* Define governance for:
	+ Models
	+ Datasets
	+ Prompts
	+ Embeddings
	+ AI applications
	+ Inference endpoints
* Establish security and governance patterns for enterprise RAG and GenAI applications.
* Address risks associated with:
	+ Sensitive data
	+ Data leakage
	+ Prompt injection
	+ Model misuse
	+ Unauthorized model access
* Integrate policy\-as\-code and security controls into AI platform lifecycle management.
* Guide customers toward responsible, auditable, and governed enterprise AI adoption.

**8\. Observability, Performance \& Cost Optimization**

* Define comprehensive observability for AI platforms covering:
	+ Infrastructure
	+ GPUs
	+ Kubernetes
	+ Models
	+ Inference services
	+ Applications
* Establish monitoring and optimization for:
	+ GPU utilization
	+ GPU memory
	+ CPU utilization
	+ Network performance
	+ Storage throughput
	+ Model latency
	+ Inference throughput
* Define AI platform SLOs, SLIs, and operational KPIs.
* Troubleshoot complex issues across:
	+ GPU infrastructure
	+ Kubernetes
	+ Networking
	+ Storage
	+ AI frameworks
	+ Model serving
	+ Application layers
* Drive capacity planning and AI infrastructure optimization.
* Develop strategies for optimizing AI infrastructure and cloud consumption costs.

**9\. Consulting, Technical Leadership \& Customer Enablement**

* Lead executive\-level architecture workshops for:
	+ Enterprise AI strategy
	+ AI platform adoption
	+ Generative AI
	+ RAG
	+ MLOps/LLMOps
	+ AI infrastructure modernization
* Act as the senior technical advisor to customer:
	+ CIO/CTO organizations
	+ Enterprise architects
	+ Data and AI leaders
	+ Infrastructure leaders
	+ Platform engineering teams
	+ Data science and ML engineering teams
* Lead complex technical discovery and architecture engagements.
* Provide technical direction for strategic AI programs and high\-value customer engagements.
* Act as the senior escalation point for complex AI architecture and implementation challenges.
* Review and govern AI architectures developed by Staff Consulting Architects and Consultants.
* Mentor architects and consultants and build organizational AI capability.

**10\. Reference Architecture, Innovation \& Thought Leadership**

* Create enterprise\-grade AI reference architectures and solution blueprints.
* Develop reusable:
	+ Design patterns
	+ Implementation guides
	+ Automation frameworks
	+ AI solution templates
	+ MLOps/LLMOps patterns
	+ RAG reference implementations
* Identify and evaluate emerging AI technologies and their applicability to Nutanix solutions.
* Drive innovation across:
	+ Generative AI
	+ AI agents
	+ RAG
	+ GPU infrastructure
	+ AI platform engineering
	+ Model serving
	+ AI observability
* Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, Support, and other technical teams to provide field feedback and influence product direction.
* Contribute to technical whitepapers, solution briefs, blogs, reference architectures, and internal enablement content.
* Represent Nutanix in strategic customer discussions, technical forums, and industry events where appropriate.

**Technical Skills \& Experience**

**Mandatory Skills – Must Have**

* **15\+ years of experience** across infrastructure, cloud, virtualization, Kubernetes, AI/ML platforms, or related technologies.
* Proven experience architecting and delivering **enterprise AI/ML platforms and AI infrastructure**.
* Deep understanding of AI/ML platform architecture and enterprise AI adoption.
* Strong hands\-on experience with:
	+ Kubernetes
	+ Nutanix AHV or equivalent virtualization platforms
	+ GPU\-enabled infrastructure
	+ Linux
	+ Container technologies
* Strong experience with **Nutanix AI Platform (NAI) or equivalent enterprise AI platforms**.
* Deep understanding of GPU architecture and AI workload requirements.
* Strong understanding of:
	+ GPU scheduling
	+ CUDA
	+ GPU Operator
	+ GPU resource management
	+ GPU performance optimization
* Strong experience with Kubernetes\-based AI platforms.
* Strong understanding of AI/ML frameworks and platforms, including several of:
	+ NVIDIA NeMo
	+ NVIDIA NIM
	+ Triton
	+ KServe
	+ Kubeflow
	+ MLflow
* Strong understanding of Generative AI and LLM architectures.
* Proven experience designing RAG architectures and AI application platforms.
* Strong understanding of:
	+ LLMs
	+ Embedding models
	+ Vector databases
	+ Model serving
	+ Fine\-tuning
	+ Inference
* Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code:
	+ Terraform
	+ Ansible
* Strong experience with CI/CD, GitOps, and platform automation.
* Strong understanding of enterprise storage, networking, security, and data architecture for AI workloads.
* Strong troubleshooting skills across infrastructure, Kubernetes, GPU, networking, storage, and AI platform layers.
* Proven ability to lead complex customer engagements and architecture decisions.
* Excellent customer\-facing, consulting, presentation, and executive communication skills.

**Added Advantage – Good to Have**

* Experience with NVIDIA AI Enterprise.
* Experience with NVIDIA DGX, HGX, or equivalent GPU infrastructure.
* Experience with NVIDIA networking technologies, InfiniBand, or RoCE.
* Experience with GPU partitioning and sharing technologies.
* Experience with Kubeflow, MLflow, KServe, Ray, or equivalent AI/ML platforms.
* Experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, Flowise, or equivalent GenAI orchestration frameworks.
* Experience with vector databases such as Milvus, Qdrant, Weaviate, pgvector, or equivalent.
* Experience with AI agents and agentic architectures.
* Experience with multimodal AI.
* Experience with AI/ML model fine\-tuning and optimization.
* Experience with public cloud AI services and GPU platforms on AWS or Azure.
* Experience with hybrid and multi\-cloud AI architectures.
* Experience with AI governance, security, and responsible AI practices.
* Experience with FinOps and AI infrastructure cost optimization.

**Trainable / Developable Skills**

* Advanced AI agent and agentic workflow architectures.
* Emerging LLM and multimodal model architectures.
* Advanced model optimization and inference technologies.
* Emerging GPU and AI accelerator technologies.
* Advanced AI governance and responsible AI frameworks.
* Advanced AI observability and LLM evaluation frameworks.
* New Nutanix AI platform capabilities and ecosystem integrations.

**Leadership \& Consulting Expectations**


The Sr. Staff Consulting Architect – AI is expected to:

* Operate effectively with **C\-level executives, AI leaders, enterprise architects, data scientists, ML engineers, infrastructure leaders, and platform engineering teams**.
* Lead strategic AI architecture discussions and influence enterprise technology direction.
* Convert business AI opportunities into practical, production\-ready architectures.
* Balance AI innovation with enterprise requirements for:
	+ Security

	+ Reliability
	+ Performance
	+ Scalability
	+ Cost
	+ Operational sustainability
* Independently lead ambiguous and high\-impact AI architecture problems.
* Provide technical authority for complex AI engagements and critical escalations.
* Mentor Staff Consulting Architects and Consultants and raise the organization's AI technical maturity.

**Education \& Certifications**

**Preferred Certifications**

* Drive continuous improvement in operations and reporting accuracy.
* Ensure all internal and external queries are resolved within defined timelines.
* Minimize financial leakages and operational inefficiencies.

**H. Administrative \& Infrastructure Management**

* Manage state office infrastructure and administrative requirements.
* Ensure readiness of tools, equipment, and support systems.

**4\. Competencies Required**

**Technical**

* Strong understanding of O\&M practices, SLA frameworks, and asset management

* Familiarity with compliance, audits, and safety standards

**Managerial**

* Multi\-site operations management

9bff2cc3.description:
**Description**
 Are you ready to lead the AI\-driven transformation of how enterprise software teams build, ship, and scale? Do you combine deep technical credibility with strategic business acumen to drive measurable developer productivity outcomes at Fortune 500 companies? Can you operate independently in ambiguous environments — setting direction when strategy is unclear and turning undefined opportunities into quantifiable business impact?
   

  

 As a Senior Engagement Manager for Developer Transformation (DevTx), AWS India, you will own end\-to\-end strategy and execution of AI\-native developer transformation programs across India's largest enterprise customers. You will lead complex, multi\-stakeholder engagements where scope, ownership, and success criteria are often undefined — bringing clarity, setting direction, and driving documented business outcomes. You will serve as a trusted advisor to senior engineering and business stakeholders, connecting developer AI adoption to measurable business value (productivity gains, time\-to\-market acceleration). You will build mechanisms that scale impact beyond individual engagements, shaping how AWS's developer transformation methodology is delivered across the APJ region.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Own the India AI\-DLC engagement pipeline — proactively identify, qualify, and prioritize developer transformation opportunities across ISVs, GSIs, FSI, and Enterprise segments by diving deep into customers' engineering organization structures, technology stacks, and business priorities. Define intake criteria and triage mechanisms that enable scale across the team. Convert undefined customer interest into scoped, investment\-justified engagement proposals with clear success metrics and ROI projections.
* Develop and articulate executive\-level narratives that connect developer transformation to business outcomes — productivity ROI, innovation velocity, and competitive differentiation. Tailor value propositions by industry vertical and customer maturity, and present independently to VP/CxO\-level engineering and business leaders.
* Lead cross\-functional delivery with Solutions Architects, Developer Specialist SAs, and field teams to design and execute AI\-native engineering transformation programs — including AI\-DLC workshops, and Kiro and developer tool adoption accelerators. Own engagement architecture and sequencing decisions. Resolve technical ambiguity by making informed trade\-offs.
* Own end\-to\-end engagement lifecycle — from qualification and scoping through delivery, measurement, and post\-engagement follow\-up — for complex enterprise developer transformation programs. Manage a portfolio of 8\-12 concurrent engagements across industries (FSI, manufacturing, technology, telecom), ensuring progress toward documented, measurable outcomes. Track and report pipeline metrics (ARR, opportunity conversion, engagement\-to\-launch ratio) with full accountability for India DevTx program targets.
* Design engagement governance structures — defining scope, success criteria, escalation paths, and exit criteria — in partnership with customer technical and business stakeholders. Evaluate feasibility, long\-term value realization potential, and AWS investment ROI before committing resources. Establish systems that ensure consistent engagement quality and eliminate non\-differentiated work through automation and reusable frameworks.
* Drive alignment across AWS internal teams (account managers, solutions architects, specialist teams) and customer organizations (engineering leadership, platform teams, developer communities). Navigate competing priorities and organizational politics to maintain momentum on transformation initiatives. Serve as the single thread connecting customer business outcomes to AWS technical delivery.
* Build and maintain trusted advisor relationships with senior engineering leaders (VP/Director level) within customer organizations. Be recognized as the go\-to person for developer platform strategy and AI\-driven engineering transformation. Engage occasionally with C\-suite executives on strategic transformation vision and engagement decisions.
* Guide customers in designing their AI\-native software development operating models — from tool adoption (Kiro) through methodology transformation (AI\-DLC framework) to organizational change management. Ensure transformation initiatives deliver verified, quantified business outcomes within agreed timelines.
* Capture and systematize learnings from engagements into reusable assets (playbooks, case studies, enablement content) that multiply team effectiveness. Provide actionable customer feedback to AWS teams that informs DevTx charter and strategy. Contribute to thought leadership through internal blogs, external case studies, and conference presentations.
* Coordinate with APJ and Global DevTx peers on cross\-geography engagement opportunities, shared customer programs, and methodology standardization. Represent India DevTx in regional forums and contribute to scaling successful India engagement patterns across APJ.


 What Makes This Role Unique
   

  

 This is not a traditional Engagement Manager or Professional Services role. In this role, you will:
   

  

* Own programs, not projects — drive multi\-quarter customer transformation journeys, not time\-boxed billable engagements
* Combine strategy with execution — present transformation roadmaps to VPs of Engineering one day, then triage intake queues and unblock engagements the next
* Own business outcomes — be accountable for pipeline metrics, opportunity conversion, and ARR — not just engagement satisfaction scores


 A day in the life
   

  

 Your days will be varied and high\-impact. One morning you might be reviewing a customer's AI\-DLC workshop feedback, refining the follow\-up plan that converts a successful prototype into a production adoption roadmap with clear revenue implications.
   

  

 Later that day, you could be presenting a transformation case to a customer's leadership team — articulating why their 5,000\-developer engineering org needs a structured AI\-native development program and what the expected business outcome looks like in 6 months.
   

  

 Between meetings, you'll triage new engagement requests in the intake queue — qualifying a GSI's ask for Kiro enablement, deprioritizing a low\-signal opportunity, and connecting an account team with the right specialist SA for a complex developer transformation scoping and review.
   

  

 You'll spend time building — creating reusable engagement frameworks, updating pipeline trackers, and authoring the narrative that justifies expanding DevTx's footprint into new customer segments. You'll collaborate with your global peers to exchange learnings, align on methodology standards, and identify customers with cross\-geography presence that need coordinated engagement strategies.
   

  

 This role requires balancing strategic executive engagement with operational program management — you'll shift between leadership conversations and intake triage daily.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The AWS Developer Transformation (DevTx) India team leads the next generation of software development practices across India's largest enterprises. We help engineering teams adopt AI\-native development methodologies and AI\-Driven Development Lifecycle (AI\-DLC) transformations — compressing development timelines from months to days and weeks. Our team works directly with CTOs and VPs of Engineering to accelerate developer productivity at scale.
   

  

 We operate with high ownership, transparency, and autonomy — every team member owns their engagements from intake to outcome. This is a small, high\-impact team where your work directly shapes how major Indian enterprises build software.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 6\+ years of leading large\-scale, technical or engineering programs with a proven record of thought leadership, business case development, realizing customer benefits, and successful program completion experience
* 6\+ years of customer\-facing work, engaging with customer executives, technologists or partners to solve business problems with advanced technologies experience
* Bachelor's degree in science, technology, engineering, math, business or equivalent
* Experience leading technical and non\-technical transformation project teams with a proven ability to work across broad functional teams


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience implementing cloud services including migrations and modernization projects or similar
* Knowledge of software development lifecycle, including design, development, test, build, deployment processes and timelines
* PMP certification, or SCRUM/Agile, SAFe certification
* Experience building scalable programs and repeatable scalable processes, levering various tools and methods to create scale and efficiency
* Experience using data and metrics to measure impact and determine improvements
* Experience with AI/ML\-assisted development tools, developer productivity platforms, or DevOps/platform engineering transformation

As a **Telecom OSS Architect (Presales \& Delivery)**, you will lead end‑to‑end OSS transformation programs for telecom operators, spanning opportunity qualification, solution architecture, OSS modernization, legacy migrations, delivery governance, and roadmap definition for autonomous network operations. You will combine deep OSS architecture expertise with presales and solutioning skills to drive large‑scale transformation engagements.

**Presales \& Solutioning**

* Lead OSS presales opportunities including RFP/RFI responses, solution design, estimation, and proposals.
* Develop winning strategies and present solutions to senior telecom stakeholders (CxO, VP level).
* Collaborate with sales and account teams to shape large transformation engagements.

**OSS Architecture \& Transformation**

* Design end‑to‑end OSS solutions covering inventory, assurance, fault/performance management, fulfillment, and orchestration.
* Define target‑state OSS architectures aligned with TM Forum ODA, eTOM, and SID standards.
* Evaluate OSS products, platforms, and vendor ecosystems; develop reference architectures and roadmaps.

**Network Automation \& Autonomous Operations**

* Define strategies for autonomous networks leveraging closed‑loop automation, intent‑based orchestration, and self‑healing operations.
* Drive OSS integration with network and operational platforms to improve automation maturity.

**OSS Modernization \& Migration**

* Lead legacy OSS modernization and greenfield OSS implementations.
* Design migration strategies for multi‑vendor environments with minimal disruption.
* Drive inventory reconciliation, data migration, cutover planning, and rollback strategies across RAN, Core, Transport, IP/MPLS, and Optical networks.

* Own technical and delivery governance across design, build, testing, deployment, and operations.
* Manage scope, schedules, risks, quality, and financial performance.
* Act as primary technical authority across delivery workstreams and stakeholder groups.
* Establish KPIs, SLAs, dashboards, and steering committee reporting.

**Team Leadership**

* Mentor architects, solution leads, and delivery teams.
* Develop reusable frameworks, accelerators, methodologies, and best practices for OSS engagements.

**Experience**

* You have 15\+ years of experience in Telecom OSS and Network Operations.

**Technical Expertise**

* You have strong knowledge of TM Forum ODA, eTOM, SID, Open APIs, and telecom standards.
* You have hands‑on expertise in OSS domains (Inventory, Assurance, Fulfillment, Service Activation, Orchestration).
* You understand telecom domains (RAN, Core, IP, Transport, Optical).

* You excel in stakeholder management and executive presentations.
* You are confident leading multi‑year transformation programs and managed services engagements.

* Define and implement greenfield architectures while modernising and migrating legacy telecom platforms and data ecosystems.
* Design scalable data pipelines for telecom datasets (CDRs, xDRs, PM/FM counters, telemetry, inventory, topology).

* Design AI and data foundations supporting autonomous network initiatives (closed‑loop assurance, self‑optimising networks, intent‑based operations).
* Build and deploy AI/ML models for telecom use cases such as churn prediction, anomaly detection, capacity forecasting, optimisation, and predictive maintenance.
* Architect enterprise data lakes, warehouses, and analytics platforms for batch and real‑time processing.

* Lead solution design and presales activities including proposals, architecture presentations, effort estimation, and costing.
* Deliver large telecom transformation programs covering design, development, testing, migration, deployment, and rollout.
* Define migration, cutover, and rollback strategies to ensure seamless implementation and business continuity.
* Support post‑production operations by monitoring performance, ensuring SLA adherence, and driving continuous improvements.

**Team Leadership \& Best Practices**

* Mentor technical teams and establish reusable frameworks, accelerators, and methodologies.
* Drive adoption of best practices across telecom analytics and data engineering initiatives.

 **We'd Love to Hear From You If...**

**Experience**

* You have 9–14 years of experience in Telecom, Network Services, Data Engineering, Analytics, or AI/ML domains.
* You have strong understanding of telecom network architecture (RAN, Core, BSC/BTS, OSS/BSS, packet and circuit‑switched).
* You have worked with telecom data sources (CDRs, xDRs, PM/FM data, alarms, telemetry, inventory, topology).
* You have led architecture discussions, customer workshops, solutioning, and presales engagements.

**Technical Expertise**

* You have hands‑on experience in data engineering, pipeline development, data lakes, warehouses, and real‑time analytics.
* You are skilled in ETL/ELT frameworks, data governance, and cloud/big data ecosystems.
* You have knowledge of AI/ML model development and deployment for telecom use cases.

**Ways of Working**

* You demonstrate strong stakeholder management, communication, and leadership skills.
* You thrive in customer‑facing consulting and presales engagements.
* You are proactive in bridging telecom expertise with advanced analytics to enable intelligent operations.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in autonomous networks, network automation, and AI‑driven telecom operations.
* Exposure to cloud platforms and modern data technologies.
* Experience with global telecom operators and CSP customers.

Through these efforts, IT helps to improve the competitive position of Corning's businesses through IT enabled processes. IT also delivers Information Technology applications, infrastructure, and project services in a cost efficient manner to Corning worldwide.
  
  

**Role Summary:** The Data Architect is responsible for the design and evolution of our enterprise data architecture, with a strong focus on reusable data pipelines, data schemas \& products, and modern data engineering practices. This role requires an AI\-first mindset in data engineering and data modeling activities that enable the business to use data effectively and consistently across domains.
  
  

You will partner closely with product owners, data engineers, data analysts, and business stakeholders to:
  
  

Define and maintain enterprise data models and domain boundaries using traditional and AI\-enabled methods
  
Design and govern reusable data assets and data products
  
Establish standards and patterns for robust, scalable data pipelines
  
Ensure data is discoverable, trustworthy, and fit\-for\-purpose for analytics, ML, and operational use cases
  
  

The ideal candidate blends deep technical expertise with strong business acumen and can translate complex business needs into clear, implementable data designs. They will evaluate and recommend different solutions and provide leadership to the product and engineering teams in delivering architecture, design, and development of solutions across multiple data products.
  
  

**Essential Responsibilities:**  

Domain Data Architecture
  
  

Define and evolve conceptual, logical, and physical data models across core business domains.
  
Establish canonical and semantic models, shared dimensions, and reference data to enable consistent reporting and cross\-functional integration.
  
Design reusable business entities, metrics, and data structures that support enterprise\-wide consistency and scalability.
  
Partner with business stakeholders to translate processes, KPIs, and analytical needs into effective data models and semantic layers.
  
Recommend fit\-for\-purpose modeling approaches based on business and technical requirements.
  
  

Data Products and Reusable Design Patterns
  
  

Define standards for data products, including structure, naming, documentation, versioning, quality expectations, and lifecycle management.
  
Develop reusable patterns for data ingestion, transformation, and consumption that can be scaled across teams and use cases.
  
Partner with data engineering teams to create reference architectures, templates, and reusable implementation assets.
  
Establish schema design and evolution practices that support ongoing change while minimizing downstream impact.
  
Contribute to iterative solution delivery through Agile and DevOps practices.
  
  

Data Pipeline and Platform Architecture
  
  

Design end\-to\-end data pipeline architectures for batch, near real time, and event\-driven use cases.
  
Define logical and physical architecture patterns using cloud\-native platforms and modern data technologies.
  
Guide the development of scalable, secure, reliable, and cost\-effective data solutions using tools such as Databricks, dbt, SQL, Python or Scala, and orchestration frameworks.
  
Ensure solutions are built with strong observability, testing, performance, and operational reliability.
  
Collaborate with engineering teams to support production\-ready implementation and continuous improvement.
  
  

Governance, Standards, and Technical Leadership
  
  

Embed data governance, security, compliance, lineage, metadata, and retention requirements into architecture and design decisions.
  
Define and promote standards for data quality, validation, cataloging, access controls, and engineering best practices.
  
Provide technical leadership and mentoring to data engineers, analysts, and architects to drive consistent adoption of standards and patterns.
  
Evaluate emerging technologies and architectural approaches and make recommendations aligned to business priorities.
  
  

**Qualifications/Requirements:**  

7–10 years of relevant IT experience, with at least 4\+ years in a Data Architect, Senior Data Engineer, or similar role focused on data design and modeling.
  
5\+ years of experience designing and implementing data models for analytics and operational reporting (dimensional, normalized, and/or domain\-driven designs).
  
5\+ years of experience building and/or guiding the development of ETL/ELT pipelines in cloud or modern data platforms.
  
4\+ years of hands\-on experience with Databricks or similar cloud\-based lakehouse platforms supporting enterprise data lakes, data warehouses, and business intelligence
  
2\+ years of experience using dbt (or similar transformation frameworks) including model structuring, tests, and documentation.
  
Strong proficiency in SQL and experience with at least one programming language used in data engineering (Python or Scala preferred).

7a096815.title: MS Azure Solution Architect
7a096815.description:
Position Description
   

  

 Founded in 1976, CGI is among the world's largest independent IT and business consulting services firms. With 94,000 consultants and professionals globally, CGI delivers an end\-to\-end portfolio of capabilities, from strategic IT and business consulting to systems integration, managed IT and business process services, and intellectual property solutions. CGI works with clients through a local relationship model complemented by a global delivery network that helps clients digitally transform their organizations and accelerate results. CGI Fiscal 2024 reported revenue is CA$14\.68 billion, and CGI shares are listed on the TSX (GIB.A) and the NYSE (GIB). Learn more at cgi.com.
   

  

 Job Title: MS Azure Solutions Architect
   

  

 Experience: 14\+ years of experience
   

  

 Job location: Bangalore
   

  

 Position ID: J0826\-0444
   

  

 Work Type: Hybrid
   

  

 Employment Type: Full Time / Permanent
   

  

 Qualification: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
   

  

 We are seeking a highly experienced and strategic MS Azure Solutions Architect to lead the technical solution definition and architecture for a project with prestigious client. In this role, you will be the primary technical authority facing the client, responsible for translating complex business requirements into scalable, robust Azure based solutions. You will operate in a dynamic, global delivery model, requiring exceptional leadership skills to manage and mentor a multi cultural team of engineers and developers across different time zones. The ideal candidate blends deep technical expertise in the Azure ecosystem with strong consulting, pre sales, and stakeholder management skills.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Solution Definition \& Architecture: Lead the end to end technical solution definition for the deal. Design secure, scalable, and high performance cloud architectures tailored to the client's specific business needs.
* Client Management: Act as the trusted technical advisor to the client. Manage expectations, conduct technical workshops, present architectural visions, and ensure alignment between client objectives and the delivered solution.
* Global Team Leadership: Direct and mentor a multi cultural technical team operating within a global delivery model (GDM). Foster collaboration, ensure technical excellence, and manage deliverables across offshore, nearshore, and onsite teams.
* Enterprise Integration: Architect and oversee the seamless integration of cloud solutions with existing Enterprise Information Systems (EIS) and third party platforms.
* Modern Application Development: Drive the adoption of micro service architectures to build resilient, modular, and easily deployable applications.


 Technical Skills \& Qualifications:
   

  

* Cloud Platform: Extensive, hands\-on experience as a Cloud Architect specializing in Microsoft Azure. Azure Solutions Architect Expert certification is highly preferred.
* Data \& Storage: Proven expertise in designing data models and selecting appropriate storage solutions, specifically utilizing Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, and Azure blob storage.
* Integration \& Compute: Deep understanding of application integration and serverless computing. Must have demonstrable experience designing scalable solutions using Azure Logic Apps and robust API management strategies.
* Architecture Style: Strong background in designing and implementing micro service architectures and containerized applications.
* Enterprise Focus: Solid experience working with complex Enterprise Information Systems (EIS) and migrating legacy workloads to the cloud.


 What You Bring to the Table
   

  

* 10\+ years of IT experience with at least 5\+ years dedicated to Azure cloud architecture.
* Proven track record of working on large scale deals and leading the technical stream during the pre\-sales and project initiation phases.
* Exceptional communication skills with the cultural intelligence and empathy required to successfully manage and motivate multi\-cultural global teams.
* Strong negotiation and conflict resolution skills when dealing with client stakeholders.


 CGI is an equal opportunity employer. In addition, CGI is committed to providing accommodation for people with disabilities in accordance with provincial legislation. Please let us know if you require reasonable accommodation due to a disability during any aspect of the recruitment process and we will work with you to address your needs.
   

  

 Your future duties and responsibilities
   

  

**Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role**
**Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.**
 Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…
   

  

 You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.
   

  

 Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.
   

  

 You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well\-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.
   

  

 That same commitment to fairness extends to how we use technology. To support our recruitment team, AI tools may be used to help assess applications though they never replace human judgement. All hiring decisions remain entirely in the hands of our recruitment professionals.
   

  

 Come join our team—one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world.

**Description**
 Our Field Service Professional Services team works across technology and business stakeholders to usher customers into the next phase of their business transformation journey and achieve innovative outcomes that craft the future.
   

  

 Technical Architect successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include\-\-but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce.com products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.
   

  

 As a core part of this role, you will realize solutions for our customers by focusing on consultancy, technical development \& delivery for the customers and partners to solve critically meaningful business challenges using Salesforce’s Field Service Platform (SFS). Salesforce FS product provides FSM solutions for a wide variety of customer verticals and ecosystem(s) like Telecom, Utilities, Oil \& Gas, Manufacturing, Finance etc.
   

  

 You are both a big picture thinker and in\-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution. The solutions you design are built for the long\-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API’s as well as a strong development background.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Champion an AI\-first delivery methodology, utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation across projects
* Translate business requirements into well\-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues
* From time\-to\-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre\-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep\-dive sessions, Proof\-Of\-Concept (POC) development with prospects
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50\-75%


**Requirements**
* Degree or equivalent proven experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 9\-14 years CRM experience with a minimum of 6 years on the Salesforce platform
* Expert level understanding of End\-to\-End Field Service Implementation
* Good understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Marketing, and Community Clouds
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance\-driven solutions
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth)
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.)
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end\-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web\-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire
