 Nutanix is seeking a Sr. Staff Consulting Architect – AI to provide senior technical leadership in the architecture, design, and transformation of enterprise AI platforms based on the Nutanix AI Platform (NAI) and equivalent enterprise AI/ML platforms.
   

  

 The role is intended for a highly experienced AI platform architect who can lead complex enterprise AI transformation initiatives spanning AI infrastructure, GPU\-enabled Kubernetes, MLOps/LLMOps, Generative AI, RAG, model serving, data services, automation, security, and hybrid/multi\-cloud environments.
   

  

 The Sr. Staff Consulting Architect will act as a trusted technical advisor to senior customer stakeholders, helping organizations define their AI platform strategy, target architecture, adoption roadmap, and operating model.
   

  

 The role requires a combination of deep hands\-on expertise and strategic architecture leadership across AI/ML platforms, Kubernetes, virtualization, GPU infrastructure, cloud\-native technologies, data platforms, and automation.
   

  

 The architect will also provide technical leadership to Staff Consulting Architects and Consultants, establish reference architectures and reusable AI solutions, and collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and other technical organizations to influence the evolution and adoption of Nutanix AI solutions.

c453f41a.title: Senior Solutions Architect, Infiniband and Networking Ethernet - NVIS
c453f41a.description:
NVIDIA is looking for Senior Networking (ETH/IB) Solutions Architect to join its NVIDIA Infrastructure Specialist Team. Academic and commercial groups around the world are using NVIDIA products to revolutionize deep learning and data analytics, and to power data centers. Join the team building many of the largest and fastest AI/HPC systems in the world! We are looking for someone with the ability to work on a dynamic customer focused team that requires excellent interpersonal skills. This role will be interacting with customers, partners and internal teams, to analyze, define and implement large scale Networking projects. The scope of these efforts includes a combination of Networking, System Design and Automation and being the face to the customer!
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Primary responsibilities will include building AI/HPC infrastructure for new and existing customers.
* Support operational and reliability aspects of large\-scale AI clusters, focusing on performance at scale, real\-time monitoring, logging, and alerting.
* Engage in and improve the whole lifecycle of services—from inception and design through deployment, operation, and refinement.
* Maintain services once they are live by measuring and monitoring availability, latency, and overall system health.
* Provide feedback to internal teams such as opening bugs, documenting workarounds, and suggesting improvements.


**What We Need To See**
* BS/MS/PhD or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or related fields.
* At least 5\+ years of professional experience in networking fundamentals, Ethernet or InfiniBand World.
* Hands\-on experience with network switch/router platforms like Cumulus Linux, SONiC, IOS, JunosOS, and EOS, etc.
* Possess solid working knowledge of Ethernet/InfiniBand/RDMA core principles.
* Be proficient in end\-to\-end IB/Eth cluster deployment, adapter configuration and firmware maintenance, and able to conduct professional performance benchmarking with mainstream RDMA testing tools.
* Capable of independently diagnosing and troubleshooting typical IB/Eth network anomalies, including link flapping, connection failure, as well as bandwidth and latency jitter issues.
* Master practical RDMA network optimization strategies such as QP tuning, MTU configuration and congestion control optimization.
* Hands\-on working experience in RDMA\-accelerated business scenarios, including distributed storage and high\-performance computing clusters.
* Extensive experience delivering automated network provisioning solutions using tools like Ansible, Salt, and Python.
* Ability to develop CI/CD pipelines for network operations.
* Strong written, verbal, and listening skills in English are essential.


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Familiarity with cloud networks (AWS, GCP, Azure) is a plus.
* Advanced Linux or Networking Certifications.
* Experience with High\-performance computing architectures. Understanding of how job schedulers(Slurm, PBS) work.
* luster management technologies knowledge (bonus credit for BCM (Base Command Manager).)
* Experience with GPU (Graphics Processing Unit) focused hardware/software.

1a3e80d0.title: Customer Success Manager- Marketing cloud
1a3e80d0.description:
**Description**
 The Customer Success Manager (CSM) is a versatile expert responsible for ensuring high\-value customers who purchase the Signature Success Plan achieve a significant return on their investment with our platform. This role functions as an extension of the customer's workforce and a trusted advisor, providing guidance and
   

  

 advice to customer organizations. The CSM is responsible for identifying and addressing both technical and business concerns, aligning them strategically with customer priorities, projects, and problems. The CSM serving Marketing Cloud customers acts as the primary Marketing Cloud Subject Matter Expert (SME) for the technical and operational configuration and needs of the customer.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Customer Accountability and Value Alignment
   

  

* Single Point of Accountability: Serve as the single point of customer accountability responsible for the delivery of all Signature deliverables, the overall customer experience, and renewal and expansion.
* Signature Lifecycle Oversight: Coordinate all deliverables the customer is entitled to, overseeing the experience throughout the Signature lifecycle.
* Value Delivery: Apply the correct processes to address customer needs and ensure value is delivered through the Signature offer.
* Stakeholder Alignment: Successfully align with and manage both Business and Technical Stakeholders, focusing on aligning Business Value and Technical Goals to the Signature offer.
* Prioritization: Prioritize the most urgent work activities, organize tasks to avoid missing key steps, and create basic plans to focus time, taking responsibility for assigned tasks.
* Internal Resource Utilization: Use internal resources to increase effectiveness and rely on managers or mentors for guidance on priority problems.


**Strategic Advisory and Stakeholder Management**
* Relationship Building: Develop and maintain strong relationships at key stakeholder levels, including cultivating executive\-level relationships within customer IT and business leadership.
* Trusted Advisor: Act as a trusted advisor by gaining trust through mutual goals, understanding the customer's business model, and applying proven solutions to their problems.
* Innovation Partnership: Solidify partnership commitments and drive innovation aligned with customers' business challenges.
* Customer Engagement: Increase customer engagement with products and services and identify major political barriers to customer success.
* Collaborative Problem Solving: Partner with more experienced team members to solve complex problems and develop strategic success plans when needed.


**Technical Health, Adoption, and Risk Management**
* AI Literacy: Proficiency in using AI agents to automate routine tasks such as meeting summaries, QBR data collection, and initial health monitoring.
* Prompt Engineering Basics: Ability to use natural\-language commands to guide AI agents in retrieving accurate customer data and generating first drafts of success plans.
* AI Engagement Monitoring: Using AI\-driven sentiment and intent analysis to flag early customer concerns for human intervention.
* Collaborative Learning: Actively seeking out "Agentblazer" training and certifications to stay current on autonomous agent capabilities.
* Learning \& Development: Apply product knowledge and expertise to address technical concerns, use this knowledge to ask effective diagnosis questions and align platform features with customer priorities and roadmaps.
* Proactive Reviews: Proactively monitor and conduct quarterly reviews, identify trends, and provide tailored release recommendations to ensure stability, performance, and feature enhancement.
* Incident Management: Act as the primary point of contact for major incidents, ensuring timely communications and resolution of issues.
* Cross\-functional Relationships: Forge strong multidisciplinary relationships with Sales, Engineering, and Product Management to lead and coordinate customer relationships for success and revenue opportunities.
* Client Engagement Planning: Form a clear plan for client engagements, communicate clearly and proactively with collaborators, and keep the customer goal central to decision\-making.


**Minimum Requirements**
 Preferred/Mandatory Qualifications and Skills
   

  

* Experience (Mandatory): Experienced business professional with 9\+ years of relevant industry expertise, including a mandatory minimum of 2\+ years of direct, hands\-on experience working with the Salesforce Marketing Cloud platform (Marketing Cloud Engagement, Marketing Cloud Account Engagement / Pardot, or Marketing Cloud Next) in a customer success, administrator, consultant, or marketing operations capacity. Candidates without demonstrated Salesforce Marketing Cloud experience will not be considered for this role.
* Consulting Skills: Strong consulting skills and demonstrated ability to drive business value, facilitate discussions, handle objections, and influence C\-level conversations.
* Domain Expertise: Possess industry\-relevant expertise and begin honing skills in a relevant functional area. Should understand the broad impact of the industry on the customer's business.
* Communication: Excellent communication skills to articulate technical issues to diverse audiences and the ability to translate technical concepts into business terms.
* Learning \& Development: Actively seek out relevant learning activities, approach obstacles as growth opportunities, and seek experienced mentors to accelerate personal development.


**Cloud Specific Experience**
 Salesforce product certifications are required for this role. Recommended Marketing Cloud certifications:
   

  

* Marketing Cloud Engagement Administrator — hands\-on experience configuring Marketing Cloud products using industry and product best practices.
* Marketing Cloud Email Specialist — proven knowledge of email marketing best practices, message design, subscriber \& data management, and inbox delivery.
* Marketing Cloud Account Engagement Specialist — skills in designing, building, and implementing marketing workflows through the Account Engagement (Pardot) platform.
* Marketing Cloud Engagement Consultant — ability to create multi\-channel campaign solutions using the full suite of Marketing Cloud tools.

4e91fa48.title: Technical Program Manager
4e91fa48.description:
**Who are we?**
 Checkmarx is the leader in application security and ensures that enterprises worldwide can secure their application development from code to cloud. Our consolidated platform and services address the needs of enterprises by improving security and reducing TCO, while simultaneously building trust between AppSec, developers, and CISOs. At Checkmarx, we believe it's not just about finding risk, but remediating it across the entire application footprint and software supply chain with one seamless process for all relevant stakeholders.
   

  

 We are honored to serve more than 1,800 customers, which includes 40 percent of all Fortune 100 companies including Siemens, Airbus, SalesForce, Stellantis, Adidas, Wal\-Mart, and Sanofi.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We’re hiring a Technical Program Manager to lead and coordinate key technical initiatives that drive customer success and adoption of the Checkmarx One platform. You’ll manage complex, cross\-functional programs—spanning migrations, onboarding, integrations, and custom enterprise projects—to ensure timely, high\-quality delivery and measurable customer outcomes.
   

  

 This role requires a balance of technical fluency, program leadership, and customer focus. You’ll collaborate closely with Engineering, Product, Professional Services, customer success, and security teams to ensure customers achieve success with Checkmarx’s solutions from implementation through long\-term adoption.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Lead complex, customer\-facing technical programs from planning to execution, ensuring timely and high\-quality delivery.
* Build and optimize program management processes that enhance consistency, visibility, and scalability across global teams.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to align on scope, dependencies, and milestones.
* Drive continuous improvement across operations by identifying gaps and leading change initiatives.
* Provide executive\-level reporting on program progress, metrics, and success outcomes.
* Act as a trusted technical liaison for enterprise customers, ensuring delivery aligns with their architecture and business goals.


 Requirements:
   

  

* 5\+ years of experience managing complex technical programs in SaaS, cybersecurity, or enterprise software.
* Proven track record leading customer delivery programs such as migrations, onboarding, or integrations.
* PMP or Scrum certification preferred.
* Strong technical understanding of system architecture, APIs, SDLC, and integrations.
* Demonstrated experience building scalable delivery frameworks and improving global operational processes.
* Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience reporting to executives.
* Comfortable collaborating across global, cross\-functional teams.
* Familiarity with security and compliance frameworks (SOC 2, FedRAMP, GDPR, ISO 27001\) preferred.


 What we have to offer:
   

  

 Checkmarx offers a great work environment, professional development, challenging careers, competitive compensation, great work\-life balance, as well as great benefits and perks throughout the year. Checkmarx is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, or other characteristics protected by law.

f8c99013.description:
**Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in a customer\-facing role working with stakeholders, driving customer technical implementations or transformation programs.
* Experience supporting customers in cloud operations (e.g., launch or capacity planning, product release management), technical support, escalation management, or consulting.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Experience translating business requirements into technological solutions.
* Experience in application or workload migration to public cloud providers.
* Experience collaborating with teams, groups, business units, channel partners, systems integrators, and third\-party developers to deliver high\-impact solutions.
* Understanding of IT operations, database systems, networking, IT security, application development, service architecture, cloud\-native application development, hosted services, storage systems, or content delivery networks.


**About The Job**
 The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.
   

  

 As a Technical Account Manager (TAM), you will help customers effectively adopt Google Cloud products. You will lead the integration of Google Cloud within organizations, guiding them through the strategic and technical facets of their transformation journey. You will also manage the delivery of Cloud Consulting engagements to drive long\-term customer adoption.
   

  

 In this role, you will regularly engage with various stakeholder groups, including enterprise leaders and cross\-functional, geographically dispersed teams.
   

  

 Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Accelerate customer integration of Google Cloud by leading the implementation journey. Provide technical guidance and manage timelines, milestones, migration goals, and transformation strategies.
* Advocate for customer needs to overcome blockers and influence new feature development. Lead multiple workstreams to maintain momentum.
* Develop strategic relationships with stakeholders to understand business objectives, create roadmaps, and lead quarterly business reviews.
* Plan for customer events and launches by partnering with Support, Engineering, and Site Reliability teams to ensure success.
* Create best practices and assets based on customer engagements to scale initiatives through partners and accelerate cloud utilization.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. c645bb3b.title: Senior DFT Design/Micro architect Engineer, Google Cloud
c645bb3b.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in the implementation and validation of DFT technologies.
* Experience with multiple projects in DFT design and verification, DFT specification, definition, architecture, and insertion.
* Experience with DFT techniques and tools, ASIC DFT synthesis, simulation, and verification flow.
* Experience in leading DFT activities throughout an ASIC development flow.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or Computer Science or a related field.
* Experience in IP integration (e.g., memories, test controllers, Test Access Point (TAP), and DFT for Multi die SoCs).
* Experience in fault modeling.
* Experience in SoC cycles, silicon bringup, and silicon debug activities.

**About the job**
-----------------


In this role, you’ll work to shape the future of AI/ML hardware acceleration. You will have an opportunity to drive cutting\-edge TPU (Tensor Processing Unit) technology that powers Google's most demanding AI/ML applications. You’ll be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's TPU. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide, and leverage your design and verification expertise to verify complex digital designs, with a specific focus on TPU architecture and its integration within AI/ML\-driven systems.



Our computational challenges are so big, complex and unique we can't just purchase off\-the\-shelf hardware, we've got to make it ourselves.


Your team designs and builds the hardware, software and networking technologies that power all of Google's services.  

  

As a Design for Testing (DFT) micro architect/design Engineer, you define, design, analyze the DFT implementation and flow, that supports the systems that are the heart of the world's largest and most powerful computing infrastructure. The team develop from the lowest levels of circuit design to large system design and see those systems all the way through to high volume manufacturing. Your work has the potential to shape the machinery that goes into our cutting\-edge data centers affecting millions of Google users
The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.


We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting\-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world\-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Develop DFT strategy and architecture (e.g., hierarchical DFT, DFT for High speed iOs, Analog DFT).
* Develop and drive die level DFT validation strategy and Complete all Test Design Rule Checks (TDRC) and Design changes to fix TDRC violations to achieve high\-test quality.
* Insert DFT logic, boundary scan, scan chains, DFT Compression, Logic BIST, TAP controller, Clock Control block, and other DFT IP blocks.
* Document DFT architecture, test sequences, and boot\-up sequences associated with test pins.
* Generate and deliver the production and debug patterns to Post Silicon engineering team and run diagnosis for post silicon supports.

### **What You’ll Do and How You’ll Succeed**


**Presales \& Solutioning**


* Lead OSS presales opportunities including RFP/RFI responses, solution design, estimation, and proposals.
* Develop winning strategies and present solutions to senior telecom stakeholders (CxO, VP level).
* Collaborate with sales and account teams to shape large transformation engagements.

**OSS Architecture \& Transformation**


* Design end‑to‑end OSS solutions covering inventory, assurance, fault/performance management, fulfillment, and orchestration.
* Define target‑state OSS architectures aligned with TM Forum ODA, eTOM, and SID standards.
* Evaluate OSS products, platforms, and vendor ecosystems; develop reference architectures and roadmaps.

**Network Automation \& Autonomous Operations**


* Define strategies for autonomous networks leveraging closed‑loop automation, intent‑based orchestration, and self‑healing operations.
* Drive OSS integration with network and operational platforms to improve automation maturity.

**OSS Modernization \& Migration**


* Lead legacy OSS modernization and greenfield OSS implementations.
* Design migration strategies for multi‑vendor environments with minimal disruption.
* Drive inventory reconciliation, data migration, cutover planning, and rollback strategies across RAN, Core, Transport, IP/MPLS, and Optical networks.

**Program Leadership \& Governance**


* Own technical and delivery governance across design, build, testing, deployment, and operations.
* Manage scope, schedules, risks, quality, and financial performance.
* Act as primary technical authority across delivery workstreams and stakeholder groups.
* Establish KPIs, SLAs, dashboards, and steering committee reporting.

**Team Leadership**


* Mentor architects, solution leads, and delivery teams.
* Develop reusable frameworks, accelerators, methodologies, and best practices for OSS engagements.

### **We’d Love to Hear From You If..****.**


**Experience**


* You have 15\+ years of experience in Telecom OSS and Network Operations.
* You have proven presales, consulting, and solution architecture expertise.
* You have led large‑scale OSS transformation, migration, and modernization programs.

**Technical Expertise**


* You have strong knowledge of TM Forum ODA, eTOM, SID, Open APIs, and telecom standards.
* You have hands‑on expertise in OSS domains (Inventory, Assurance, Fulfillment, Service Activation, Orchestration).
* You understand telecom domains (RAN, Core, IP, Transport, Optical).
* You are experienced with network automation, closed‑loop operations, and autonomous networks.

**Ways of Working**


* You excel in stakeholder management and executive presentations.
* You are confident leading multi‑year transformation programs and managed services engagements.
* You mentor teams and drive best practices across OSS delivery.

**Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience with Tier‑1 telecom operators and multi‑vendor OSS ecosystems.
* Certifications in TM Forum, Telecom OSS, Cloud, or Network Automation.

31ec1852.description:
As a **Telecom Architect – AI, Analytics \& Data Engineering**, you will combine deep telecom network expertise with advanced data engineering, analytics, and AI/ML capabilities to deliver next‑generation, data‑driven solutions for Communication Service Providers (CSPs). You will architect and implement telecom analytics platforms, AI‑enabled network solutions, and autonomous network capabilities that improve performance, efficiency, and customer experience.


### **What You’ll Do and How You’ll Succeed**


**Telecom \& Data Architecture**


* Architect and deliver end‑to‑end telecom network and data solutions across RAN, Core, BSC/BTS, and multi‑generation mobile networks (2G/3G/4G/5G).
* Define and implement greenfield architectures while modernising and migrating legacy telecom platforms and data ecosystems.
* Design scalable data pipelines for telecom datasets (CDRs, xDRs, PM/FM counters, telemetry, inventory, topology).

**AI, Analytics \& Autonomous Networks**


* Design AI and data foundations supporting autonomous network initiatives (closed‑loop assurance, self‑optimising networks, intent‑based operations).
* Build and deploy AI/ML models for telecom use cases such as churn prediction, anomaly detection, capacity forecasting, optimisation, and predictive maintenance.
* Architect enterprise data lakes, warehouses, and analytics platforms for batch and real‑time processing.
* Optimise ETL/ELT frameworks with focus on data quality, governance, lineage, and scalability.

**Solutioning \& Delivery Leadership**


* Lead solution design and presales activities including proposals, architecture presentations, effort estimation, and costing.
* Deliver large telecom transformation programs covering design, development, testing, migration, deployment, and rollout.
* Define migration, cutover, and rollback strategies to ensure seamless implementation and business continuity.
* Support post‑production operations by monitoring performance, ensuring SLA adherence, and driving continuous improvements.

**Team Leadership \& Best Practices**


* Mentor technical teams and establish reusable frameworks, accelerators, and methodologies.
* Drive adoption of best practices across telecom analytics and data engineering initiatives.

### **We’d Love to Hear From You If..****.**


**Experience**


* You have 9–14 years of experience in Telecom, Network Services, Data Engineering, Analytics, or AI/ML domains.
* You have strong understanding of telecom network architecture (RAN, Core, BSC/BTS, OSS/BSS, packet and circuit‑switched).
* You have worked with telecom data sources (CDRs, xDRs, PM/FM data, alarms, telemetry, inventory, topology).
* You have led architecture discussions, customer workshops, solutioning, and presales engagements.

**Technical Expertise**


* You have hands‑on experience in data engineering, pipeline development, data lakes, warehouses, and real‑time analytics.
* You are skilled in ETL/ELT frameworks, data governance, and cloud/big data ecosystems.
* You have knowledge of AI/ML model development and deployment for telecom use cases.

**Ways of Working**


* You demonstrate strong stakeholder management, communication, and leadership skills.
* You thrive in customer‑facing consulting and presales engagements.
* You are proactive in bridging telecom expertise with advanced analytics to enable intelligent operations.

**Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience in autonomous networks, network automation, and AI‑driven telecom operations.
* Exposure to cloud platforms and modern data technologies.
* Experience with global telecom operators and CSP customers.

With strong technical acumen and sound judgment, you’ll be responsible for resolving complex infrastructure challenges and driving seamless integration, automation, and reliability across our environments. Your expertise will be especially critical in managing and optimizing systems built on **Microsoft Windows Server**, **Microsoft Remote Desktop Services**, **Microsoft SQL Server**, and **PostgreSQL**, alongside **containerized** and **AWS**\-hosted infrastructure supporting our production SaaS environments, ensuring they operate securely, efficiently, and at scale to support our industry\-leading dealership software solutions.

 **Requirements** **Key Responsibilities**

**Infrastructure Provisioning \& Management**

* Design, build, and maintain secure, scalable Windows Server infrastructure across on\-premises and cloud environments.
* Administer and optimize Remote Desktop Services (RDS) deployments, including Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) environments.
* Manage and maintain Microsoft SQL Server and PostgreSQL database instances, including performance tuning, backups, and patching.
* Participate in upgrades and transitions of customer environments to newer technologies.

**Cloud \& Production Environment Support**

* Provision, secure, and maintain infrastructure within AWS (e.g., EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, RDS, CloudWatch), applying cost\-optimization and security best practices.
* Deploy, manage, and troubleshoot containerized workloads (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes/ECS) to support scalable, portable infrastructure.
* Contribute to and help maintain CI/CD deployment pipelines for each of our application environments, supporting reliable, repeatable releases.
* Support and maintain the underlying infrastructure for our production dealer software environments, ensuring uptime, performance, and reliability for our customers.
* Collaborate across Azure and AWS environments to standardize monitoring, automation, and deployment practices in a multi\-cloud landscape.

**Monitoring \& Optimization**

* Implement centralized monitoring and logging solutions.
* Set up automated alerts and conduct regular performance audits.
* Identify opportunities for automation and efficiency improvements.

**Security \& Compliance**

* Develop and enforce security best practices across on\-premises, Azure, and AWS environments.
* Continuously assess vulnerabilities and implement cybersecurity measures.
* Assist in patch management, system updates, and endpoint protection.

**Collaboration \& Support**

* Provide escalation support for production infrastructure issues.
* Work closely with development teams to improve reliability and performance.
* Document procedures, configurations, and troubleshooting steps.
* Mentor and guide team members across the organization.
* Facilitate knowledge transfer and cross\-training within the team
* Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies to drive innovation and efficiency within the organization.
* Participate in on\-call rotation, after\-hours activities (weekends and evenings), and respond to incidents as needed.

 **The Kind of Candidate we are looking for:**  

  

3\+ years of experience in a Windows support or administration role.

	+ Familiarity with Microsoft Azure (Entra ID, Networking, DevOps, Security) is an asset.

	+ Strong communication and collaboration abilities.

**Benefits**  

Flexible work environment

* Minimum 5 years of experience in cloud engineering, infrastructure management, or cloud operations.


 Bachelor’s degree (B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science/IT) or equivalent experience.

******Physical wellness******

******Personal wellness******
 We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life.

**Job Description**
 The Application Support Engineer – CSD Division will be responsible for providing technical and application support for Agilent's Chemistries and Supplies Division (CSD) portfolio, including chromatography columns, sample preparation products, consumables, reagents, and workflow solutions. The role focuses on enabling customer success through application consulting, method optimization support, troubleshooting, customer training, and close collaboration with sales, service, and product teams.
   

  

 The successful candidate will possess strong analytical chemistry knowledge, hands\-on experience with chromatography workflows, excellent problem\-solving capabilities, and a customer\-centric mindset. This position plays a critical role in helping customers maximize the performance and value of Agilent CSD products while driving customer satisfaction and business growth.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Application \& Technical Support**
* Serve as the primary technical resource for customer inquiries related to Agilent CSD products including HPLC, LC/MS, GC, GC/MS columns, sample preparation products, standards, reagents, and laboratory consumables.
* Provide application guidance and troubleshooting support for chromatography workflows and analytical challenges.
* Assist customers in achieving optimal method performance through product selection and application recommendations.
* Support issue resolution by working closely with customers, field service engineers, and technical support teams.


**Method Development \& Optimization**
* Support customers in developing, transferring, and optimizing analytical methods using Agilent chromatography columns and consumables.
* Provide recommendations on sample preparation, chromatographic separation, method robustness, and productivity improvements.
* Demonstrate best practices for improving analytical performance and laboratory efficiency.


**Customer Training \& Education**
* Conduct customer training programs, workshops, seminars, and webinars on chromatography applications and consumable usage.
* Develop and deliver application\-focused educational content, including technical guides, application notes, presentations, and training materials.
* Promote best practices for method development, troubleshooting, and instrument\-consumable integration.


**Customer Engagement \& Success**
* Partner with sales teams to understand customer requirements and provide application consultation.
* Build strong relationships with customers across pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical, environmental, food, chemical, forensic, academic, and contract testing laboratories.
* Ensure a high level of customer satisfaction through proactive follow\-up and continuous technical support.
* Identify opportunities to improve customer workflows and laboratory productivity using Agilent solutions.


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**
* Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Service, Product Management, and Global Application teams to address customer needs.
* Provide customer feedback, market intelligence, and application insights to support product development and portfolio enhancement initiatives.
* Support new product introductions and technical marketing activities.


**Market \& Competitive Intelligence**
* Stay current with industry trends, regulatory developments, emerging analytical techniques, and competitive technologies.
* Monitor application trends in chromatography and related analytical workflows.
* Support business growth initiatives through identification of customer challenges and opportunities.


**Qualifications**
**Education**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemical Engineering, Life Sciences, or a related scientific discipline.


**Experience**
* Minimum 5 years of relevant laboratory, applications, technical support, or customer\-facing experience.
* Hands\-on experience with HPLC, UHPLC, LC/MS, GC, and/or GC/MS techniques.
* Experience in method development, troubleshooting, and analytical workflow optimization.
* Knowledge of chromatography consumables, sample preparation products, and related laboratory workflows is highly desirable.


**Technical Skills**
* Strong understanding of chromatographic theory and analytical chemistry principles.
* Ability to troubleshoot analytical methods and chromatography\-related issues.
* Familiarity with pharmaceutical, environmental, food, chemical, or applied markets.
* Proficiency in scientific data interpretation and problem\-solving.


**Soft Skills**
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong presentation and customer engagement capabilities.
* Ability to work effectively in cross\-functional and multicultural environments.
* Customer\-focused approach with a passion for helping customers succeed.
* Strong organizational and project management skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience supporting chromatography columns and sample\-preparation products.
* Prior experience in applications support, technical sales support, or customer success roles.
* Demonstrated ability to deliver customer training and technical seminars.


**Additional Details**
 This job has a full time weekly schedule.
   

  

 Our pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. During the hiring process, a recruiter can share more about the specific pay range for a preferred location. Job description:
   

  

 Job Description Enterprise Architect L2 \- Role Overview
 
 As an Enterprise Architect L2 at Wipro Technologies, you will play a crucial role in shaping and overseeing the architectural governance across multiple business programs. This individual contributor role focuses on establishing and enforcing solution governance frameworks to foster standardization, risk mitigation, and streamlined interoperability. Your efforts will ensure that enterprise applications and solutions comply with security standards, regulatory demands, and align tightly with organizational objectives.
 



 Working within the Technology Services sector, under the TTMS \- Tech Transformation \& Adv (ICD) practice, you will help drive architectural consistency while facilitating modernization initiatives that enable transformational growth and cloud readiness. You will be a key influencer, collaborating cross\-functionally with program stakeholders, IT leadership, and technology teams to ensure that the enterprise architecture roadmap reflects both current and future state strategic priorities.
 



 This role is suited for candidates with deep expertise in enterprise\-level architecture and application portfolio rationalization, who demonstrate thought leadership and technical governance capabilities to guide complex modernization programs within a dynamic, innovative environment.
 


 ͏ Primary Responsibilities and Accountabilities
 **Requirement Analysis** 
 Lead the development and enforcement of governance frameworks that guide requirement elicitation across integrated programs, ensuring alignment with compliance policies and solution architectural standards. Facilitate requirement validation sessions to prioritize business and technical needs effectively.
 **Designing and Architecture Validation** 
 Oversee architecture design reviews to validate adherence to security, interoperability, and compliance guidelines. Develop and champion reusable architectural patterns and frameworks that accelerate large\-scale solution delivery while maintaining best practices.
 **Integration Assessment and Support** 
 Formulate and govern integration strategies including API policies, security protocols, and interoperability standards. Monitor integration solutions across multiple programs to ensure optimal performance, reliability, and security compliance.
 **Troubleshooting and Issue Resolution** 
 Identify and analyze repetitive architectural issues impacting solution stability. Recommend and validate corrective measures through governance oversight, ensuring issues are remediated effectively and sustainably.
 **Risk Analysis and Management** 
 Establish a comprehensive risk management framework tailored for enterprise programs, articulating policies, processes, and controls. Conduct impact analyses for significant architectural changes and oversee mitigation planning aligned with security and regulatory requirements. ͏ Additional Contributions and Leadership
 **Request for Proposal (RFP) Support** 
 Provide strategic input to proposals including solution requirements, integration frameworks, risk mitigation strategies, and reusable design assets. Ensure submissions are aligned with client goals, regulatory prerequisites, and performance deliverables.
 **Thought Leadership** 
 Develop and publish whitepapers, frameworks, and points of view that establish Wipro Technologies as an industry leader. Represent the company in external forums, sharing insights into enterprise architectural trends and innovations.
 **Competency Development** 
 Drive team and community competency\-building initiatives through structured learning programs, certifications, and knowledge exchange platforms focused on emerging technologies and architectural best practices. ͏ Key Responsibilities
 * Manage and nurture strategic relationships with executive technology leaders including CIOs, CTOs, and architects to influence and shape enterprise\-wide architectural directions.
* Lead and coordinate Application Portfolio Rationalization efforts, including Discovery, Cloud Readiness Assessments, and crafting comprehensive modernization roadmaps aligned with business strategies.
* Conduct in\-depth application assessments and develop clear retain/retire/rehost/replatform/refactor/replace recommendations to optimize technology investments.
* Provide authoritative technical governance and architectural leadership for cloud migration and modernization projects, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and compliance frameworks.


 Required Skills and Experience
 * 12 to 15\+ years of professional experience in IT consulting, enterprise architecture, or cloud modernization within complex organizations.
* Strong proficiency with Application Portfolio Rationalization (APR) methodologies and enterprise architecture frameworks.
* Expertise in Azure and AWS cloud platforms, including extensive experience in cloud migration strategies and modernization initiatives.
* Skilled in analyzing technical debt, conducting application assessments, and delivering business case and total cost of ownership (TCO) analyses.


 Preferred Certifications
 * TOGAF certification or equivalent enterprise architecture credential highly desirable.


 ͏ Core Competencies and Company Values
 
 As an Enterprise Architect L2 at Wipro Technologies, you are expected to embody and demonstrate the highest level of professional competencies and values that strengthen our collaborative culture and commitment to excellence:
 


* **Being Respectful:** 
 Foster an inclusive environment by appreciating diverse perspectives, promoting equitable interactions, and engaging with empathy towards all colleagues and stakeholders.
* **Building Trust:** 
 Act with integrity, transparency, and reliability to earn and maintain the confidence of clients, peers, and leadership.
* **Demonstrating Stewardship:** 
 Take ownership of architectural governance, guiding technology adoption thoughtfully while safeguarding organizational assets and interests.
* **Always Communicating:** 
 Maintain open, clear, and timely communication across teams and leadership to ensure alignment and inform decision\-making.
* **Being Responsive:** 
 Address challenges, inquiries, and feedback promptly and effectively, adapting to evolving business environments with agility.



 Join Wipro Technologies and contribute to building a modern future where your expertise enables transformative digital journeys. We support your professional growth and inspire continuous reinvention of your skills and career path within a values\-driven, purpose\-led organization.
 



 Mandatory Skills: Enterprise Architecting .
 



  
 



 Experience: \>10 YEARS .
 



  
 



 Reinvent your world. We are building a modern Wipro. We are an end\-to\-end digital transformation partner with the boldest ambitions. To realize them, we need people inspired by reinvention. Of yourself, your career, and your skills. We want to see the constant evolution of our business and our industry. It has always been in our DNA \- as the world around us changes, so do we. Join a business powered by purpose and a place that empowers you to design your own reinvention.

5c102b8a.description:
**Role description**  

Director of Platform Architecture Who We Look For We are looking for a Director of Platform Architect to define, build, and evolve the cloud platform and internal developer platform that underpin UST FinX’s engineering organization. This is a senior, hands\-on technical leadership role — not people management. Your influence comes from designing strong platform foundations, making sound architectural decisions, writing production\-grade code and infrastructure, mentoring engineers, and raising the engineering standard across multiple pods. You own the technical vision for our platform engineering capabilities: AWS architecture, Kubernetes runtime environments, infrastructure as code, GitOps, CI/CD, observability, security, and developer experience. You build reusable capabilities serving multiple teams, products, environments, and client implementations — not one\-off projects. You understand that a platform is an engineering product used by other engineers: it must be secure, reliable, observable, automated, documented, and easy to consume. You stay close to implementation — reviewing architecture, writing code, building infrastructure modules, improving pipelines, and debugging production issues. In an AI\-assisted development environment, you apply strong engineering judgment to validate, refine, and reject generated outputs so components meet strict standards for correctness, resilience, security, and maintainability. We value a 360\-degree collaborative culture where ideas are judged on merit, not hierarchy. We expect architects to constructively challenge designs, simplify complexity, and converge the organization on strong reusable patterns. What You Will Do Define and evolve the technical architecture of the UST FinX cloud platform and internal developer platform. Design and build reusable platform capabilities: cloud foundations, deployment patterns, runtime environments, observability standards, security controls, CI/CD pipelines, and self\-service developer workflows. Work hands\-on with AWS, Kubernetes, IaC, GitOps, CI/CD tooling, observability platforms, and production runtimes. Establish patterns reusable across products, clients, environments, and delivery pods. Guide teams on cloud architecture, networking, IAM, security boundaries, deployment and environment strategy, operational readiness, scalability, and resilience. Contribute production code and infrastructure — reusable modules, platform services, automation, templates, libraries, and reference implementations. Partner with backend, DevOps, QA, product, and client\-facing teams so the platform enables delivery without compromising quality. Mentor engineers through design reviews, code reviews, pairing, and technical direction rather than reporting lines. Define engineering standards for cloud\-native delivery, reliability, observability, automation, governance, and developer experience. Ensure systems are deployable, observable, secure, scalable, recoverable, and maintainable from the start. Reporting Line and Role Context This role reports directly to the CTO of UST FinX. You operate as one of the CTO’s senior technical lieutenants, creating engineering leverage across the organization while remaining deeply hands\-on — influencing multiple pods, establishing reusable standards, mentoring technical leaders, challenging weak designs, and turning technical direction into production\-quality execution. This is neither a passive advisory role nor a traditional people\-management role. Your authority comes from technical credibility, judgment, and execution. You work with the CTO to define standards, identify engineering gaps, raise delivery quality, and ensure architecture is reflected in real code, platforms, and operational behavior — a true force multiplier for the engineering organization. Skills and Experience We Are Looking For Minimum 8 years in software, cloud, platform, or infrastructure architecture; ideally 10–15 years with production platform ownership. Designing and operating production cloud platforms on AWS — multi\-account strategy, networking, IAM, security, workload isolation, environment design, operational controls, and cost\-aware design. Infrastructure as code — AWS CDK preferred; strong Terraform or CloudFormation also relevant. Kubernetes (preferably Amazon EKS): cluster architecture, ingress, scheduling, autoscaling, service discovery, secrets management, deployment strategies, and production operations. GitOps and modern CI/CD: automated deployment, environment promotion, rollback, policy enforcement, and release controls. Observability — metrics, dashboards, logs, traces, ing, SLOs; Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, or OpenTelemetry. Platform engineering and internal developer platforms: golden paths, self\-service workflows, paved roads, templates, and developer experience. Production engineering: reliability, scalability, security, performance, operability, maintainability, and cost efficiency. Communicating architecture, trade\-offs, and risks clearly to globally distributed teams. Mentoring and technical leadership without reliance on formal authority. Comfortable in a global, distributed organization with multiple pods, stakeholders, and time zones. Preferred Qualifications Building internal developer platforms or platform products consumed by multiple teams. Building reusable engineering capabilities rather than project\-specific infrastructure. Service mesh and cloud\-native traffic management. Designing secure multi\-tenant or multi\-environment platforms. Java and Spring Boot, especially where platform capabilities interact with backend services, APIs, or shared libraries. TypeScript, especially for AWS CDK, developer tooling, automation, or platform portals. API\-first architectures, event\-driven systems, microservices, and integration\-heavy enterprise platforms. Financial services, banking, or regulated environments where security, auditability, resilience, and operational control are critical. Policy\-as\-code, security automation, secrets management, supply chain security, vulnerability management, and compliance\-oriented controls. Living with the long\-term consequences of architectural decisions — supporting, patching, scaling, migrating, and evolving a platform after adoption. UST FinX operates as a long\-term transformation partner, not a traditional vendor — reducing operational risk, simplifying complex system landscapes, and delivering measurable outcomes such as faster delivery, improved efficiency, and lower infrastructure cost. We are building the infrastructure layer for the next generation of digital banking.

227386ec.title: Software Solution Architect II
227386ec.description:
**Role description**  

Solution Architect II – Enterprise Solutions Who We Look For We are looking for a Senior Solution Architect to raise backend engineering quality across delivery teams through daily hands\-on contribution, technical leadership, mentoring, and architectural execution. This is a senior hands\-on role, not people management—your influence comes from your code, design judgment, code reviews, and ability to mentor engineers toward production\-ready backend systems. You will guide backend implementation across teams, ensuring architecture becomes clean, maintainable, testable, observable, and scalable software—staying close to the code every day and setting a high bar for production readiness. The role suits someone combining excellent Java and Spring Boot skills with strong distributed\-systems understanding—building services that survive real production conditions. Technical leadership here means working in the details, not producing diagrams alone. In an AI\-assisted development environment, you apply engineering judgment to validate, refine, and sometimes reject generated output, ensuring it still meets strict standards for correctness, resilience, testability, security, and maintainability. We value a merit\-based culture where leads challenge weak designs, simplify complexity, and drive strong engineering practices. What You Will Do Provide hands\-on technical leadership for backend engineering across one or more delivery teams—writing production Java/Spring Boot code while guiding engineers through design, implementation, testing, review, and production readiness. Translate platform architecture and product requirements into well\-designed backend services, APIs, event\-driven components, integrations, and reusable engineering patterns. Review code daily, using reviews to improve correctness, maintainability, design quality, testing, observability, and engineering discipline. Mentor engineers through pairing, design discussions, debugging sessions, and refactoring work. Guide RESTful API design, asynchronous/event\-driven flows, data access layers, service boundaries, error handling, and operational controls. Guide distributed\-systems concerns: consistency, retries, idempotency, concurrency, transaction boundaries, backpressure, resilience, failure isolation, and performance under load. Define and promote testing strategies—unit, integration, contract, component, API, performance, and production validation. Identify and remove technical debt, weak abstractions, poor service boundaries, and fragile integrations. Support production readiness: observable, secure, scalable, resilient, deployable, diagnosable, and maintainable systems. Collaborate with architects, platform, QA, DevOps, product, and client\-facing delivery teams so speed never compromises engineering quality. Raise the engineering standard via reusable examples, reference implementations, coding guidelines, review checklists, and technical documentation. Reporting Line and Role Context This role reports directly to the CTO of UST FinX. You will act as one of the CTO’s senior technical lieutenants—creating engineering leverage while remaining deeply hands\-on: influencing multiple pods, establishing reusable standards, mentoring technical leaders, challenging weak designs, and turning technical direction into production\-quality execution. This is neither a passive advisory role nor traditional people management; your authority comes from technical credibility, judgment, and the ability to make other engineers better. As a force multiplier, you work with the CTO to define standards, identify engineering gaps, raise delivery quality, and ensure architecture is reflected in real code, platforms, and operational behavior across UST FinX. Skills and Experience We Are Looking For Minimum 8 years of professional backend engineering (ideally 10–12\), with meaningful hands\-on ownership of production backend systems. Excellent modern Java: language features, concurrency, collections, error handling, performance, modularity, and maintainable code design. Strong Spring Boot and broader Spring ecosystem: REST APIs, dependency injection, configuration, security, data access, testing, observability, and deployment. Strong distributed systems: latency, partial failure, retries, idempotency, consistency, concurrency, transaction boundaries, backpressure, and operational failure modes. Event\-driven architecture: producers, consumers, event contracts, schema evolution, async processing, replay, retries, dead\-letter handling, and eventual consistency. API design: RESTful design, versioning, validation, error models, pagination, security, documentation, and consumer\-oriented contract discipline. Testing strategies: unit, integration, contract, and component testing, test data management, mocking boundaries, and automated regression protection. Performance tuning: profiling, query optimization, JVM behavior, memory, threads, connection pools, serialization, caching, and high\-throughput behavior. Cloud\-native backend systems, preferably on AWS or equivalent: containers, managed services, CI/CD, observability, and automated deployment. Extensive code review: identifying design flaws, correctness, maintainability, security, performance, and operational risks, plus missing tests. Architecture executed through working code, strong service boundaries, and reusable patterns. Mentoring that raises standards without friction; clear communication of decisions, trade\-offs, and risks to distributed teams. Comfortable in a global, distributed organization with multiple pods, stakeholders, and time zones. Preferred Qualifications Financial services, banking, payments, lending, servicing, compliance, or regulated enterprise environments. Kafka, Redpanda, or equivalent messaging and event\-streaming platforms. Kubernetes and cloud\-native deployment: containerized workloads, autoscaling, service discovery, configuration management, and runtime operations. Observability stacks: Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, structured logging, and ing. Database design and tuning across relational and non\-relational systems: schema, indexing, transactions, and query performance. CI/CD, automated quality gates, static analysis, dependency scanning, deployment automation, and zero\-downtime practices. Domain\-driven design, clean and hexagonal architecture, modular monoliths, microservices, and service decomposition. Reusable backend frameworks, shared libraries, platform components, and reference implementations consumed by multiple teams. Security\-aware development: authentication, authorization, OAuth2/OIDC, secrets handling, input validation, auditability, and least\-privilege design. Large, complex, evolving codebases where maintainability and refactoring discipline matter—living with the long\-term consequences of engineering decisions: supporting, debugging, scaling, migrating, and evolving critical production systems.

 **Skills**  

Code Review, Distributed Systems, Domain\-Driven Design, Java, Kubernetes, Microservices, Observability, OpenTelemetry, Performance Tuning, Event\-Driven Architecture, REST

UST is a global digital transformation solutions provider. For more than 20 years, UST has worked side by side with the world’s best companies to make a real impact through transformation. 6e65bffc.description:
**Role description**  

Principal Architect — Data Platform \& Lakehouse Who We Look For We are looking for a Principal Architect — Data Platform \& Lakehouse to own the technical direction of enterprise data architecture, Apache Iceberg\-based lakehouse capabilities, metadata, analytical infrastructure, and document management across the UST FinX platform. This is a senior, hands\-on architecture and engineering role — not advisory or governance\-only. Your influence comes from designing scalable platforms, building reusable frameworks, defining strong architecture patterns, writing production\-grade code, and guiding teams to deliver data infrastructure that is reliable, secure, governed, observable, and usable. You understand that a lakehouse is more than a storage bucket with query access: it requires table\-format discipline, catalog architecture, data modeling, schema and partition evolution, metadata management, governance, access control, lifecycle management, performance tuning, and clear ownership of data products. You stay close to implementation — writing Java, building frameworks, reviewing data contracts, debugging pipelines, and evolving catalog and metadata capabilities. In an AI\-assisted development environment, you apply strong engineering judgment to validate, refine, and sometimes reject generated output, ensuring components meet high standards for correctness, resilience, security, scalability, and maintainability. We value a collaborative, merit\-driven culture and expect senior architects to constructively challenge weak designs, simplify complexity, and converge teams on strong reusable patterns. What You Will Do Define and evolve the data platform and lakehouse architecture strategy for UST FinX. Own the technical architecture for Apache Iceberg\-based lakehouse capabilities — table design, catalog integration, schema and partition evolution, metadata, compaction, snapshots, retention, performance, and governance. Build reusable patterns, frameworks, and reference implementations for ingestion, storage, metadata, data access, document management, analytics, and table lifecycle management. Provide technical ownership for enterprise data architecture across platform, integration, and orchestration services, document repositories, and analytical platforms. Guide teams on Iceberg table design, catalog selection, partitioning, query performance, data lifecycle, and multi\-tenant isolation. Define standards for data contracts, metadata, lineage, governance, retention, access control, and data quality. Work hands\-on with Java\-based platform services, ingestion frameworks, metadata services, and storage abstractions. Partner with backend, platform, data, security, DevOps, and QA engineers plus product and delivery teams to ship reliable, governed, production\-ready capabilities. Mentor engineers through design and code reviews, pairing, and incident analysis. Ensure data systems are secure, scalable, resilient, observable, cost\-aware, and suitable for regulated banking environments. Reporting Line and Role Context This role reports directly to the CTO of UST FinX. You will operate as one of the CTO’s senior technical lieutenants — creating engineering leverage across the organization while remaining deeply hands\-on. You will influence multiple pods, establish reusable standards, mentor technical leaders, and turn technical direction into production\-quality execution. This is not a passive advisory or traditional people\-management role; your authority comes from technical credibility, judgment, and execution. You will work closely with the CTO to define standards, identify engineering gaps, raise delivery quality, and ensure architecture is reflected in real code and operational behavior — a true force multiplier for the engineering organization. Skills and Experience We Are Looking For Minimum 8 years (ideally 10–15\) in software, data, platform engineering, or architecture, with meaningful ownership of production\-scale data platforms. Strong experience designing and implementing large\-scale lakehouse platforms in production. Deep experience with Apache Iceberg — snapshots, schema and partition evolution, hidden partitioning, compaction, time travel, table maintenance, and query performance. Strong knowledge of lakehouse catalog and metadata layers (AWS Glue Data Catalog, Hive Metastore, Nessie, REST catalogs, or equivalent). Experience with object\-storage\-based platforms — storage layout, lifecycle policies, encryption, access control, cost management, and raw/curated/governed/analytical zone separation. Strong metadata management skills — cataloging, lineage, schema management, discoverability, governance, and auditability. Experience building ingestion pipelines across batch, streaming, event\-driven, CDC, file\-, and API\-based patterns. Strong Java background — designing, implementing, reviewing, and debugging production platform and infrastructure code. Understanding of multi\-tenant architectures — tenant isolation, access boundaries, metadata separation, and operational controls. Understanding of data governance — ownership, classification, retention, access control, lineage, data quality, and regulatory expectations. Experience supporting analytics — data modeling, query tuning, semantic layers, and BI integration. Experience building reusable frameworks and shared libraries consumed by multiple teams. Strong communication and mentoring skills to raise data architecture maturity across globally distributed teams without relying on formal authority. Preferred Qualifications AWS data platforms (S3, Glue, Lake Formation, Athena, EMR, Redshift, Kinesis, MSK, Lambda, IAM, KMS). Spark, Flink, Trino, Presto, Dremio, Snowflake, Databricks, or equivalent processing and analytical technologies. Iceberg operational tooling — table optimization, snapshot expiration, orphan file removal, compaction, and catalog migration — across multiple query engines. Document management infrastructure — object\-backed storage, metadata indexing, lifecycle, retention, search, and workflow/case\-management integration. Event\-driven ingestion — Kafka or Redpanda, schema registries, event contracts, CDC, and transactional outbox. Data platforms for financial services, banking, payments, lending, compliance, or regulated enterprise environments. API\-first, data\-product\-oriented architectures with governed access APIs. Observability for data platforms — pipeline metrics, data quality checks, freshness, ing, and dashboards. CI/CD, automated testing, data contract testing, and production\-readiness practices. Security patterns — IAM, encryption, secrets management, network isolation, and row\-/object\-level access control. Experience living with the long\-term consequences of data architecture decisions — supporting, scaling, migrating, and evolving critical production platforms.

03c366d9.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


We're seeking an experienced Technical Program Manager to lead critical programs within Risk and Compliance Solutions (RCS).
  

RCS serves as a crucial safeguard for Amazon's buyers, brands, and selling partners while ensuring business teams meet their regulatory obligations. Operating under the Three Lines of Defense (3LoD) model, RCS functions as the second line of defense, providing specialized oversight, monitoring, and expertise while setting policies and procedures that guide Amazon's compliance framework.  

RCS's mission is to leverage specialist industry insights and Amazon's unique approach to scale through technology, delighting customers through tailored compliance solutions. Our work spans multiple critical areas, including:  

* Enabling Amazon's financial services expansion through streamlined license acquisition
* Managing existing business risks across the organization
* Delivering comprehensive governance, risk, and assurance services
* Developing innovative solutions like Compliance as a Service (CaaS)
* Transforming compliance operations into a proactive, intelligence\-led framework

  

Role Overview:  

We're seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager (TPM) to lead scalable technology solutions delivery that transform how Amazon approaches compliance and risk management. This role is critical for RCS's mission to scale compliance operations through technology, reduce manual processes, and enable Amazon's global expansion while maintaining regulatory compliance.  

At Amazon, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate and build on behalf of our customers. The focus we have on our customers is why we are one of the world's most beloved brands – customer obsession is part of our company DNA. Our TPM use technology to drive complex programs and get to see the impact of their work first\-hand. The challenges you'll solve are big and influence millions of customers, sellers, and products around the world.
  

We are looking for individuals who are passionate about driving alignment and execution leveraging their technical domain knowledge, strong program management fundamentals, and trusted partnerships while managing ambiguity and the pace of a company where development cycles are measured in weeks, not years.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Lead complex technical programs across RCS's end\-to\-end regulatory compliance applications and regulatory reporting
* Drive the implementation of AI/ML\-powered compliance solutions, including automated horizon scanning, predictive control frameworks, and automated controls testing.
* Manage cross\-functional programs that integrate GenAI capabilities across RCS.
* Partner with engineering teams and business stakeholders to transform manual compliance processes into automated, scalable solutions
* Coordinate with global regulatory teams to ensure technology solutions meet compliance requirements
* Drive technical integration initiatives with other Amazon teams to leverage core services
* Establish and track program metrics that demonstrate compliance effectiveness and operational efficiency
* Lead programs that enable streamlined license acquisition for Amazon's financial services expansion
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 7\+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 5\+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 3\+ years of software development experience
* 5\+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5\+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi\-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership
* Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science or equivalent

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. 4b5c192d.title: Course5i - AI Solutions Architect
4b5c192d.description:
**About C5i**
 Founded in 2000, C5i enables organisations to make the most effective strategic and tactical moves relating to their customers, markets and competition, at the pace the digital business world demands. We build AI products : Agent5i, our enterprise agentic AI system; Compete, digital shelf analytics for brands selling through retail; Incivus, creative effectiveness for marketing teams; and Synthetic Audiences, virtual respondents for research teams who need an answer faster than a panel can return one. Each has its own users, roadmap, release cycle and stack today, running across Azure, AWS and GCP.
   

  

**What We Seek**
 You sit between what the products need to do and which method will actually do it. This is an internal product seat : no customer calendar, no pre\-sales. The work is generative and agentic by default. Agent decomposition, tool and function contracts, orchestration, context assembly, retrieval design, guardrails and evaluation. Fine\-tuning and domain\-specific small models where they beat prompting on cost or accuracy. Knowing which to reach for, and recognising when none of them is the answer, is most of the job.
   

  

 Every capability as a feature resolves to one of three things : a pattern the products already support, something worth building once and using across all four, or a no. You make that call before engineering commits to it. Getting it wrong in the generous direction is how a product ends up with four implementations of the same idea.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on seat. You will specify an architecture and prototype it yourself in the same week. A design that reads well and cannot be built is a failure, and so is a method that works in a notebook and falls over at ten thousand users. The domain moves with the product : retail and consumer goods in Compete, marketing in Incivus, research in Synthetic Audiences, and whatever Agent5i lands in next. Depth in method transfers, depth in a single industry does not, and we are hiring for the former. Your designs become constraints for the Full Stack Architect and the Cloud and Data Architect, so involving both early is expected rather than optional.
   

  

 Yes, that means reading Papers with Code, working out which of it holds, and turning the one paper in twenty that does into a feature the products can ship. That is Applied AI in this seat. Wiring up tool calls is not.
   

  

**How We Work**
 Flat. Three things decide whether you succeed here, and we weight them above any line on your CV.
   

  

* Proactivity : Nobody hands you a scoped problem. Find where a product is losing to its own method, size it, decide whether it is worth solving now, then design it. The same applies to research : much of what is published is not production\-ready, and saying so in week one rather than after three months of build is part of what this seat is for.
* Adaptability : The domain changes with the product and the methods change faster. Model providers change, agent frameworks are superseded, roadmaps move. Treat the churn as normal rather than as a planning failure.
* Accountability : You own the outcome from design to production, not the design. There is no handover at specification. You stay with it through build and evaluation, and if the estimate was wrong it was your estimate. Delegation to the engineering team is not available.


**What You Will Own**
* Method selection : whether prompting, retrieval, fine\-tuning, a domain\-specific small model or none of them is right for a given capability, across all four products.
* Core, shared or no : whether a capability belongs in one product, is worth building once for all four, or should not be built at all.
* Agentic system design : agent decomposition, tool and function contracts, orchestration, context assembly, guardrails and human\-in\-the\-loop points.
* Retrieval and domain model strategy : hybrid retrieval, chunking and reranking, and fine\-tuning or domain\-specific small models where they beat prompting on cost or accuracy.
* Evaluation strategy : success criteria agreed with product before build, including golden sets, acceptance thresholds and regression suites.
* Feasibility and estimation : what a roadmap item costs to build and what it costs to serve, established before it is committed.
* Prototypes and method assessment : fast calls on whether an approach is worth pursuing, and on which published research is production\-ready.
* Continuity through build, with the Full Stack Architect and the Cloud and Data Architect involved early rather than at specification handover.


**Must Have**
* 8\-12 years in applied machine learning with production ownership. Bachelors or masters in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field.
* Four or more AI products or platforms taken from design to production and scaled to a live user base between 1,000 and 100,000\.
* Shipped generative AI to production users with accountability for the outcome : retrieval\-augmented generation, agentic workflows, tool and function calling, structured output.
* Current working knowledge of agentic patterns, retrieval architectures, fine\-tuning approaches and model evaluation.
* Evaluation design : golden sets, acceptance thresholds, regression suites and human review loops.
* Able to reach working depth in an unfamiliar business domain fast enough to design for it.
* Has written code recently and can still do so.
* Judgement to decline a method that would work once and not generalise.


**Good To Have**
* Domain\-specific language model or retrieval system design.
* Cost modeling for inference at scale : token economics, unit cost per query, caching and routing strategy.
* Evaluation harnesses or benchmark suites built for other teams to reuse.
* Responsible AI governance and model risk practice.
* More than one product domain : consumer goods, retail, marketing, pharma or supply chain.
* Published work, patents or conference contribution.


**On The Experience Band**
 The band is deliberate. Above it we consistently meet people who have optimised for depth in a settled environment, or who have moved far enough from implementation that design has come to mean specification. Neither works here.
