14f90188.title: Principal Solution Consultant
14f90188.description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.

**The Role**
------------


As a Principal Solution Consultant, you will partner with AspenTech sales teams during the sales cycle to lead consultative discovery process with customers, craft a vision and roadmap of a solution that addresses customer requirements, identifying differentiated value capture potential, and an implementation/sustainment program for that solution. This involves maintaining a keen understanding of the AspenTech product strategy, value enablers, professional services and partner execution capabilities, and sales pipeline to drive opportunities where AspenTech solutions can bring significant business value to our customers and to AspenTech.  

  

The Principal Solution Consultant is responsible for delivering high quality solutions and business outcomes based on existing AspenTech Asset Performance Management (APM) solutions focused on Oil \& Gas (O\&G), Chemical industries and also Growth Industries in Power, Mining, Food \& Beverages positioning the broader AspenTech portfolio, including data historian, advanced process control and data fabric.  

  

Demonstrating deep knowledge of the solutions and offerings, capable of contributing to the design of a complete solution across the entire lifecycle of a project \- from pre\-sales through design and delivery of the solution \- the Principal Solution Consultant drives transformational results and realizes business strategy for AspenTech customers.  

  

This is a customer facing role that requires self\-motivated individuals with excellent business, industry and technical knowledge along with strong consultative and communication skills to position AspenTech solutions and services with our customers.**Your Impact**
---------------

* Develop O\&G and eventually other segments in the Asia Pacific Japan (APJ) industry and APM application specific solutions for the customer. This is a very client\-facing position that will have you leading value discovery customer sessions, assessing customer needs, and developing solutions and value propositions.
* Determine and understand prospective client’s critical business issues in order to present and demonstrate AspenTech’s software capabilities as the best possible solution to win the business with focus on technical solution, business value and competitive differentiation.
* Build client specific solutions on the AspenTech platform using all the available tool options.
* Develop robust recommendations, proposals and scope of work documents for AspenTech Consulting engagements while also identifying critical dependencies \& gaps.
* Accountable to consult with customers and advise on the relevant AspenTech solutions, services and establish a credible value proposition.
* Develop \& execute sales campaigns and plans together with the sales teams.
* Work with the Sales team to identify and qualify business opportunities, to identify key customer technical challenges and to develop solutions to meet the business needs.
* Proactively support pipeline development (e.g. marketing, account planning, awareness sessions, etc.) and sales execution in the assigned accounts and opportunities.

**What You'll Need**
--------------------

* Bachelor Degree in Chemical Engineering or any equivalent discipline.
* Previous consultant, pre\-sales, professional services consultant type of role particularly in Oil \& Gas, Chemicals and Asset Performance Management experience.
* Experience with Machine Learning \& Artificial Intelligence applications as applied in Engineering companies.
* Basic Knowledge of data historian, MES integration and Advanced Process Control and Data Fabric.
* Strong knowledge of industry processes, challenges, and evolving trends.
* Understanding of cloud, SaaS solutions, ML/AI and the impact of these solutions in the Engineering industry
* Candidates will have a strong understanding of Oil \& Gas industry economics with an ability to interact with potential clients and talk knowledgeably about their work processes.
* Balance of business and technology acumen, including ability to articulate high\-level technical solutions to business problems and the differentiated value those solutions can provide.
* Outstanding problem solving and analytical skills, including ability to create clear observations, analysis and conclusions based on customer interviews and data.
* Regional experience with Asia preferable. Occasional global engagements outside primary operational region.
* Previous knowledge and experience with Python is a plus.
* Previous experience in technical sales and/or operations
* Travel within region approximately 50 \- 60%.

9fd26cf9.title: Application Consultant-IBM Cloud Migration
9fd26cf9.description:
**Introduction**
 A career in IBM Consulting is built on long\-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long\-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
   

  

**Your Role And Responsibilities**
 As an Application Consultant for Cloud Migration, you will play a key client\-facing leadership role in developing and delivering cloud migration solutions. You will lead the development of migration platform solutions for hybrid\-cloud environments, including IBM Cloud Private and IBM Cloud Platform, based on client priorities and business benefits.
   

  

**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include**
* Lead Migration Solution Development: Lead the development of migration solutions for hybrid cloud platforms, including on\-prem, off\-prem, and dedicated cloud environments, in collaboration with client representatives.
* Build Migration Strategy: Lead the team in building migration strategies based on value vs. effort, and prepare cost\-benefit models and inputs to ROI analysis.
* Collaborate with Vendors/Partners: Lead discussions with migration vendors/partners to determine solution\-based tools/vendors specialties, including what vendor/tool, when, why, and benefits.
* Contribute to Migration Methodology: Significantly contribute to migration methodology and tailor methods to client environments and industries.
* Deliver Solution Design: Lead the team in delivering migration solution designs, including effort estimation, costing, staffing, client negotiations, and tailoring solutions to meet client budgetary guidelines.


**Preferred Education**
 Master's Degree
   

  

**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**
* Cloud Migration Solution Development: Exposure to leading the development of migration platform solutions for hybrid\-cloud environments, including IBM Cloud Private and IBM Cloud Platform.
* Hybrid Cloud Migration: Experience working with migration solutions for hybrid cloud platforms, including on\-prem, off\-prem, and dedicated cloud environments.
* Migration Strategy Development: Exposure to building migration strategies based on value vs. effort, and preparing cost\-benefit models and inputs to ROI analysis.
* Vendor/Partner Collaboration: Experience working with migration vendors/partners to determine solution\-based tools/vendors specialties.
* Migration Methodology: Exposure to contributing to migration methodology and tailoring methods to client environments and industries.


**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**
* Cloud Migration Methodology: Exposure to contributing to migration methodology and tailoring methods to client environments and industries, with the ability to adapt to changing client needs.
* Hybrid Cloud Platforms: Experience working with migration solutions for hybrid cloud platforms, including on\-prem, off\-prem, and dedicated cloud environments, with a focus on delivering client\-centric solutions.
* Migration Solution Design: Exposure to delivering migration solution designs, including effort estimation, costing, staffing, client negotiations, and tailoring solutions to meet client budgetary guidelines.

**Position Summary**

**Level: Oracle Cloud PPM \-** 
**Senior Consultant, Functional Transformation**
 As a Senior Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will design, develop, and deploy enterprise\-scale software solutions, lead the creation of robust pipelines and manage code deployment across environments. You will collaborate with cross\-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective deliverables, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high\-quality and timely delivery of solutions.
   

  

**Work You’ll Do**
 As an Oracle Senior Consultant, you will be involved in the implementation of Oracle Projects processes. Responsibilities include:
   

  

* Developing programs across all RICEFW components and process areas, ensuring high\-quality deliverables in line with our CMMI\-certified standards.
* Reviewing functional specifications, preparing technical documentation, translating requirements into efficient code, and performing thorough technical unit testing.
* Maintaining comprehensive documentation throughout the build phase and actively participating in review processes, including self and peer reviews.
* Capturing minutes of meetings (MOM) during technical reviews.
* Actively participate in staff recruitment and retention activities; provide support for delivery teams and staff in local offices.


**The Team**
 Deloitte’s Oracle Enterprise Solutions practice provides services from ERP and Cloud Strategy, through Business Transformation and Applications Implementation, to Operate and Cloud Release Management. We modernize our client’s business and core environments to leverage technology innovations around Cloud, Digital, Mobility, and Social Collaboration. Our team helps clients address digital transformation by designing modern applications and industry\-specific solutions to deliver outcomes that improve flexibility, scalability, and cost management.
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**
* 6 to 10 years of experience in the implementation of Oracle Projects processes.
* Well\-versed with Oracle modules of Project Costing, Project Billing, Project Management, Project Contracts, Project Resource Management, Grants Accounting.
* Professional with at least 2 end\-to\-end implementations.
* Good working knowledge of modules interacting with Oracle projects like Payables, Fixed Assets, Receivables, Time \& Labor.
* Demonstrated experience as a senior resource assisting in the definition of systems strategy, gathering and documenting business requirements, leading fit\-gap analysis, as\-is and to\-be business process designs, conference room pilots (CRPs), functional configuration, testing, client user training.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple task assignments.
* Strong oral and written communication skills, including presentation skills (MS Visio, MS PowerPoint).
* A Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Engineering, Business, Finance, or Accounting.


**Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**
* Well\-versed with Microsoft Project plan or equivalent.


**Education:**
* BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from an accredited university.


**Location:**
* Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai

 We’re looking for Senior Managers (Senior Data Architects) with strong technology and data understanding having proven Pre\-sales \& Delivery capability. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm as well as a part of a growing Consulting Business.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Architecture \& Solutioning
+ Design and propose cloud\-based data and AI solutions that align with customer objectives and solve business challenges.
+ Architect and implement data platforms that support real\-time, batch, and hybrid analytics.
+ Recommend design alternatives for data ingestion, processing, and provisioning layers.
+ Define and develop client\-specific best practices around data management in cloud environments.
+ Translate business problems into data models, analytics pipelines, and BI/ML solutions.
+ Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure data security, scalability, and performance.
+ Responsible for creating Thought Leadership and Prototypes across horizontals and industry use cases.
+ Articulate examples of Modern Data Platforms, AI Ready Data

* Data Engineering \& Development
+ Develop standardized practices for delivering new products and capabilities using Big Data \& cloud technologies.
+ Design and develop data ingestion programs for large datasets in batch mode using data bricks, cloud DBs, PySpark, Python and Orchestration tools.
+ Build real\-time ingestion pipelines using Apache Kafka, Spark Streaming, and related technologies.
+ Lead the development of data Lakehouse architectures, streaming pipelines, and data integration frameworks.
+ Design and develop high\-quality, efficient, testable code in Python and other languages.

* Governance, Quality \& Patterns
+ Define and implement data governance, lineage, and quality frameworks.
+ Guide teams on various modern data design patterns, e.g.:
- ETL/ELT
- Lambda/Kappa Architecture
- Data Vault \& Dimensional Modelling
- Streaming Data Pipelines
- CQRS
- Change Data Capture (CDC)
- Schema Evolution
- Immutable Data
- Polyglot Persistence

* Leadership \& Client Engagement
+ Interact with senior client technology leaders to understand business goals and propose solutions.
+ Lead technical delivery, including effort estimation, solution design, and team management.
+ Develop and present PoCs, demos, and technical proposals to stakeholders and clients.
+ Build and mentor technical teams and contribute to capability development.
+ Experience in managing delivery teams and career transformations of the people.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong understanding of cloud ecosystems (Azure, AWS, GCP) and distributed computing paradigms.
* Hands\-on experience with:
+ Azure Data Services: Synapse, ADF, ADB, Azure SQL, Data Lake, Microsoft Fabric
+ Programming: Python, PySpark, SQL
+ Proficient in Databricks / Snowflake
+ Streaming: Kafka, Event Hubs, Spark Streaming
+ BI Tools: Power BI, Tableau

* Comprehensive applied knowledge of:
+ Data modelling (dimensional, vault)
+ Data governance, metadata management, and data observability
+ Performance tuning

* Strong stakeholder management and ability to bridge business and technical teams.
* Exposure to AI/ML platforms: Azure Machine Learning, Cognitive Services, Azure OpenAI.


**To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have**
* Minimum 14\+ years of industry experience, with 7\+ years in data architecture and analytics.
* Proven experience in enterprise\-grade solution implementations.
* Experience in working \& managing global stakeholders.
* Should have driven significant business outcomes as a part of their role.
* Strong understanding and hands\-on experience in data strategy, cloud\-native architectures, and analytics modernization.
* Have deep Pre\-sales experience leading and supporting deals
* Experience in responding to RFPs/RFIs, creating technical documentation, and leading solution design workshops.


**Ideally, You’ll Also Have**
* Pre\-sales, client management skills.
* Experience in solutioning and pre\-sales engagements.
* Exposure to data mesh principles and domain\-oriented data product design.
* Familiarity with data fabric, data mesh and multi\-cloud data strategies.
* Familiarity with real\-time analytics


**What We Look For**
* People with technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
   

  

 You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

9e24f5aa.description:
**About Atos Group**
 Atos Group is a global leader in digital transformation with c. 63,000 employees and annual revenue of c. €8 billion, operating in 61 countries under two brands — Atos for services and Eviden for products. European number one in cybersecurity, cloud and high performance computing, Atos Group is committed to a secure and decarbonized future and provides tailored AI\-powered, end\-to\-end solutions for all industries. Atos Group is the brand under which Atos SE (Societas Europaea) operates. Atos SE is listed on Euronext Paris.
   

  

 The purpose of Atos Group is to help design the future of the information space. Its expertise and services support the development of knowledge, education and research in a multicultural approach and contribute to the development of scientific and technological excellence. Across the world, the Group enables its customers and employees, and members of societies at large to live, work and develop sustainably, in a safe and secure information space.
   

  

**About Eviden**
 Eviden is the Atos Group brand for hardware and software products with c. € 1 billion in revenue, operating in 36 countries and comprising four business units advanced computing, cybersecurity products, mission\-critical systems and vision AI. As a next\-generation technology leader, Eviden offers a unique combination of hardware and software technologies for businesses, public sector and defense organizations and research institutions, helping them to create value out of their data. Bringing together more than 4,500 world\-class talents and holding more than 2,100 patents, Eviden provides a strong portfolio of innovative and eco\-efficient solutions in AI, computing, security, data and applications.
   

  

 We are looking for Presales Consultant, please find the JD below
   

  

**Presales Consultant**
**Type of Hire** 
 Full\-Time
   

  

**Min** 
 12\+ yrs
   

  

**Role Summary**
 The Presales expert TM – Presales \& Execution plays a pivotal role in the end\-to\-end deal lifecycle, with a primary focus on the presales phase of large, complex IT outsourcing opportunities ranging from £10M to £200M\+ TCV. Acting as the transition solution owner during bids, this role is responsible for designing, validating, and costing transition and transformation programs that are commercially sound, operationally feasible, and aligned with client\-specific requirements.
   

  

 As part of the presales team, the Senior Transition Manager leads transition solutioning and potential due diligence efforts, defines transition strategies, and ensures seamless alignment between solution design and delivery capability. This individual works collaboratively with sales, solution architects, and delivery teams to create robust, end\-to\-end solutions that ensure cost control, risk mitigation, and high\-quality service readiness.
   

  

 In the execution phase, the role ensures the smooth handover of transition plans to delivery teams, supporting early\-stage execution through structured governance, knowledge transfer, and oversight to protect solution integrity and client outcomes.
   

  

* Presales Responsibilities (Primary Focus – 70%)
* Lead the transition solution stream in RFPs, RFIs, and proactive proposals by engaging early with the Sales and Solutioning teams.
* Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders (Sales, Solution Managers, Delivery / Practice Heads, Finance, HR, Legal) to define/validate a transition approach that supports the proposed operating model.
* Develop detailed transition blueprints, high\-level / detailed project plans, staffing models, timelines, risk registers, and assumptions aligned with customer requirements.
* Participate in customer due diligence activities, validating current state operations, capturing transition\-specific constraints, and identifying transformation levers.
* Own and prepare the transition cost model, ensuring alignment with delivery feasibility, internal benchmarks, and bid financial targets.
* Present and defend the transition solution during orals, client presentations, and contract negotiations, articulating the value, approach, risk mitigations, and success criteria.
* Evaluate the readiness of delivery units to execute the proposed transition and identify capability gaps or dependencies.
* Act as a key interface to Delivery Assurance and Risk \& Compliance teams to ensure adherence to Atos governance, legal, and risk management standards.
* Coordinate with the Bid Manager to ensure solution compliance with Atos presales processes (Win2Deliver, RAINBOW etc) while aligning to the Solution to win benchmarks.
* Drive integration of transition and transformation elements into a comprehensive delivery program, ensuring traceability from solution to execution.
* Validate and challenge transformation components (where applicable) to ensure scope, complexity, and dependencies are accurately reflected.
* Support creation of transition\-specific bid artefacts solution write\-ups, SOW inputs, RAID log, governance model, service readiness criteria, and delivery ramp\-up plans.
* Transition Execution Responsibilities (Secondary Focus – 30%)
* Translate bid commitments into execution\-ready transition project plans with aligned workstreams, deliverables, and milestones.
* Ensure smooth handover from presales to delivery by onboarding Transition Project Managers and briefing delivery leads on assumptions, dependencies, and risks.
* Provide ongoing advisory and oversight during initial stages of transition to ensure alignment with bid intent.
* Escalate any deviations or delivery risks identified post\-handover and ensure appropriate mitigation actions are taken.
* Support transition execution governance, helping define escalation paths, program dashboards, and client reporting formats.


**Experience**
* Overall 12\-20 years of experience working in IT service organization
* Should have at least one project management certification (PgMP/PMP/Prince 2 Practitioner/MSP)
* 8\-10 years of experience in Transition management functions within IT or Outsourcing
* Strong client\-facing and management Skills
* Proven track record in an international environment or projects
* Domain expertise is a big plus (Manufacturing, Healthcare, Telecom)


**Key Skills**
* Strong communication and stakeholder management at senior leadership and client executive levels.
* Commercial and financial acumen with ability to balance delivery feasibility and bid competitiveness.
* Strong problem\-solving, analytical thinking, and solution structuring abilities.
* Ability to work across geographies and collaborate with diverse, matrixed teams.


**Technical Skills**
* Educated to university level (e.g. Bachelor or Master). Preferably engineering degree in Computer Science/Information systems or related field, plus 7 \+ years directly related experience in IT Infrastructure/Application technical program leadership, as well as in solution development and delivery.
* Minimum of 3 years working in a large international services and IT service support organization on transitioning large contracts.
* Experience in Application Lifecycle, Agile Processes \& Methodologies, IT Infra support (Digital Workplace, Data centre technologies, etc.)
* Strong complex solution lead experience dealing with internal Delivery
* Demonstrated ability to work with large multi–regional cross technology work streams.
* Comfortable working with all levels of a business or IT organization.
* Transitioning enterprise\-wide services from legacy solutions to virtual and cloud\-based solution.


**Leadership Skills**
* Provides guidance and direction to execute project reviews and evaluation with senior stakeholders.
* Leads large (10\-50 staff), geographically dispersed, multi\-cultural, multi\-disciplined project teams, including more than one sub\-contractor in a consortium scenario, and where the solution/ technology is immature and/or leading edge.
* Actively coaches others. Creates team spirit and a supportive environment.
* Acts as role model.


**Project Organization**
* Plans and controls very complex portfolios of projects.
* Defines risk strategies, approaches and tools. Identifies and manages risks, issues and assumptions on portfolio of complex projects.
* Influences senior stakeholders to apply and/or adapt Atos standards to the project to maximize effectiveness.
* Manages handover including proposal for reallocation of staff and disposal of assets not included in handover.
* Promotes continuous improvement.


**Delivery Management**
* Efficiently engages with senior stakeholders to agree/influence strategy, directing complex projects and maximizing benefits.
* Defines project requirements/scope with senior stakeholders maximizing Atos’s commercial position and client value.
* Maintains a view on the bigger picture.
* Able to judge complex risk analysis and translate to possible solutions. Has a clear vision on factors that influence strategic decision making, initiating/driving development of innovative products and services.
* Maximizes effectiveness while achieving standards, ensuring control of deliverables.


**Relationship Management**
* Builds relationships with customers based on mutual trust and respect. Monitors performance targets and deadlines in addition to quality standards. Tailors Atos products to best\-fit customer needs.
* Demonstrates strong consistency between communication and action. Is sought out for advice and solutions. Recognises potential areas of conflict and leads resolution.
* Promotes cross\-functional team working. Ensures that common goals are understood.
* Communicates complex information. Commands attention and can manage large groups. Actively engages and manages stakeholder community.


**Commercial Drive**
* Produces budgets and identifies controls to maintain a profitable environment. Identifies and pursues opportunities to create added value for the client and Atos.
* Leads an effective overall change control and approval by Change Control Board, updates and coordinates the project plan. Can propose and implement changes with senior stakeholders.
* Leads projects with respect to revenue and margin, team size, geographical spread, sub\-contractor terms, risk profile and diverse technologies.
* Leads excellent client relationship balanced with the Atos commercial position, utilizing strategic negotiations where appropriate.


**Let’s grow together.**

**Overview**
------------

**Platform Infrastructure Architect**
=====================================

**Core Apps** **Location:** Hyderabad, India \| **Remote**

**About the Role**
------------------


The Platform Infrastructure Architect designs, standardizes, and continuously improves the core infrastructure platforms that support enterprise applications, operational services, and business\-critical environments. This role provides technical leadership for operating systems, virtual machine templates, monitoring and observability platforms, database infrastructure, and automation frameworks.


The ideal candidate has strong infrastructure engineering experience, thinks strategically about architecture, creates clear documentation, applies security best practices, and can turn operational needs into scalable, reliable, and supportable platform standards.

**Your Role Responsibilities? Here's What You'll Do.**
------------------------------------------------------

* Lead the design and improvement of automation solutions using **PowerShell, Ansible, and Python** that reduce manual work, improve consistency, and strengthen configuration control across enterprise infrastructure platforms.
* Design and maintain enterprise standards for **Linux and Windows Server** operating systems, virtual machine templates, baseline configurations, lifecycle management, and patch readiness across production, disaster recovery, and lab environments.
* Create scalable platform architecture patterns that improve reliability, security, efficiency, and consistency; support change management by ensuring infrastructure changes are documented, assessed for risk, communicated, tested, and aligned with operational standards.
* Provide technical leadership for monitoring and observability tools including **Zabbix, LogicMonitor, and PagerDuty**; improve coverage, alert quality, escalation workflows, and operational response across all platform environments.
* Work with services, security, application, and operations teams to define platform requirements, document reference architectures, and guide implementation decisions; create and maintain documentation, runbooks, architecture diagrams, build standards, and operational procedures.
* Support database infrastructure for **SQL Server and Oracle** in production and disaster recovery environments, including availability, recovery, monitoring, capacity planning, and operational standards; promote security, compliance, resilience, and cost\-conscious engineering throughout the platform lifecycle.

**Technology Tools You'll Use**
-------------------------------

**Automation \& Scripting**

* PowerShell, Ansible, Python

**Operating Systems \& Virtualization**

* Linux (RHEL, Ubuntu, CentOS), Windows Server, Virtual Machine Templates

**Monitoring \& Observability**

* Zabbix, LogicMonitor, PagerDuty

**Database Platforms**

* SQL Server, Oracle

**Cloud \& Hybrid Infrastructure**

* Hybrid Infrastructure Platforms, Cloud\-Related Services, Self\-Service Infrastructure Catalogs

**Documentation \& Governance**

* Architecture Diagrams, Runbooks, Build Standards, IT Asset Management Tools

**Role Essentials**
-------------------

* **Bachelor's degree or at least seven years of equivalent work experience**, with extensive experience serving as a Systems Architect, Infrastructure Architect, or senior infrastructure administrator with responsibility for architecture decisions and platform standards in complex production environments.
* **Proficiency in infrastructure automation and scripting** using **PowerShell, Ansible, Python**, or similar technologies, with strong practical experience in **Linux and Windows Server** — including build standards, configuration management, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management.
* **Working knowledge of monitoring and observability platforms**, preferably **Zabbix, LogicMonitor, or PagerDuty**, with demonstrated expertise in capacity planning, performance tuning, backup and recovery, and business continuity planning across enterprise environments.
* **Experience supporting infrastructure dependencies for SQL Server, Oracle**, or other enterprise database platforms in production and disaster recovery environments, along with experience with hybrid infrastructure, virtualization platforms, cloud\-related services, or self\-service infrastructure catalogs.
* Strong spoken and written communication skills with a professional and respectful approach; proven ability to create clear technical documentation, architecture standards, runbooks, and implementation guidance for both technical and non\-technical audiences, with strong collaboration and problem\-solving skills.

**What We'd Like to See**
-------------------------

* **Architecture and systems thinking** — demonstrated ability to evaluate dependencies, tradeoffs, and long\-term impacts to guide infrastructure decisions across virtualization, cloud, compute, storage, data protection, and data center services.
* **Automation mindset** — experience identifying repeatable work, selecting appropriate automation opportunities, and promoting reusable solutions across teams to drive operational consistency and efficiency at scale.
* **Continuous learning and responsible AI use** — proven commitment to keeping technical skills current and evaluating approved AI tools and emerging technologies responsibly before applying them to infrastructure work and platform decisions.
* **Security and compliance expertise** — demonstrated ability to apply risk\-based judgment when balancing security, compliance, resilience, usability, and operational requirements throughout the platform lifecycle.
* **Process and governance alignment** — experience aligning technical work with IT asset management, change management, documentation, operational readiness, and service management requirements in enterprise environments.

**About Hyland**

Hyland is the pioneer of the Content Innovation Cloud™, delivering ubiquitous enterprise intelligence to organizations with solutions that unlock actionable insights and drive automation.

Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, including many of the Fortune 100, Hyland's solutions create the foundation for a connected, agentic enterprise, where teams harness the power of AI to redefine how they operate and engage with those they serve. At GoDaddy the future of work looks different for each team. Some teams work in the office full\-time; others have a hybrid arrangement (they work remotely some days and in the office some days) and some work entirely remotely.


This is a remote position, so you’ll be working remotely from your home. You may occasionally visit a GoDaddy office to meet with your team for events or meetings.


**Join Our Team...**

  


This role is for aStaff Technical Program Manager within GoDaddy’s engineering organization, focused on building scalable, fault\-tolerant systems that power critical customer and platform experiences at massive scale.



GoDaddy is empowering everyday entrepreneurs around the world by providing all of the help and tools to succeed online. GoDaddy is the place people come to name their idea, build a professional website, attract customers, sell their products and services, and manage their work. Our mission is to give our customers the tools, insights and the people to transform their ideas and personal initiative into success!


**What you'll get to do...**

  


As a Staff Technical Program Manager, you will be at the forefront of our project management efforts. You will coordinate the seamless delivery of technical programs, ensuring our projects are successfully implemented and meet the highest standards. Your role is pivotal in driving our mission forward by:


* Leading and coordinating multiple workstreams across product engineering, legal, and enterprise customer commitments.

* Familiarity with ML or LLM\-integrated products, including training and evaluation pipelines, and the judgment to ensure GA readiness.

**You might also have...**


* A computer science degree or comparable background in the industry.

3e72ae59.title: Technical Program Manager
3e72ae59.description:
About the Role
 



 We are looking for a high\-impact Technical Program Manager to drive enterprise project execution and strategic account growth for our flagship Conglomerate Client. This is a senior, highly visible role that sits at the intersection of delivery excellence and enterprise sales — requiring both sharp operational rigor and a commercial mindset.
 



 You will be the single point of contact for one of our most strategic enterprise accounts, owning end\-to\-end project delivery, stakeholder relationships, and revenue growth targets.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



**A. Project Execution \& Delivery (70%)** 



* Serve as the primary external Point of Contact for all project updates, escalations, and communications with Enterprises stakeholders across business units.
* Own end\-to\-end project execution for all ongoing deployments — from SOW sign\-off through go\-live — ensuring timelines, milestones, and quality standards are consistently met.
* Drive internal coordination across Product, Engineering, Pre\-Sales, and QA teams to align on deliverables, resolve dependencies, and eliminate blockers.
* Review, negotiate, and execute Statement of Work (SOW) agreements in collaboration with legal, finance, and sales teams — both internally and externally.
* Proactively identify and escalate commercial and technical risks that could impact delivery timelines or customer outcomes; maintain a live risk register with mitigation plans.
* Manage structured governance cadences — weekly project updates, monthly business reviews, and quarterly CSAT reviews — to track progress, surface gaps, and drive accountability.
* Anchor quarterly business reviews (QBRs) with the customer to assess satisfaction, close delivery gaps, and align on the roadmap ahead.
* Escalate red flags, delivery risks, or account health concerns to the Head of Enterprise Sales in a timely and structured manner.
* Maintain accurate project documentation, dashboards, and status reports accessible to both internal and external stakeholders.



**B. Revenue Growth \& Commercial Accountability (30%)** 



* Own and drive upsell and cross\-sell revenue of ₹5 Cr annually within Enterprises, focused exclusively on Enterprise Business — identifying expansion opportunities across new business units, use cases, and product lines.
* Establish and nurture OEM partnerships that contribute to top\-line revenue growth and improve EBITDA margins — identifying the right partners, structuring commercial arrangements, and driving joint GTM motions.
* Collaborate with the Enterprise Sales head to build account plans that map customer strategic priorities to our product capabilities and identify whitespace for growth.
* Track account\-level revenue performance, forecast accuracy, and pipeline health — providing regular updates to sales leadership.
* Participate in commercial negotiations and contract renewals, ensuring pricing, scope, and terms reflect the value delivered.
* Build executive\-level relationships within Enterprises to position the company as a long\-term strategic technology partner, not just a vendor.



 What We're Looking For
 


* 6–10 years of experience in Technical Program Management, Delivery Management, or a hybrid delivery \+ sales role — preferably in SaaS, AI, or enterprise technology.
* Proven track record managing large, complex enterprise accounts with multiple internal and external stakeholders.
* Strong commercial acumen — ability to identify upsell opportunities, own revenue targets, and participate meaningfully in commercial conversations.
* Exceptional stakeholder management skills — comfortable engaging CXOs, business heads, and technical teams with equal confidence.
* Experience managing SOWs, project contracts, and delivery governance frameworks.
* Familiarity with enterprise software deployment lifecycles — including product rollout, integration, QA, and hypercare phases.
* Strong analytical and communication skills — ability to distil complex project status into crisp executive updates.
* Experience working with or establishing OEM/technology partnerships is a strong plus.
* PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent certification preferred but not mandatory.
* Prior experience with large Indian conglomerates or enterprise accounts (Adani, Reliance, Tata, L\&T etc.) is a significant advantage.

**Qualification:** Bachelor's degree in related field, Hubspot Certified

***\*\*Please read COMPLETE JOB Description and apply only if you have 5\+ Years of experience in all below required skills in HUBSPOT CRM and HUBSPOT CMS.***

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior HubSpot Engineer to lead the technical design, architecture, implementation and optimization of complex HubSpot solutions for our client. The candidate must possess atleast Bachelor's degree and preferably be Hubspot Certified.

· HubSpot CMS Hub Software

* Develop CRM architecture, object relationships, lifecycle frameworks, lead routing processes, and automation strategies.

**CRM Configuration \& Automation**

1e0983e7.title: Presales Technical Consultant
1e0983e7.description:
**Who Are We?** 
  
 




 Millipixels Interactive is where creativity, technology, strategy, and innovation come together to build meaningful digital experiences. We partner with startups, growing businesses, and enterprise brands to create everything from immersive digital products and marketing ecosystems to transformation\-driven technology solutions.
 





 But beyond the work, we're a team that thrives on ideas, ownership, experimentation, and execution. We like people who take initiative, think beyond the obvious, and bring energy into everything they do.
 




  






 If you're someone who enjoys building, collaborating, and making a visible impact \- you'll probably enjoy being here.
 




  





**About the Role** 

  
 




 Every strong proposal has a moment where sales promise meets technical reality, and someone has to make sure those two things actually match. At Millipixels, that's you.
 




 You'll own the entire technical pre\-sales journey: running discovery workshops that uncover what clients actually need, architecting solutions that hold up under real\-world conditions, and standing in front of clients to present, demo, and defend what Millipixels can build. You're the bridge between business development and delivery \- making sure nothing gets sold that can't be built, and nothing gets built that wasn't sold right.
 





 This role sits at the intersection of technical credibility and commercial instinct. We're looking for someone who has actually written code and built systems earlier in their career \- because that hands\-on foundation is what lets you architect solutions that hold up under real scrutiny, not just ones that sound good on paper. You'll need to go deep enough into AI and tech solutioning to earn a room full of engineers' respect, while staying sharp enough on commercial viability to keep a deal moving forward.
 




  





**You’ll Be the Person Who** 



* **Leads Discovery That Actually Uncovers Something:** 

 Runs workshops that go beyond surface requirements to understand what clients really need and what they haven't said out loud yet.
* **Architects Solutions That Hold Up:** 

 Designs technical solutions that are robust enough to survive delivery, not just impressive enough to survive a pitch.
* **Owns the Client\-Facing Moment:** 

 Presents, demos, and fields tough technical questions in real time, turning complexity into clarity for the people across the table.
* **Bridges Sales and Delivery:** 

 Makes sure what gets promised in a proposal is exactly what delivery can and will build.
* **Stress\-Tests Every Proposal:** 

 Ensures each solution is commercially viable, technically sound, and operationally realistic before it ever reaches a client's inbox.
* **Speaks Fluent AI:** 

 Understands AI solutions deeply enough to shape them, question them, and explain them \- not just reference them.
* **Solves in Real Time:** 

 Handles technical clarifications and objections on the spot, without needing to "get back to you."
* **Keeps Solutions Aligned to Reality:** 

 Ensures every proposed solution actually reflects what Millipixels can deliver \- not just what sounds good on paper \- drawing on genuine hands\-on engineering experience.
* **Shapes the Proposal, Not Just Reviews It:** 

 Gets involved early in proposal solutioning, so technical thinking is baked in from the start, not bolted on at the end.



  





**You’ll Be a Great Fit If** 



* **You've built things before you started designing them:** 

 you've spent earlier years of your career hands\-on with a programming language \- Java, .NET, Node.js, full\-stack, or similar. It doesn't matter which; what matters is that you've actually written and shipped code, so when you architect a solution, you understand how it really works under the hood.
* **You're a seasoned technical architect:** 

 Typically 9–14 years of overall experience, with genuine depth in solution/technical architecture, not just adjacent exposure.
* **You've been part of actual project delivery: N** 

 ot just design and hand\-off \- you understand what it takes to build what gets promised.
* **Startup scale\-up experience is a strong plus: C** 

 andidates who've been part of a startup that has genuinely grown are valued more highly than those whose experience is limited only to large service\-based organisations \- though that background is welcome too.
* **Client\-facing exposure helps: P** 

 rior involvement in client interactions and/or presales activity is a plus, but not a strict requirement.
* **What really matters: C** 

 an you stand in front of a customer's technical team and confidently, accurately answer their questions in real time? Formal presales experience is optional \- this ability isn't.
* **Your communication skills are excellent:** 

  Fluent enough with engineering heads to discuss what gets built and how, yet just as at ease making deep tech solutions digestible to non\-technical stakeholders. This is non\-negotiable for the role.
* **You have strong working knowledge of AI solutions** 

 and can architect around them, not just talk about them.
* **You're equally comfortable** 

 in a whiteboard session with engineers and a boardroom pitch with executives.
* **You think commercially:** 

 You know a great solution still has to make business sense.
* **You hold a cloud architecture certification:** 

 AWS or Azure (Solutions Architect / Solutions Professional level \- Optional).



  





**Benefits of Working at Millipixels** 



* **Flexible work, your way:** 

 Work where you do your best thinking. We measure outcomes, not hours at a desk.
* **Life admin handled:** 

 Regular expert\-led sessions on finance, tax, and healthcare, so the boring stuff doesn’t eat into your weekends.
* **Comprehensive Health Coverage:** 

  Company\-paid health insurance of ₹500,000, with options to extend to spouse.
* **Generous paid leave:** 

  Properly switch off and recharge. We’re in this for the long game, and so are you.
* **Room to grow:** 

  Continuous learning and real development in a global team, with space to grow your career as fast as you grow the pipeline.
* **Ground\-floor impact:** 

  Join early, help shape the GTM playbook, and put your mark on how we grow, including our AI platform, avirat.ai.
* **Ownership, not red tape:** 

  Small team, big trust. Bring the idea, run with it, and watch it ship.

 :

* Location: Ind\- Hyderabad


 Opella is the self\-care challenger with the purest and
 **third\-largest portfolio in the Over\-The\-Counter (OTC) \& Vitamins, Minerals \& Supplements (VMS) market globally** 
 .

 **100 loved brands**

 and 4 specialized science and innovation development centers. Headquartered in France, Opella is the proud maker of many of the world’s most loved brands, including Allegra, Buscopan, Doliprane, Dulcolax, Enterogermina, Essentiale and Mucosolvan.
   

  

**B Corp certified in multiple markets**

**About The Job**
 We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Cloud Storage Engineering expert to join our dynamic infrastructure team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing, optimizing, and securing our cloud storage infrastructure to ensure optimal performance, scalability, and reliability. This role requires a deep understanding of cloud storage solutions, data management, and cloud security practices. Additionally, the candidate should have experience with carve\-out projects, involving the separation and migration of IT infrastructure and services during corporate divestitures or acquisitions.
   

  

**Main Responsibilities**
 The Cloud Storage Engineer is a strong technical expert, with proven expertise able to lead projects to be executed in various countries. She/He will handle the following areas:
   

  

**Cloud Storage Management**
* Design, deploy, and manage cloud storage solutions across various cloud platforms (AWS, Azure etc.).
* Monitor cloud storage performance, availability, and usage to ensure optimal operation.
* Implement and maintain backup and disaster recovery solutions for cloud storage systems.


**Optimization And Scaling**
* Optimize cloud storage configurations for performance, cost\-efficiency, and scalability.
* Develop and execute strategies for data lifecycle management, including archiving and deletion policies.
* Collaborate with DevOps and infrastructure teams to integrate storage solutions with other cloud services.


**Technical Support And Troubleshooting**
* Provide expert\-level support for cloud storage\-related issues, including performance tuning and troubleshooting.
* Develop and maintain documentation, including procedures, policies, and best practices for cloud storage management.
* Guide and be point of escalation for storage support team (in run\-mode).


**Carve\-Out Project Management**
* Lead and manage the cloud storage aspects of carve\-out project, ensuring smooth separation and migration of data and services.
* Develop and execute detailed migration plans, timelines, and risk assessments for carve\-out initiatives.
* Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure alignment and minimal disruption during the carve\-out process.
* Address and resolve any technical challenges related to cloud storage during corporate divestitures or acquisitions.


**Collaboration And Innovation**
* Stay updated with the latest trends and advancements in cloud storage technologies.
* Evaluate and recommend new cloud storage solutions and services to improve overall efficiency and performance.
* Work closely with development teams to understand storage requirements and provide tailored solutions.


**About You**
**Technical background required**
* Minimum of 5\+ years of experience in cloud \& on\-premise storage management or related field.
* Proven experience with major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, etc.).
* Experience with cloud storage and on\-premise storage technologies (e.g., S3, Blob Storage, Google Cloud Storage, NetApp).
* Demonstrated experience in managing carve\-out projects, including data migration and IT separation.
* Experience in developing automation for storage processes using Terraform, Ansible, ServiceNow etc.
* In\-depth knowledge of cloud storage architecture, data management, and security practices.
* Proficiency in cloud management tools and services.
* Strong understanding of networking, virtualization, and containerization as it relates to cloud storage.


**Soft Skills Required**
* Demonstrated ability to lead and inspire technical teams, fostering a collaborative and productive work environment.
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly convey complex technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Proficiency in preparing detailed reports and presentations for leadership, ensuring transparency and understanding of network initiatives and their impact.
* Ability to think strategically, foreseeing potential challenges and developing proactive solutions.
* Strong problem\-solving skills, with a creative and analytical approach to overcoming obstacles and finding effective solutions in a dynamic environment.
* Commitment to ongoing personal and professional development, staying abreast of the latest industry trends and technological advancements.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.


**Why us?**
 At Opella, you will enjoy doing challenging, purposeful work, empowered to develop consumer brands with passion and creativity. This is your chance to grow new skills and be part of a bold, collaborative, and inclusive culture where people can thrive and be at their best every day.
   

  

**We Are Challengers.**
 We Are Dedicated To Making Self\-care As Simple As It Should Be. That Starts With Our Culture. We Are Challengers By Nature, And This Is How We Do Things
   

  

**All In Together:** 
 We keep each other honest and have each other's backs.
   

  

**Courageous:** 
 We break boundaries and take thoughtful risks with creativity.
   

  

**Outcome\-Obsessed:** 
 We are personally accountable, driving sustainable impact and results with integrity.
   

  

**Radically Simple:** 
 We strive to make things simple for us and simple for consumers, as it should be.
   

  

 Join us on our mission. Health. In your hands.

7c23b03f.title: Technical Program Manager
7c23b03f.description:
Candescent is a forward\-thinking technology company transforming how financial institutions deliver Intelligent Banking experiences. We unite digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions that power and connect digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions—creating seamless engagement across digital, remote, and in\-person channels.
   

  

 Our Experience\-Led, Intelligence\-Driven approach combines human\-centered design with data, automation, and cloud\-based innovation. Built on an API\-first architecture, our extensible ecosystem enables institutions to adapt quickly, integrate easily, and unlock new opportunities for growth—turning every customer interaction into a moment of clarity, confidence, and connection.
   

  

**About Candescent**
 Candescent is the largest non\-core digital banking provider. We bring together the transformative technologies that power and connect account opening, digital banking and branch solutions for banks and credit unions of all sizes on any core. Our Candescent solutions power the top three U.S. mobile banking apps and are trusted by banks and credit unions of all sizes.
   

  

 We offer an extensive portfolio of industry\-leading products and services with an extensible ecosystem of out\-of\-the\-box and integrated partner solutions. In addition, our API\-first architecture and developer tools enable financial institutions to optimize and expand upon their existing capabilities by seamlessly integrating custom\-built or third\-party solutions. And our connected in\-person, remote and digital experiences reinvent customer service across all channels.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 As a Technical Program Manager at Candescent, you will lead cross\-functional technical initiatives, manage program execution, and ensure alignment between engineering deliverables and business objectives. You’ll be responsible for planning, tracking, and delivering high\-impact programs that span multiple teams and technologies.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Lead the planning and execution of complex technical programs across engineering, and product teams.
* Define program scope, goals, success metrics, and deliverables in collaboration with stakeholders.
* Develop and maintain detailed program schedules, risk assessments, and mitigation plans.
* Drive alignment across teams by identifying dependencies, resolving blockers, and ensuring timely delivery.
* Communicate program status, risks, and decisions to senior leadership and stakeholders.
* Foster continuous improvement by introducing scalable processes, tools, and best practices.
* Ensure compliance with internal standards and external regulations.
* Support technical decision\-making and provide guidance on architecture, integration, and deployment strategies.
* Champion a culture of accountability, transparency, and innovation.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (Master’s or MBA is a plus).
* 5\+ years of experience in technical program management, preferably in a software or cloud\-based environment.
* Proven track record of managing large\-scale, cross\-functional technical programs.
* Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC), Agile methodologies, and DevOps practices.
* Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience with project management tools (e.g., Jira, Asana, Confluence).
* Ability to analyze complex technical problems and propose effective solutions.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), microservices architecture, and modern development frameworks.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* PMP, Scrum Master, or equivalent certification.
* Technical background in software engineering or systems architecture.
* Experience working in a startup or high\-growth environment.


**Benefits**
* Competitive salary and equity package
* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) with company match
* Generous PTO and flexible work arrangements
* Inclusive and collaborative culture


**Statement to Third Party Agencies**
 To ALL recruitment agencies: Candescent only accepts resumes from agencies on the preferred supplier list. Please do not forward resumes to our applicant tracking system, Candescent employees, or any Candescent facility. Candescent is not responsible for any fees or charges associated with unsolicited resumes.

**Minimum qualifications:**

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Proficient in executing strategic initiatives and utilizing sales enablement platforms, with a focus on adopting and deploying AI\-powered solutions to streamline workflows and resolve operational bottlenecks.

**About The Job**
 A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. **Location: Pune** 




**Experience: 3\+ Years** 




**Employment Type: Full\-time** 




  





**Skills: Presales , Nutanix, HCI, Server, Backup** 




  





**Job Overview** 




 We are looking for a dynamic Presales Consultant (Data Centre) to drive technical solutioning and business growth. In this role, you will collaborate with customers to understand their infrastructure needs, architect server and storage solutions, formulate accurate Bills of Materials (BoM), and deliver technical presentations.

* Solution Architecture \& Sizing: Design and architect enterprise server and storage solutions. Translate customer business requirements into technical specs by calculating Processor cores, RAM, TPS/IOPS, and storage tiering.

* Experience: Minimum 3\+ years in Data Centre Presales, Solution Architecture, or Technical Consulting.

* NetApp NCDA / NCIE

* EMCISA / VCP\-DCV

2990bde4.title: Partner Solutions Engineer
2990bde4.description:
**About Us**
 Automation Anywhere is the leader in Agentic Process Automation (APA), transforming how work gets done with AI\-powered automation. Its APA system, built on the industry’s first Process Reasoning Engine (PRE) and specialized AI agents, combines process discovery, RPA, end\-to\-end orchestration, document processing, and analytics—all delivered with enterprise\-grade security and governance. Guided by its vision to fuel the future of work, Automation Anywhere helps organizations worldwide boost productivity, accelerate growth, and unleash human potential.
   

  

 Location : Bangalore , Mumbai , Delhi
   

  

 Experience \- 10 \+ Years
   

  

**Our Opportunity**
 Automation Anywhere is redefining how enterprises work through Agentic Process Automation (APA) — AI\-native agents that automate complex, end\-to\-end business processes. Our partner ecosystem is central to how we reach and serve global enterprises, and we are looking for a Partner Solutions Engineer to be the technical cornerstone of that motion.
   

  

 In this role, you will work directly alongside our Global System Integrator (GSI) and regional SI/VAR partners to win strategic deals at the intersection of ITSM and Agentic Automation. You are not a back\-office resource — you are the most senior AA technical voice in the room on partner\-led opportunities, guiding both the partner and the customer to a successful technical close.
   

  

**You Will Make an Impact By**
**Owning Technical Success In Partner\-Led Deals**
* Lead technical strategy and execution on high\-priority ITSM and APA opportunities sourced and co\-sold through GSI and regional SI/VAR partners — from discovery and architecture through POC and close.
* Serve as the definitive Automation Anywhere technical authority in partner\-led customer engagements, ensuring solutions are designed for business impact, not just technical correctness.
* Co\-develop tailored solution architectures that integrate Automation Anywhere's APA platform with other platforms, demonstrating clear ROI and measurable outcomes for enterprise customers.


**Driving Deal Strategy**
* Position AA's agentic automation capabilities including AI agents, LLM\-powered workflows, and intelligent document processing within transformation narratives that resonate with both business and IT stakeholders.
* Design and lead compelling POCs and technical workshops that accelerate partner deal cycles and validate AA as the platform of choice.
* Provide competitive technical advocacy in deals, equipping partners with the differentiated positioning needed to win against competitors.


**Elevating Partner Technical Capability**
* Coach and mentor partner SEs on deal strategy, solution design, and demo best practices. Raise the quality of the partner\-led technical motion without taking the wheel away from them.
* Build and contribute to partner\-ready solution assets: reference architectures, use case playbooks, integration blueprints, and battlecards.
* Serve as the escalation point for complex technical challenges that exceed partner SE capacity, ensuring no deal is lost due to technical gaps.


**Operating As a Strategic Voice**
* Engage C\-suite and senior IT leadership at customer organizations, articulating the strategic value of an AI\-native automation platform within enterprise ITSM and service delivery transformation.
* Represent Automation Anywhere at partner events, QBRs, and industry forums, reinforcing Automation Anywhere's thought leadership in Agentic Automation and ITSM.
* Channel partner and market intelligence: competitive signals, technology gaps, emerging use cases and back into AA's product, alliance, and go\-to\-market teams.


**Architecting Scalable Partner Solutions**
* Design reusable solution frameworks and integration patterns that enable GSI and regional SI partners to replicate AA value across their customer portfolios — multiplying deal impact beyond direct engagement.
* Stay at the forefront of agentic AI, LLM orchestration, RAG, and MCP standards, translating emerging capabilities into concrete partner\-ready solutions.


**You Will Be a Great Fit If You Have**
* 10\+ years of overall professional experience, with 5\+ years in pre\-sales, solutions engineering, or solution consulting roles at an enterprise software or SaaS company.
* Hands\-on experience with ITSM platforms including integration patterns, workflow design, and the broader technology landscape.
* Demonstrated experience working within a partner or channel motion: co\-selling alongside GSIs, regional SIs, VARs, or system integrators, and understanding how to win through partners rather than independently.
* Proven expertise with enterprise automation platforms \- Automation Anywhere, UiPath, Blue Prism, or equivalent including the ability to build and demonstrate production\-quality automations and agentic workflows.
* Fluency in the broader enterprise application ecosystem: SAP, Salesforce, Oracle, ServiceNow, Workday, and their integration within automation architectures.
* Working knowledge of agentic AI concepts: LLMs, RAG, prompt engineering, AI agent frameworks, and how they apply to enterprise automation use cases.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degrees and platform certifications (AA, UiPath, ServiceNow) are a plus.
* Ability to travel up to 40% to partner and customer sites


**You Excel in These Key Competencies**
* Partner\-first mindset: you make partners look good in front of their customers, building trust that drives long\-term co\-sell relationships.
* Equally fluent with C\-suite executives and hands\-on technical architects: You can shift register in the same meeting without losing credibility in either direction.
* Deep ITSM domain fluency that lets you speak the language of IT operations, service delivery, and enterprise IT transformation without relying on scripted demos.
* Strong influencing skills without direct authority: You advance deals and elevate partner SEs through expertise, coaching, and earned trust.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguity: This is a role that requires building structure and playbooks, not just following them.
* Exceptional verbal, written, and presentation skills: with the presence to lead executive workshops and the clarity to write solution architectures partners can execute independently.


**Ready to Revolutionize Work? Join Us.**
 This is an opportunity to shape how Automation Anywhere wins through its partner ecosystem — not just on individual deals, but at scale. You will be the technical face of AA for some of the most important partnerships in the company, working on the most strategic ITSM and APA opportunities in the market. Join us and define what it means to win with partners.
   

  

 Job Segment: Pre\-Sales, Partner Solutions, ITSM Automation, Agentic Process Automation, GSI, Enterprise SaaS, AI Agents
   

  

 All unsolicited resumes submitted to any @automationanywhere.com email address, whether submitted by an individual or by an agency, will not be eligible for an agency fee.

**Company Description**  

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI\-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.


Join us to put AI to work for people.

 **Job Description** **The Team**


The Customer Excellence Group (CEG) is ServiceNow’s internal professional services organisation. The CEG team at ServiceNow works with customers to help them achieve their business outcomes by providing proven practice guidance and technical expertise.
