db18d748.title: Architect, Apps & AI
db18d748.description:
**Overview**
 Microsoft Industry Solutions \- Global Center Innovation and Delivery Center (GCID) delivers end\-to\-end solutions by enabling accelerated adoption and productive use of Microsoft technologies. An organization of well over 1000\+ exceptional people, GCID presents a great opportunity for highly skilled services professionals to make a foray into consulting, solution development and delivery roles.
   

  

 The Architect is a senior leader responsible for the successful technical execution and delivery of complex client projects across diverse domains. This role acts as a strategic anchor between clients, senior leadership, delivery managers, project managers, and delivery teams. In the AI\-first GCID organization, Architect(s) are expected to embed AI\-native thinking into delivery models, ensuring solutions are intelligent, scalable, and aligned with business outcomes. The ideal candidate is passionate about technology, demonstrates breadth of expertise, and advocates for solutions that deliver true client value.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**AI\-First Delivery Leadership**
* Embed AI\-first principles into delivery workflows, leveraging automation and intelligent orchestration where applicable.
* Own the Architecture and drive end\-to\-end delivery of complex projects, ensuring solutions are scalable, robust, and aligned with client business outcomes.
* Drive engineering excellence through reusable components, accelerators, and scalable architecture.
* Oversee technical execution across multiple projects, ensuring adherence to best practices, quality standards, and compliance requirements.
* Collaborate with clients and internal stakeholders to define strategies, delivery plans, milestones, and risk mitigation approaches.
* Act as a technical point of contact for clients, translating business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Ensure delivery models are optimized for modern, AI\-native execution, including integration of automation and intelligent processes.
* Ability to step into at‑risk projects, quickly assess issues, and establish a credible path to recovery or exit.


**Engineering Excellence**
 Promote high\-quality engineering throughout all projects. Enforce coding standards, architectural integrity, and performance goals. Establish secure coding, TDD, and observability practices. Support ongoing learning and certifications. Advance modern methodologies like Agile, DevOps, and CI/CD for scalable solutions. Build a team culture of technical rigor, innovation, and accountability.
   

  

**Innovation \& Thought Leadership**
 Track new technologies to guide strategy. Drive innovation in delivery, assets, and tools for better efficiency. Promote best practices and continuous improvement across teams.
   

  

**Client Engagement \& Solutioning**
 Apply design thinking to develop user\-centric solutions that also support business objectives, architecture, and project delivery. Collaborate with clients to identify their needs and provide guidance throughout each stage of the project. Participate in pre\-sales and solutioning activities by preparing estimates, proofs\-of\-concept, and technical proposals. Additionally, maintain strong client relationships to ensure satisfaction and ongoing value.
   

  

**Team Management \& Mentorship**
 Lead cross\-functional teams, promote learning and collaboration, and uphold technical standards. Review work, offer feedback, and support team growth.
   

  

**Quality \& Compliance**
 Ensure secure, compliant, and reliable solution delivery through secure coding, test‑driven development, observability, design reviews, and quality gates across all engagements
   

  

**Other**
* Embody our culture and values


**Qualifications**
* 20\+ years of experience in software/solution engineering, with at least 10–15 years as Architect and delivery leadership roles.
* Proven experience in leading delivery of complex, multi\-disciplinary projects.
* Strong understanding of modern delivery methodologies (Agile, Scrum, DevOps, etc.).
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, problem\-solving, and team leadership skills.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* Relevant certifications are a plus.


**Areas of Expertise**
**Full Stack Application Engineering**
* 
+ End\-to\-end design and development of modern web and mobile applications using React, Angular, Next.js, Blazor, or equivalent frameworks
+ Strong backend expertise using .NET / Java / Node.js / Python, with clean architecture, domain\-driven design, and API\-first principles
+ Experience building microservices and distributed systems using REST, gRPC, event\-driven patterns, and asynchronous processing
+ Hands\-on expertise with relational and NoSQL databases (Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, Cosmos DB) and performance tuning
+ Strong understanding of state management, scalability, resiliency, and application security


**AI Driven Application Development**
* Proven expertise in AI‑driven application development, embedding intelligence directly into modern, cloud‑native applications.
* Extensive hands‑on experience using GitHub Copilot as a core engineering capability to accelerate solution design, coding, refactoring, testing, and documentation across delivery teams.
* Demonstrated ability to foster a Copilot‑assisted engineering culture (“vibe”) \- enabling rapid iteration, AI pair‑programming, explain‑as‑you‑build workflows, and high‑velocity delivery without compromising engineering quality.
* Strong experience modernizing application landscapes using GitHub Copilot‑assisted approaches, including rapid codebase comprehension, dependency analysis, large‑scale refactoring, and migration to cloud‑native and AI‑enabled architectures.
* Effective use of GitHub Copilot across the entire SDLC, from solutioning and scaffolding through CI/CD automation, test generation, production readiness, and operational excellence.
* Ability to coach and enable teams and customers on effective Copilot usage patterns, prompt strategies, and safe AI‑assisted engineering practices in enterprise environments.
* Apply Responsible AI principles across design and delivery, incorporating security, privacy, governance, and compliance controls into production‑grade engineering workflows.


**AI\-Enabled Application Development**
* Ability to translate business scenarios into production‑grade AI solutions using Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Services, Azure AI Foundry, and custom ML models, with hands‑on delivery of RAG architectures leveraging Azure AI Search, vector databases, enterprise data grounding, and integration patterns.
* Strong expertise in prompt engineering, context management, grounding strategies, and LLM integration for copilots, conversational interfaces, intelligent workflows, and decision‑support applications.
* Proven experience designing and implementing single‑agent and multi‑agent AI systems, including task boundaries, tool invocation, memory management, collaboration, delegation, and coordination, using frameworks such as Semantic Kernel, LangChain, and LangGraph.
* Deep understanding of agentic workflows, combining LLM reasoning with external tools, APIs, and enterprise data sources, alongside agent lifecycle management \- planning, execution, retries, failure handling, and human‑in‑the‑loop patterns.
* Designs enterprise‑ready AI solutions with built‑in observability and operational excellence, including telemetry, prompt tracing, agent behavior logging, model metrics, experimentation, drift monitoring, and cost/performance optimization, while applying Responsible AI principles across security, privacy, governance, and compliance \- balancing speed, quality, and enterprise constraints at scale.


**Cloud\-Native Architecture (Azure)**
* 
+ Deep experience designing cloud‑native, PaaS‑first solutions on Azure, prioritizing managed services over IaaS to improve scalability, resilience, security, and operational efficiency.
+ Proven expertise in architecting and delivering solutions using Azure App Service, Azure Container Apps, AKS, Azure Functions, and API Management, selecting the right compute model based on workload characteristics and business needs.
+ Strong working knowledge of identity, security, and networking architectures, including Microsoft Entra ID, RBAC, Managed Identity, Key Vault integration, private endpoints, and VNET‑integrated application deployments.
+ Design and implementation of architectures that support high availability, horizontal scalability, disaster recovery, and fault tolerance, including multi‑region deployment patterns and resiliency strategies.
+ Experience in cost‑aware architecture design, applying cost optimization strategies such as right‑sizing, autoscaling, consumption‑based services, and proactive cost governance.
+ Apply Microsoft Well‑Architected Framework principles across reliability, security, performance efficiency, operational excellence, and cost optimization, incorporating architecture reviews and continuous improvement into delivery.
+ Hands‑on experience building cloud‑ready landing patterns, integrating application architectures with enterprise networking, security baselines, and platform standards.


**DevOps, Platform \& Developer Productivity**
* 
+ Strong expertise in designing and operating CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions, enabling automated build, test, security scanning, and deployment workflows across environments.
+ Proven hands‑on experience with Infrastructure‑as‑Code (IaC) using Bicep, ARM, and Terraform, leveraging GitHub Copilot to scaffold modules, generate templates, and propose secure configurations aligned with enterprise standards.
+ Deep understanding of observability and reliability engineering, including centralized logging, metrics, distributed tracing, SLOs, and proactive alerting for production systems.
+ Demonstrated ability to enhance developer productivity and delivery velocity through inner‑source practices, reusable components, reference implementations, accelerators, and automation.
+ Experience embedding DevSecOps practices into delivery pipelines, including secure coding checks, dependency scanning, secrets management, policy enforcement, and compliance validation.
+ Effective use of GitHub Copilot across the DevOps lifecycle, including authoring pipeline definitions, generating runbooks and release notes, assisting with PR summaries, and accelerating troubleshooting and incident response.
+ Strong grasp of platform engineering principles, building paved‑road solutions and self‑service capabilities that balance speed, governance, and operational excellence.
+ Ability to continuously improve engineering throughput, quality, and system reliability, while maintaining enterprise security and compliance expectations.


**Solutioning, Pre\-Sales \& Technical Leadership**
* 
+ Lead technical solutioning, estimations, and support architecture design during pre\-sales and delivery shaping
+ Translate business outcomes into clear architecture, execution plans, and risk mitigation strategies
+ Influence technical direction across multiple teams and engagements
+ Act as a trusted advisor to clients and internal leadership


**Frontier Engineering \& Customer Enablement Skills**
* 
+ Lead rapid prototyping, pilots, and early\-stage deployments for enterprise customers
+ Ability to go from whiteboard to production with minimal friction
+ Strong troubleshooting and production support expertise, including performance, reliability, and security issues
+ Side‑by‑side coding with customer engineering teams to unblock deployments and accelerate time to value
+ Outcome‑driven engineering focused on business impact, not activity
+ Building reusable assets, accelerators, and reference implementations
+ Comfortable operating in ambiguous, high\-pressure environments with C\-Level customer stakeholders


**Personal Attributes**
* Passion for technology and innovation.
* Ability to interact confidently with senior leaders and clients.
* Strong decision\-making skills and a consultative mindset.

* Commitment to continuous learning and professional growth.

9ddd0da6.title: Senior Engineering Consultant - Cloud
9ddd0da6.description:
### **When you join Verizon**


You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere \& always. Want in? Join the \#VTeamLife.

**What you will be doing...**


The VCP Far Edge Automation team builds and maintains the automation that manages the full lifecycle of Verizon's virtualized RAN (vRAN) infrastructure — the technology powering the nation's largest, most reliable 5G network. Our automation drives Lifecycle Management (LCM) for vRAN software deployments across Ericsson, Samsung, and Corning vDU platforms, as well as the Far Edge hardware stacks from HPE, ZT Systems, and Dell that run beneath them. The team brings together DevOps engineers and AI engineers to deliver automation solutions end\-to\-end — from infrastructure pipelines and configuration management to intelligent, AI\-driven remediation and tooling.


As a Senior Engineer on this team, you'll be a core contributor — owning the build and maintenance of automation that deploys, configures, upgrades, and heals vRAN infrastructure at national scale.


You'll work closely with the team to take technical direction and deliver reliable automation solutions that the broader team can depend on in production.

* Building and maintaining Ansible\-based automation for vRAN LCM workflows — including initial deployments, software upgrades, configuration management, and fallout remediation — across Ericsson, Samsung, and Corning vDU platforms.
* Developing and maintaining automation for Far Edge hardware lifecycle management covering HPE, ZT Systems, and Dell vRAN server platforms (BIOS, firmware, OS, and driver management).
* Writing Python tooling to support automation workflows — REST API integrations, data processing, inventory management, and operational reporting.
* Owning CI/CD pipelines that test, validate, and deploy automation code using Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent tools.
* Working with databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB) to manage automation state, deployment history, inventory, and run data.
* Troubleshooting automation failures across the full stack — from pipeline issues to failed playbooks to vendor API problems — and drive fixes through to resolution.
* Participating in code reviews and maintain a high bar for code quality, test coverage, and documentation.
* Building and maintaining dashboards and alerting integrations (Grafana, Kibana, Icinga) to track LCM automation health and delivery KPIs.
* Maintaining documentation: playbooks, MOPs, design docs, and implementation guides for supported platforms.
* Collaborating with operations, planning, and vendor engineering teams to translate network requirements into automation solutions.

**What we are looking for…**


You'll need to have:

* Bachelor's degree or four or more years of hands\-on work experience in lieu of degree.
* Six or more years of experience in a DevOps, automation engineering, or platform engineering role.
* Strong, production\-grade Ansible skills — writing roles, playbooks, dynamic inventories, and custom modules.
* Strong Python skills — clean, testable, maintainable code used in real automation workflows, not just one\-off scripts.
* Hands\-on database experience — writing queries, managing schemas, and integrating databases into automation pipelines (PostgreSQL, MySQL, or MongoDB).
* Solid CI/CD pipeline experience using Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent.
* Proficiency in Git\-based workflows (Bitbucket, GitLab, or GitHub).
* Linux/Unix systems experience with solid Shell scripting skills.
* Familiarity with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
* **Ability to work US Central Standard Time (CST) business hours (8:00 AM to 5:00 PM CT), which corresponds to current 6:30 PM to 3:30 AM Indian Standard Time.**


Even better if you have:

* Experience in telecommunications, RAN, vRAN, or virtualized network infrastructure — particularly with vendors like Ericsson, Samsung, Corning, HPE, ZT Systems, or Dell in a network context.
* Experience with server hardware lifecycle management (BIOS/firmware upgrades, OS provisioning, driver management) in a data center or edge environment.
* Experience with Terraform, Helm, or other IaC tooling beyond Ansible.
* REST API development experience — building or integrating APIs as part of automation pipelines.
* Monitoring and observability experience (Grafana, Elasticsearch, Kibana, Kafka, Icinga).
* Hands\-on experience with LLMs or AI agent frameworks — for example, using tools like Claude Code, LangChain, or similar to build AI\-assisted automation, accelerate code generation, or prototype agentic workflows.
* Experience with OpenStack, VMware, or hybrid cloud environments relevant to NFV/vRAN infrastructure.


If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

### **Where you’ll be working**


In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.### **Scheduled Weekly Hours**


40### **Equal Employment Opportunity**


Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, gender, disability or any other legally protected characteristics.

**Job Description:**
--------------------

#### **Job Purpose**


The Territory Technical Services Manager will plan and implement the sales promotional \& brand equity activities in coordination with TSM / TSE to make UltraTech as the preferred choice of customers \& influencers in the assigned territory.

#### **Job Context \& Major Challenges**


Cement industry, which is the backbone of all construction activities, is steadily growing. Mergers \& acquisitions have led to the consolidation of manufacturing and marketing of this commodity. There is a need to create differentiation to maintain leadership position. UltraTech being the Industry leader, with around 20% of market share is poised to grow rapidly in the next 5 years. To resonate with the tag line of \`Engineers Choice', UltraTech has built a very powerful value addition called Tech. Services. With the industry's largest team of civil and mobile concrete labs, UltraTech has established extensive customer interface across the country.  

The position of Territory Technical Services Manager represents the front line role, representing UltraTech to the influencers \& end consumer. The position holder shall be responsible for running the Mobile Concrete Lab service, manage off\-role employees (MLE, LATF, RME). This role is responsible for achieving the Depot\-level targets of conversions, loyalty schemes, all varieties of sales promotional meets, engagement programs for Masons, Engineers, IHBs, diploma / degree students.

#### **Key Result Areas**

**KRA (Accountabilities) (Max 1325 Characters)** **Supporting Actions (Max 1325 Characters)**  


KRA1 Assistance to Internal Stakeholders- (R) Assess the extent of damaged cement and recommend the price for sale, based on defined norms
  

- (R) Conduct godown inspections, rake inspections to monitor quality
  

- (R) Quality verification of Non trade site

08da36f6.description:
Join our dynamic Customer Engagement team as a Manager \- Client Engagement, where you'll drive measurable business outcomes, accelerate client adoption of GRAVTY®, and strengthen strategic relationships across our Global Key Accounts.!
 



  





 Loyalty Juggernaut (LJI) is a leading B2B SaaS company redefining how enterprises drive customer engagement and loyalty. Our flagship platform, GRAVTY®, enables global brands to transform loyalty programs into measurable, revenue\-generating growth engines.
 



 Built as an AI\-first, next\-generation solution, GRAVTY® empowers organizations to deliver highly personalized, real\-time experiences at scale—helping them increase customer lifetime value and deepen brand relationships.
 



 Headquartered in Palo Alto, California, LJI partners with leading enterprises across 16 major industries including airlines, retail, hospitality, financial services and telecommunications powering some of the most innovative loyalty ecosystems worldwide.
 



  





**Our Global Impact:** 



* 400\+ Million members connected through our platform.
* 100\+ Global Brands trust us to drive loyalty and brand devotion.
* 3\-Time Winner of “Best Technology Innovation in Loyalty”.
* Global recognitions for Excellence in Loyalty Management under numerous categories.
* Recognized as a ‘Strong performer’ in The Forrester Wave™ Loyalty Platforms, Q4 2025\.



  





 Explore more about us at www.lji.io.
 



  





**The OPPORTUNITY** 




 As the Manager – Client Engagement, you will take end\-to\-end ownership of account strategy, client engagement, relationship continuity, value realization, governance, account health, renewals, and expansion for a portfolio of enterprise customers. Acting as a trusted advisor, you will build long\-term strategic relationships while ensuring customers achieve measurable business outcomes from the GRAVTY® platform.
 



  





 In this role, you will play a pivotal role in driving Net Revenue Retention (NRR), accelerating AI adoption, and maximizing Client Lifetime Value (CLTV). You will ensure that enterprise customers realize the full value of GRAVTY®, proactively identify opportunities for growth and innovation, and partner closely with cross\-functional teams to deliver exceptional customer experiences and sustained business success.
 



  





**What will you DO:** 




  





**Client Leadership \& Strategic Ownership** 



* Own and manage engagement for Global strategic and Key accounts, ensuring program success and maximizing GRAVTY® adoption
* Act as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders, aligning their business objectives with GRAVTY®’s capabilities.
* Develop and execute strategic account plans, ensuring alignment with LJI’s Client Engagement OKRs
* Drive governance, executive alignment, and client advocacy, ensuring long\-term partnerships



  





**Governance \& Execution Excellence** 



* Oversee governance models to ensure all client requests, program roadmaps, and deliverables remain on track.
* Work cross\-functionally with Client Delivery, Product, and Sales/Presales to ensure seamless execution.
* Monitor client engagement outcomes across the portfolio i.e. product adoption, retention (GRR/NRR), expansion ARR, CSAT, and customer advocacy.
* Drive engagement discipline through account hygiene, account health trends, renewal risk signals, expansion pipeline coverage, QBR and executive connect cadence etc.



  





**Account Ownership and Orchestration** 



* Act as the voice of the client inside Loyalty Juggernaut
* Translate client priorities into internal actions and ensure executive discussions become tracked execution
* Support adoption readiness, success validation, feedback capture, and transition to steady\-state
* Maintain stakeholder alignment, communication, risk visibility, and the value narrative
* Own Partnership plan, Recurrence cadence, Health Baseline, QBRs, Executive connects, Adoption analysis, Renewal readiness, Expansion signals, and Account strategy



  





**Innovation \& Transformation** 



* Drive AI and product expansion, positioning GRAVTY® as an essential platform for client success.
* Identify and address gaps in client engagement strategies, ensuring a proactive approach to risk and opportunity.
* Influence the product roadmap based on client insights and market trends.



  





**You will be a GREAT FIT if you have:** 




**Experience \& Expertise** 



* 5\+ years in Client Engagement, Account Management, or Client Services, ideally within CRM, loyalty, SaaS AI or technology\-driven industries
* A strong track record of managing enterprise accounts, driving growth, and achieving measurable success.








**Strategic \& Commercial Acumen** 



* Proven ability to align client needs with commercial objectives, driving NRR, CLTV growth, and AI adoption.
* Experience managing C\-level and senior stakeholders, with strong influencing skills.








**Operational \& Governance Mastery** 



* Experience or familiarity with project management methodologies such as Agile, SAFe, and SCRUM.
* Ability to manage competing priorities, ensuring focus on strategic objectives.








**Communication \& Relationship Building** 



* A confident and articulate communicator who can build trust and credibility with both mid\-level and senior stakeholders within client organizations.
* Strong ability to manage complex client relationships, ensuring alignment between LJI’s solutions and client business objectives.
* Adept at navigating cross\-functional discussions, collaborating with internal teams such as Client Delivery, Product, and Engineering to ensure seamless execution.
* Proactive in identifying potential risks or concerns, ensuring that issues are addressed before they escalate.
* Skilled at delivering clear, structured client communications, whether through formal presentations, business reviews, or day\-to\-day account management.








**Self\-Starter \& Problem Solver** 



* A highly motivated, independent thinker who takes initiative and ownership of client engagements without needing constant direction.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-moving, high\-growth SaaS environment, balancing multiple priorities while maintaining strategic focus.
* Ability to assess challenges critically, offering practical, data\-driven solutions that drive results for both the client and LJI.
* Proactively seeks out efficiencies and process improvements, ensuring that account management remains structured and effective.
* Resilient in managing client demands, internal challenges, and operational hurdles, ensuring that momentum is sustained across all client interactions.



  





**Why should you consider US?** 



* Work with top\-tier global brands, shaping their loyalty strategies and driving industry innovation.
* Lead high\-impact client engagements in a fast\-scaling, empowered work environment.
* Collaborate with world\-class teams on cutting\-edge AI and loyalty solutions.
* Make a real impact—this is not just account management; this is strategic leadership.

289d566a.title: Staff Architect II, Software & Data Architecture
289d566a.description:
WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK
  
  

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on \[1] Glassdoor's Best Places to Work list and have earned the \#1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  

WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH
  
  

You'll join Bain's NextGen Software Solutions (NGSS) team, where we build and support software products that help power the firm's work.
  
  

As a Staff Architect II, you'll be the technical owner of a \[2] Coro product workstream within NGSS. The Coro team is focused on building and scaling Bain's proprietary data and product ecosystem. We develop and manage platforms such as BizMap and Helix, which power data\-driven insights and solutions across Bain's commercial and private equity practices.
  
  

WHERE YOU'LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM
  
  

As a Staff Architect II, you'll play a hands\-on engineering leadership role \- writing code, setting technical standards, reviewing the team's work, and driving the architectural direction and delivery of your workstream.
  
  

You'll partner closely with Product Managers to translate the product roadmap into actionable engineering plans, mentor engineers, remove technical blockers, and serve as the primary technical liaison between product leadership and Bain's broader platform teams. You'll also lead the workstream's operational excellence by overseeing production support, triaging system issues, providing Level 1 and Level 2 troubleshooting, and managing code deployments.
  
  

WHAT YOU'LL DO
  
  

Architecture \& Technical Governance
  
  

* Provide technical leadership, governance and architectural direction to internal and external development teams on the design, development, implementation, and deployment of highly usable and scalable software
* Participate in system coding and engineering alongside development teams, including performing formal code reviews and providing feedback on the structure, maintainability and quality of code
* Produce, communicate and maintain technical designs, architecture artifacts, best practice, and principles for technical and executive\-level audiences
* Define and document the workstream architecture, ensuring alignment with the shared platform design and Bain\-wide Azure, make key design decisions on data flow, service boundaries, and integration patterns
* Collaborate with AI Engineers to design LLM orchestration and tool\-calling architecture for product\-specific agents, ensuring reliability, maintainability, and cost efficiency at scale


Delivery \& Roadmap Execution
  
  

* Work with Product Managers to translate prioritized epics into concrete technical scopes, estimating complexity, flagging dependencies, and sequencing work across the team
* Own sprint\-level task assignment, remove blockers, and ensure the team delivers against committed timelines and roadmap commitments


Team Leadership \& Development
  
  

* Lead, mentor, and grow multiple engineering teams across products, services, and projects
* Run technical standups, manage individual workloads, provide structured feedback, and grow junior engineers while maintaining delivery pace
* Support team in recruiting activities (resume screening, interviews, etc.)


Stakeholder Alignment
  
  

* Ensure the workstream's builds stay compatible with and contribute back to the shared Bain platform
* Represent the workstream team in technical touchpoints with practice leadership and external engineering partners


Innovation \& Emerging Technologies
  
  

* Drive innovation through out\-of\-the\-box thinking to solve critical business challenges and demands
* Participate in technical discovery, POCs, and innovation workstreams to validate new tools, technologies, and designs
* Investigate and keep up\-to\-date on emerging data, AI, and agentic technologies and trends; lead knowledge sharing
* Entrepreneurial spirit, willing to try new approaches
* Comfortable in a consulting\-adjacent product context, turning ambiguous requirements into well\-scoped engineering work


ABOUT YOU
  
  

Education
  
* Bachelor's or Engineering degree or an equivalent combination of education, training and experience


Technical
  
* Software and data architecture experience in a senior technology leadership role
* Track record in building and running scalable cloud\-based B2B software products
* Strong backend experience in Python (FastAPI or similar), with Node.js and C\# / ASP.NET in the stack, plus TypeScript/React for full\-stack work
* Deep experience with cloud\-native Azure (Container Apps, Functions) and containerized deployments (Docker, Docker Compose)
* Working knowledge of LLM APIs and agent orchestration frameworks, enough to make sound design calls on agent structure, tool\-calling, and prompt management
* Working knowledge of data pipelines and stores (SQL schemas, ETL, data quality) across relational and analytical systems (Azure SQL, Postgres, Snowflake)
* Deep experience building AI agents (long\-running and workflow DAG agents)
* Familiarity with AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex) to speed up development
* Experience leading and mentoring engineering teams in a fast\-paced Agile environment
* Results\-driven, with an analytical, creative, and proactive mindset


Experience
  
* 8\+ years in software engineering, including 2\+ years as a staff architect or technical team lead responsible for team delivery of large features or full products
* Track record of delivering in an Agile environment
* Experience managing engineering teams, including conflict and dependency resolution
* Demonstrated ability to manage communication across project stakeholders and external vendors


This role follows a hybrid work model, with 2 days per week in the office.
  
References
  
  

Visible links
  
1\. https://www.bain.com/about/awards\-recognition/
  
2\. https://www.coro.io/

7b4e1cd7.title: Partner Solutions Engineer
7b4e1cd7.description:
**About Us**
 Automation Anywhere is the leader in Agentic Process Automation (APA), transforming how work gets done with AI\-powered automation. Its APA system, built on the industry’s first Process Reasoning Engine (PRE) and specialized AI agents, combines process discovery, RPA, end\-to\-end orchestration, document processing, and analytics—all delivered with enterprise\-grade security and governance. Guided by its vision to fuel the future of work, Automation Anywhere helps organizations worldwide boost productivity, accelerate growth, and unleash human potential.
   

  

 Location : Bangalore , Mumbai , Delhi
   

  

 Experience \- 10 \+ Years
   

  

**Our Opportunity**
 Automation Anywhere is redefining how enterprises work through Agentic Process Automation (APA) — AI\-native agents that automate complex, end\-to\-end business processes. Our partner ecosystem is central to how we reach and serve global enterprises, and we are looking for a Partner Solutions Engineer to be the technical cornerstone of that motion.
   

  

 In this role, you will work directly alongside our Global System Integrator (GSI) and regional SI/VAR partners to win strategic deals at the intersection of ITSM and Agentic Automation. You are not a back\-office resource — you are the most senior AA technical voice in the room on partner\-led opportunities, guiding both the partner and the customer to a successful technical close.
   

  

**You Will Make an Impact By**
**Owning Technical Success In Partner\-Led Deals**
* Lead technical strategy and execution on high\-priority ITSM and APA opportunities sourced and co\-sold through GSI and regional SI/VAR partners — from discovery and architecture through POC and close.
* Serve as the definitive Automation Anywhere technical authority in partner\-led customer engagements, ensuring solutions are designed for business impact, not just technical correctness.
* Co\-develop tailored solution architectures that integrate Automation Anywhere's APA platform with other platforms, demonstrating clear ROI and measurable outcomes for enterprise customers.


**Driving Deal Strategy**
* Position AA's agentic automation capabilities including AI agents, LLM\-powered workflows, and intelligent document processing within transformation narratives that resonate with both business and IT stakeholders.
* Design and lead compelling POCs and technical workshops that accelerate partner deal cycles and validate AA as the platform of choice.
* Provide competitive technical advocacy in deals, equipping partners with the differentiated positioning needed to win against competitors.


**Elevating Partner Technical Capability**
* Coach and mentor partner SEs on deal strategy, solution design, and demo best practices. Raise the quality of the partner\-led technical motion without taking the wheel away from them.
* Build and contribute to partner\-ready solution assets: reference architectures, use case playbooks, integration blueprints, and battlecards.
* Serve as the escalation point for complex technical challenges that exceed partner SE capacity, ensuring no deal is lost due to technical gaps.


**Operating As a Strategic Voice**
* Engage C\-suite and senior IT leadership at customer organizations, articulating the strategic value of an AI\-native automation platform within enterprise ITSM and service delivery transformation.
* Represent Automation Anywhere at partner events, QBRs, and industry forums, reinforcing Automation Anywhere's thought leadership in Agentic Automation and ITSM.
* Channel partner and market intelligence: competitive signals, technology gaps, emerging use cases and back into AA's product, alliance, and go\-to\-market teams.


**Architecting Scalable Partner Solutions**
* Design reusable solution frameworks and integration patterns that enable GSI and regional SI partners to replicate AA value across their customer portfolios — multiplying deal impact beyond direct engagement.
* Stay at the forefront of agentic AI, LLM orchestration, RAG, and MCP standards, translating emerging capabilities into concrete partner\-ready solutions.


**You Will Be a Great Fit If You Have**
* 10\+ years of overall professional experience, with 5\+ years in pre\-sales, solutions engineering, or solution consulting roles at an enterprise software or SaaS company.
* Hands\-on experience with ITSM platforms including integration patterns, workflow design, and the broader technology landscape.
* Demonstrated experience working within a partner or channel motion: co\-selling alongside GSIs, regional SIs, VARs, or system integrators, and understanding how to win through partners rather than independently.
* Proven expertise with enterprise automation platforms \- Automation Anywhere, UiPath, Blue Prism, or equivalent including the ability to build and demonstrate production\-quality automations and agentic workflows.
* Fluency in the broader enterprise application ecosystem: SAP, Salesforce, Oracle, ServiceNow, Workday, and their integration within automation architectures.
* Working knowledge of agentic AI concepts: LLMs, RAG, prompt engineering, AI agent frameworks, and how they apply to enterprise automation use cases.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degrees and platform certifications (AA, UiPath, ServiceNow) are a plus.
* Ability to travel up to 40% to partner and customer sites


**You Excel in These Key Competencies**
* Partner\-first mindset: you make partners look good in front of their customers, building trust that drives long\-term co\-sell relationships.
* Equally fluent with C\-suite executives and hands\-on technical architects: You can shift register in the same meeting without losing credibility in either direction.
* Deep ITSM domain fluency that lets you speak the language of IT operations, service delivery, and enterprise IT transformation without relying on scripted demos.
* Strong influencing skills without direct authority: You advance deals and elevate partner SEs through expertise, coaching, and earned trust.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguity: This is a role that requires building structure and playbooks, not just following them.
* Exceptional verbal, written, and presentation skills: with the presence to lead executive workshops and the clarity to write solution architectures partners can execute independently.


**Ready to Revolutionize Work? Join Us.**
 This is an opportunity to shape how Automation Anywhere wins through its partner ecosystem — not just on individual deals, but at scale. You will be the technical face of AA for some of the most important partnerships in the company, working on the most strategic ITSM and APA opportunities in the market. Join us and define what it means to win with partners.
   

  

 Job Segment: Pre\-Sales, Partner Solutions, ITSM Automation, Agentic Process Automation, GSI, Enterprise SaaS, AI Agents
   

  

 All unsolicited resumes submitted to any @automationanywhere.com email address, whether submitted by an individual or by an agency, will not be eligible for an agency fee.

8caed9c3.description:
**Job Description**
 As a key contributor within our team, the Product Architect plays a central role in defining the technical direction and roadmap for the Business Unit. In this role, you will be responsible for driving the technical vision and architecture strategy for the Business Unit, translating market and customer requirements into innovative and scalable product solutions.
   

  

 You will work closely with Product Management, customers, and industry forums to analyze requirements, define solution architectures, and shape the product roadmap. The role requires strong expertise in system analysis, solution design, effort estimation, and resource planning to ensure successful product development and delivery. As a key technical leader, you will influence architectural decisions, ensure alignment with customer expectations, and contribute to the development of next\-generation embedded telecom solutions.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**
* Translate business and product requirements into detailed solution architecture, including application, integration, deployment, security, and data design.
* Own and guide the configuration of cloud services and platform components in close collaboration with the DevOps and infrastructure teams.
* Continuously evaluate and keep cloud components, platform services, and related frameworks up to date based on research, best practices, scalability needs, and performance considerations.
* Participate in architecture reviews, design discussions, and technical decision\-making across cross\-functional teams.
* Troubleshoot and resolve architecture\-level issues related to performance, scalability, deployment, and cloud platform behavior.
* Perform technical evaluation and proof\-of\-concept activities for new tools, frameworks, and cloud services before adoption.
* Mentor development teams and provide architectural leadership to ensure consistent implementation of best practices.
* Maintain architecture documentation and ensure all stakeholders have visibility into design decisions, assumptions, dependencies, and constraints.


**Key Skills And Experience**
**Must\-to\-have**
* Should have at least 10 years of experience in developing cloud\-based microservices applications. Experience with applications developed using Spring Boot and Java 8\+ is a plus and Experience in telecom domain, BSS/OSS, or large\-scale enterprise platforms is an added advantage.
* Bachelor’s or master's degree in computer science, Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, Industrial science or equivalent experience
* Should have experience in designing highly scalable architectures. Experience working as a Solution Architect for more than 5 years is a plus and ability to work with cross\-functional teams, including development, QA, DevOps, operations, and business stakeholders.
* Should have experience in defining solution architecture and translating business requirements into technical solutions.
* Should have experience working with NoSQL databases such as MongoDB and Cassandra.
* Should have experience working with distributed cache technologies such as Hazelcast and Redis.
* Should have experience working with messaging/queuing systems such as RabbitMQ or Kafka.
* Should have familiarity with DevOps and cloud platform tools, such as load balancers, Kubernetes, Helm charts, and OpenShift storage and networking layers.
* Should have expertise in debugging field issues related to scalability and performance.
* Should have understanding of application security, secure coding practices, authentication/authorization, and common cloud security principles.


**Nice\-to\-have**
* Knowledge of public cloud providers such as AWS and Google Cloud is a plus.
* Knowledge of AI/ML and MCP server development is a plus


**About Us**
**Advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.**
 Nokia is a global leader in connectivity for the AI era. With expertise across fixed, mobile and transport networks, powered by the innovation of Nokia Bell Labs, we’re advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.
   

  

 Learn more about life at Nokia .
   

  

**Our recruitment process**
 We act inclusively and respect the uniqueness of people. Our employment decisions are made regardless of race, color, national or ethnic origin, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. We are committed to a culture of inclusion built upon our core value of respect.
   

  

 If you’re interested in this role but don’t meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply. Unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences enrich our teams, and you may be just the right candidate for this or another opportunity.
   

  

 The length of the recruitment process may vary depending on the specific role's requirements. We strive to ensure a smooth and inclusive experience for all candidates. Discover more about the recruitment process at Nokia .

**Membership Engagement Manager**
**Location** 
 : India
   

  

**About TM Forum**
 TM Forum is an association of more than 850 member companies, which include the world’s top 10 network and communications providers and spans 180 countries. Our members tap into each other’s collective experiences and abilities to collaboratively solve complex industry\-wide challenges, deploy new services, and create technology breakthroughs to accelerate change. We help communications service providers (CSPs) and their suppliers to digitally transform and thrive in the digital era. We do this by providing an open, collaborative environment and practical support that enable CSPs and suppliers to rapidly transform their business operations, IT systems, and ecosystems to capitalise on the opportunities presented in a rapidly evolving digital world.
   

  

 You can learn more at www.tmforum.org
   

  

 Our vision is to drive the next wave of digital business growth – the digitisation of every industry by providing a common innovation platform that connects businesses, industries, and ecosystems. We do this in a highly practical and agile way through collaboration programs and communities that lead to rapid prototypes, ranging from digital business models to interconnectivity APIs that lead to real world commercial applications. Complementing our collaboration programs, the Forum provides thought\-provoking digital business research and publications, industry best practices and standards as well as training programs designed to accelerate adoption. We also deliver events and workshops that bring together leading business \& IT executives to learn, network, and develop meaningful partnerships.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Meet or exceed the revenue targets for sales of member renewals (primary focus), support the sale of TM Forum services and programmes, including training, coaching, tools, conformance, and certifications and new memberships (secondary focus) – this is primarily an account management role focusing on member retention and services sales within those members. There is some scope for new member acquisition but that is not the primary function of this role.
* Primary focus on the India market (a mix of CSP’s, Global Systems Integration firms and technology vendors), with select account responsibilities extending beyond the region (i.e. global accounts).
* Build and maintain a strong pipeline of qualified sales opportunities in line with regional targets.
* Manage member renewals and engagement across named accounts. Maintain accurate Salesforce records and reporting to support effective pipeline management and forecasting.
* Broaden and deepen relationships with existing members through effective communication, face\-to\-face meetings, calls, and targeted use of marketing collateral.
* Raise the profile of TM Forum through active participation in relevant industry conferences and events.
* Work closely with regional teams, Engagement Managers, and colleagues to share best practices, support account development, and deliver consistent member experiences.
* Support the Global Research \& Media and Events Sales Teams to unlock opportunities in existing members and beyond.
* Work closely with our Program Management, Marketing and Sales Enablement teams to ensure the voice of the members is clearly understood and reflected in our value propositions, marketing positioning, and collateral.
* Create and maintain accurate and comprehensive opportunity records, ensuring the organisation can effectively forecast revenue volume and timing.
* Develop a strong understanding of the telecommunications and technology landscape, staying abreast of industry trends and emerging challenges to become a trusted advisor to members and identify new opportunities for TM Forum.


**Experience And Requirements**
* Working experience in the telecoms industry is essential.
* Previous account management and sales experience is essential, with the ability to build trusted relationships, identify opportunities for growth, and manage a sales pipeline effectively – this is not an entry level role.
* Familiarity with the digital economy is advantageous. Experience of the Indian market and the wider telecommunications ecosystem is essential.
* Results\-oriented, highly organised and able to manage multiple priorities effectively while maintaining a strong focus on outcomes.
* A customer\-focused individual who can understand member needs and develop appropriate solutions that deliver value.
* Strong interpersonal, communication, and organisational skills, with the ability to engage confidently with stakeholders at all levels and collaborate effectively across different countries, cultures, and time zones.
* Excellent digital and analytical skills, including proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint, and the ability to work confidently with CRM, reporting and business support systems.
* Experience of structured sales processes, with working knowledge of Salesforce or similar CRM platforms and other business intelligence platforms being advantageous.
* Self\-disciplined, proactive, and able to work independently while contributing as part of a close\-knit and highly collaborative team.
* Curious, adaptable, and committed to continuous learning. This role offers the opportunity to develop deep expertise in the telecommunications industry, TM Forum's frameworks and programmes, and the challenges facing our members. The successful candidate will be willing to invest time in building this knowledge and expertise.
* Comfortable working within a small, geographically distributed regional team. Success in the role requires proactive collaboration, knowledge sharing, and a willingness to learn from experienced colleagues across different markets and areas of expertise.


**Diversity \& Inclusion at TM Forum**
*At TM Forum, we’re building a workplace where everyone can belong, feel respected, supported and able to do their best work. We welcome talent from all walks of life to join our global community, which is made stronger by the different perspectives, backgrounds and experiences each person brings. We hire based on skills, potential and values, never on assumptions about who someone is or where they come from. We actively work to ensure our recruitment and people practices are fair, inclusive and free from bias.*
 We are a global alliance of 800\+ organizations across the connectivity ecosystem. Members include the top 10 Communication Service Providers, top three hyperscalers, and a wide range of vendors, consultancies, and system integrators.
   

  

 Together, we are building a sustainable future for the sector in connectivity and beyond

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI\-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.


Join us to put AI to work for people.

 **Job Description** **The Team**


The Customer Excellence Group (CEG) is ServiceNow’s internal professional services organisation. The CEG team at ServiceNow works with customers to help them achieve their business outcomes by providing proven practice guidance and technical expertise. As part of the CEG Expert Services Delivery team, you will work with our customers to drive consumption, adoption, and customer satisfaction and ultimately help our customers grow their business on the ServiceNow platform by getting them to realise the value of their ServiceNow investment, while making ServiceNow the best buying decision they’ve ever made.

**The Role**


This Senior Technical Consultant (Core Business Workflow) role leads the design and implementation of ServiceNow solutions to accelerate customer adoption and drive business outcomes. The role partners with customers to address key challenges, design and configure best\-practice solutions, and drive delivery excellence. The ideal candidate is experienced in Core Business Workflows domains (e.g. HRSD, WSD, LSD and/or FSC) and leads both design and build across diverse stakeholders including customers, partners and junior team members.

**What you get to do in this role:**

* Manage technical delivery streams within large ServiceNow engagements, across diverse matrixed and cross\-functional teams
* Facilitate process re\-engineering and optimisation workshops and guide customers to maximise the value of ServiceNow technologies.
* Act as a domain expert in Core Business Workflows, consulting effectively and navigating strategically across specialised areas (e.g. Human Resources, Legal, and Workplace Services)
* Architect scalable, best\-practice solutions and present technical concepts effectively to varied business and technical stakeholders
* Create detailed user stories, test strategies, solution design documents and customer hand\-over deliverables
* Configure and develop automation workflows and domain specific solutions aligning to ServiceNow standards
* Ensure consistent quality through technical oversight and testing
* Support pre\-sales by leading scoping, solutioning, and estimation discussions
* Contribute innovation, best practices, and thought leadership to global CEG and product teams.
* Mentor colleagues, guide on customers, and partners on technical excellence and delivery quality

 **Qualifications** **To be successful in this role you have:**

* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision\-making, or problem\-solving. This may include using AI\-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI\-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
* Minimum 5 years of hands\-on experience in configuring and developing ServiceNow or equivalent solutions within related service domains (e.g. Human Resources, Legal, or Workplace).
* Familiar with leading ServiceNow implementations.
* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision\-making, or problem\-solving.
* Skilled at engaging both technical and business stakeholders to gather requirements and design end\-to\-end solutions
* Strong ability to simplify and present complex concepts through visual models, workflows, and wireframes
* Deep customer focus with a passion for delivering excellence
* Combines creativity with analytical thinking and effective problem\-solving
* Naturally curious, proactive, and self\-driven in adopting new technologies
* Thrives in fast\-moving environment with concurrent assignments
* Exceptional communication, collaboration, and interpersonal skills
* Demonstrated success as both a team contributor and leader
* Experienced in Agile delivery methodologies and collaborative project execution
* Technically proficient in web technologies (XML, HTML, JavaScript, Web Services, CSS, middleware, LDAP, SSO, OAUTH, etc.) and working experience with SaaS technologies
* Strong grasp of data management, database design, and related concepts
* ServiceNow Certifications (required or must achieve within the first 90 days):
* Certified System Administrator (CSA)
* Certified Application Developer (CAD)
* Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) \- \- Human Resources / Workplace Service Delivery / Legal Service Delivery
* Desired ServiceNow Certifications (required or must achieve within the first year):

b4897ff2.title: Technical Program Manager >
b4897ff2.description:
Role Overview
   

  

 Application
   

  

**Team:** 
 Core Platform
 **Reports to:** 
 Director of Engineering
   

  

**About The Company**
 At Redpin we simplify life's most important payments. Buying a new property overseas can be a stressful time, especially when it comes to moving your money. Through our Currencies Direct and TorFX brands we've been helping people do just that for over 25 years. With recent investment we're now on a mission to build a new range of digital products and services that will make moving money internationally for real estate purchases even easier.
   

  

 We're on a mission to become the solution for real estate payments everywhere. To do this, we are transitioning our business from a horizontal FX platform to a verticalized, embedded software company, as we look to the future and Redpin 2\.0\.
   

  

 As part of this mission, we're thrilled to announce we have opened a new office in Hyderabad!
   

  

**About The Role**
 You will own the delivery of Redpin's most important cross\-functional business initiatives — the programs the company is betting on — and be accountable for the outcome, not just the plan.
   

  

 Success means bringing multiple teams into alignment on scope, dependencies, and timelines, holding that alignment as things change, and driving execution through to shipped. You'll operate across Engineering, Product, Operations, and the CTO's office, turning ambiguous, high\-stakes goals into a plan teams believe in and then landing it. When a program starts slipping from green to yellow to red, you're the one who sees it first and does what it takes to turn it back
   

  

 You'll do this as a nimble, async\-first operator — not by filling calendars with status meetings.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own end\-to\-end delivery of key cross\-functional initiatives across Core Platform, from planning to ship.
* Drive quarterly planning: shape goals with leadership, decompose initiatives, map dependencies, and align teams on scope and timelines.
* Maintain an honest RAG view of program health; detect risk early, escalate the right issues to the right people, and drive the actions that turn red/yellow back to green.
* Unblock teams — broker decisions, remove dependencies, and make pragmatic calls rather than logging problems and waiting.
* Manage risk and dependencies across teams and third parties (banking partners, payment rails, critical vendors).
* Keep leadership informed through crisp written updates that drive decisions without a meeting.


**What You’ll Need**
* Proven track record delivering complex, cross\-functional technical programs in a fast moving environment.
* Strong technical fluency — enough to earn engineers' trust, reason about architecture and trade\-offs, and make pragmatic decisions.
* Excellent written communication and stakeholder management across ICs, managers, Directors, Product, Operations, and executive leadership; strong persuasion and influence without authority.
* Sharp risk and escalation instincts — you recognise "yellow turning red" early and know how to intervene.
* Comfort with ambiguity and a bias to action; async\-first working style.
* Experience with quarterly/OKR planning and dependency management at scale


**Nice to have**
* Experience in payments, fintech, FX, or banking, and comfort where compliance and delivery intersect.
* Exposure to third\-party vendors, banking partners, or platform integrations.


**How We Work**
 Async\-first and pragmatic. We default to writing, meet only when a decision needs a room, and value judgement over process. We're not looking for a TPM who runs programs by the book or blocks progress with ceremony — we're looking for the person who is the reason initiatives ship.

3a1bd62a.title: Engagement Manager, Professional Services, AWSI, Healthcare and Life Sciences
3a1bd62a.description:
**Description**
 AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector
   

  

 The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Engagement Manager to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you will lead delivery quality and velocity for programs spanning several concurrent workstreams, orchestrating 50\+ person teams of AWS builders, partners, and customers to deliver transformational AI, data, and enterprise modernization outcomes for the world's leading HCLS organizations.
   

  

 Your objective will be to deliver distinctive customer business outcomes and experience. In doing so, you will lead the implementation of AWS delivery innovations with customers, including re\-designing software development processes to become AI\-native end\-to\-end (“AI\-DLC”). You will bring exceptional stakeholder orchestration and relationship\-building skills, intrinsic problem\-solving ability to proactively shape program direction, anticipate and mitigate risks, and actively manage interdependencies, and the backbone to influence customers and partners when program success demands it. This is an opportunity to shape the future of the industry directly through hands\-on transformation leadership.
   

  

 The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using AWS services. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing and AI transformation initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Build and nurture trusted executive relationships (VP\+), delivering strategic counsel on program direction, health, risks, and trade\-offs to inform executive decisions
* Proactively manage interdependencies, mitigate risks, and drive accountability for program outcomes in ambiguous, fast\-changing environments
* Orchestrate across customer lines of business, IT, and partner teams simultaneously, aligning these stakeholders on priorities, timelines, and definitions of success, and escalating blockers where necessary for resolution
* Define and track measurable customer business outcomes (e.g., time\-to\-market acceleration) as the north star for program success, translating technical delivery progress into executive\-ready value narratives that demonstrate ROI and inform strategic decisions
* Own the program financial health, including forecasting, revenue recognition, commercial management, change request negotiation, and scope management for fixed\-price, milestone\-based delivery constructs
* Influence human builder and agent builder teams effectively, establishing clear operating models and responsible AI guardrails as delivery increasingly incorporates AI\-augmented development workflows and agentic automation
* Drive adoption of AI\-DLC (AI\-Driven Development Life Cycle) methodologies across delivery programs, adapting delivery models and team structures for accelerated scale and pace, establishing outcomes\-based governance frameworks for AI\-native builds, and steering multi\-agent systems at scale to drive delivery productivity across the program
* Establish and enforce governance frameworks for agentic AI in delivery — including observability, cost controls, human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints, and compliance guardrails — ensuring AI\-augmented workflows remain auditable, secure, and aligned with customer regulatory requirements
* Proactively surface ideas on how ProServe and other AWS teams can innovate to help our customers achieve their goals at a faster pace and larger scale


**About The Team**
 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. c5c99cb2.title: Technical Program Manager, Risk
c5c99cb2.description:
Who we are
   

  

**About Stripe**
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Stripe mission is to build the economic infrastructure for the internet. Risk and Compliance Engineering builds products to lower financial and regulatory risk at scale for Stripe, while retaining a best\-in\-class user experience. We build user\-facing products and backend platforms to ensure our users are compliant with regulatory and financial partner requirements. We protect the Stripe brand while also protecting the company from financial losses that can put the Stripe business at risk. The Risk TPM team is crucial to driving programs to address these challenges.
   

  

 What you'll do
   

  

 As a Technical Program Manager in the Risk and Compliance space, you'll play a key role across engineering, product, and strategy to drive programs that span across the Risk organization and Stripe. You'll be responsible for the successful definition, cross\-functional strategy, planning, and execution of large\-scale technical programs that help to solve complex problems and empower Stripe and our users.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Execute on technical programs that require deep systems and engineering knowledge.
* Partner with Engineering Managers, Product Managers, and other cross\-functional partners to define, scope, and drive large programs to conclusion.
* Develop, implement, and iterate on program management techniques, frameworks, and key performance indicators to achieve goals with well\-defined success criteria.
* Make substantial improvements to how the teams you work with communicate and operate to significantly increase the productivity and efficiency of the teams.
* Define and produce high\-quality written proposals, communications and documentation.
* Leverage data and acquired knowledge to drive strategic decisions at an engineering leadership level.
* Create widely circulated plans, driving consistency, clarity, and building alignment across teams.


 Who you are
   

  

 We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
   

  

**Minimum Requirements**
* 5\+ years of software engineering, systems engineering, or technical program management experience.
* You have excellent analytical skills, digest complex information, and make recommendations.
* You have a track record of providing program management during all phases of software development from kickoff to launch, demonstrating critical thinking, challenging the norms, and thought leadership.
* You have very strong written and verbal communication skills, building strong relationships with stakeholders, teams, and senior leaders around the organization.
* You drive internal and external process improvements across multiple teams and functions and bring a wealth of experience, opinions, proposals, and best practices.
* Experience operating autonomously and leading large\-scale efforts across multiple teams and functions, with stakeholders in different disciplines across time zones.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working in financial risk and compliance
* SQL and Python scripting and programming skills


 In\-office expectations
   

  

 Office\-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in\-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in\-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.
   

  

 Pay and benefits
   

  

 Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.
   

  

 We look forward to hearing from you.
   

  

 At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.
   

  

 Apply now

Job Description
**ABOUT LEADSQUARED**


LeadSquared is one of the fastest\-growing SaaS companies in the CRM space — trusted by 2,000\+ customers and 2\.5 lakh\+ users globally. We help organizations automate sales and marketing to run high\-velocity revenue operations at scale. With a strong presence across the US, Middle East, ASEAN, ANZ, and South Africa, LeadSquared is expanding its US vertical teams to drive growth in Education and Healthcare — two of our strongest market segments.

  

**ABOUT THE ROLE**


LeadSquared is expanding its US Education vertical and is looking for a senior PreSales Consultant with deep expertise in the Education sector to drive enterprise deal pursuits across Higher Education institutions, K\-12 districts, EdTech platforms, and Workforce Training organizations. You will serve as the technical and solutions authority in the sales process — owning discovery, demo design, RFP responses, and proof\-of\-concept development — while acting as a trusted advisor to prospects and a strategic partner to the US Sales team.

  

***This is not a generic SE role. We need someone who speaks Education — who understands enrollment funnels, student lifecycle management, and how institutions buy technology.***

  

  

**Solution Engineering** **Product Demonstrations** **RFP/RFI Response** **CRM** **EdTech** **Higher Education** **POC Development**

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**


**Solution Design \& Demonstrations**


* Lead tailored product demonstrations of LeadSquared’s CRM and Student Lifecycle Management platform for Higher Education, K\-12, and EdTech prospects.


* Design and deliver discovery\-led demos that address specific institutional pain points — enrollment management, student engagement, retention, and alumni relations.


* Develop and present end\-to\-end solution blueprints aligned to each prospect’s administrative, enrollment, and technology workflows.


* Build and deliver proof\-of\-concepts (POCs) for complex or competitive enterprise evaluations.


* Showcase integration capabilities with SIS platforms (Banner, Ellucian, PowerSchool), LMS tools, and other education ecosystem technologies.


**RFP Leadership \& Proposal Excellence**


* Own RFI/RFP responses for US Education prospects, including functional requirements, solution architecture, and integration approach.


* Create compelling solution documents, executive summaries, and business case narratives tailored to CIO, VP Enrollment, and Provost\-level audiences.


* Develop effort estimation, implementation roadmap, and TCO analysis for enterprise Education deployments.


* Maintain and improve a library of standard RFP responses, demo scripts, and proposal templates for the US Education team.


**Education Domain Authority**


* Serve as LeadSquared’s internal subject\-matter expert on US Education: enrollment management, student success, financial aid workflows, and alumni engagement.


* Maintain competitive intelligence across EdTech CRM platforms (Salesforce Education Cloud, Slate, Ellucian CRM, Element451\) and develop battle cards.


* Stay current on FERPA compliance, Title IV regulations, and accreditation\-related technology requirements.


* Represent LeadSquared at US Education conferences, events, and industry forums to build brand presence and generate pipeline.


**Stakeholder Engagement \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration**


* Engage VP Enrollment Management, CIOs, Registrars, Student Success Directors, and Provosts as a trusted advisor, not just a vendor.


* Partner with the US Sales team, Marketing, and Customer Success to build winning deal strategies and seamless customer handoffs.


* Provide structured feedback to Product and Engineering on US Education market requirements and competitive gaps.


* Mentor and support junior PreSales resources as the Education vertical scales.

  

**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**


**Experience \& Education**


* 5\-10 years of experience in PreSales, Solution Engineering, or Sales Consulting, with significant tenure supporting US Education accounts.


* Deep understanding of US Higher Education and/or K\-12 institutional buying processes, IT governance, and technology procurement.


* Prior hands\-on experience with EdTech CRM, SIS, or Student Lifecycle Management platforms is strongly preferred.


* Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree or prior experience working inside a US educational institution is a strong plus.


* Excellent English communication skills — written, verbal, and presentation — with proven ability to engage C\-suite and VP\-level academic leaders.


**Technical \& Domain Skills**


* Strong understanding of enrollment management, student lifecycle, financial aid, and alumni engagement workflows.


* Familiarity with US Education technology ecosystem: SIS platforms (Banner, Ellucian, PowerSchool, Infinite Campus), LMS (Canvas, Blackboard, D2L), and communication tools.


* Knowledge of FERPA, data privacy standards, and compliance requirements for US Education technology.


* Proficiency in solution architecture, integration design, and API\-based connectivity for enterprise Education environments.


* Experience with competitive platforms: Salesforce Education Cloud, Slate, Element451, Ellucian CRM, or similar.


**Good to Have**


* Experience presenting at EDUCAUSE, NACAC, or similar US Education conferences.


* Familiarity with Title IV, accreditation body requirements, and financial aid system integrations.


* Experience with data analytics and reporting for student outcome tracking.
