27fa6cc6.title: Integration Architect
27fa6cc6.description:
**Job Description**
**About TI**
 Texas Instruments Incorporated (TI) is a global semiconductor design and manufacturing company that develops analog ICs and embedded processors. By employing the world’s brightest minds, TI creates innovations that shape the future of technology. TI is helping about 100,000 customers transform the future, today. We’re committed to building a better future – from the responsible manufacturing of our semiconductors, to caring for our employees, to giving back inside our communities and developing great minds. Put your talent to work with us – change the world, love your job!
   

  

**About The Job**
 Texas Instruments (TI) is looking for a detailed and results\-oriented leader to become a part of our global Information Technology team as Integration Architect.
   

  

 Sales, Marketing \& Workforce Solutions (SMWS) is critical to the success and growth of TI as a company. Our mission in SMWS is to deliver a best\-in\-class and technically credible digital experience at all stages of the customer lifecycle, scale digital selling to the mass market, and accelerate sales and marketing through digitization and personalization.
   

  

 As an Integration Architect within the Digital Experience Solutions (DES) group, you will be technical leader, responsible for architecting end‑to‑end digital‑experience platforms within Texas Instruments’ IT Solutions organization in India. This is a
 **hands\-on architecture leadership role** 
 and will ensure architectureis
 **secure, scalable, well\-modeled, interoperable, and fit for both operational and analytical use** 
 , while enabling domain teams to deliver independently.
   

  

 The Integration Architect influences through
 **technical authority, standards, and partnership** 
 , working closely with domain engineering teams, platform teams, analytics, and security.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will bring in well\-rounded expertise around software development, including industry awareness of web technologies, frameworks, secure and scalable architecture, and back\-end services. Sharp focus on execution, organization, and efficiency is critical for this role, including decision making around strategic staffing, cost, and skills. The ability to develop and drive technical strategy and lead effectively cross\-functionally is critical.
   

  

**Responsibilities Include**
* Define Solution Architecture – Design, develop and deployment diagrams for all new digital‑experience initiatives
* Technology Strategy \& Roadmap – Evaluate emerging technologies (AI/ML services, edge, serverless)
* Standards \& Governance – Establish coding standards, security baselines, CI/CD and observability best practices
* Proof‑of‑Concept (PoC) Leadership – Lead rapid PoCs to validate architectural choices and capture performance metrics.
* Collaboration \& Stakeholder Management – Partner with product owners, UX designers, data engineers, security, and SRE teams across global TI to translate business needs into technical solutions.
* Mentorship \& Knowledge Transfer – Conduct architecture workshops, design‑review sessions, and code‑review guidance for development
* Risk \& Compliance Management – Identify architectural risks (security, performance, vendor lock‑in) and ensure designs meet internal audit requirements.
* Documentation \& Communication – Produce high‑quality architecture artifacts, runbooks, and executive‑level presentations for business partners.
* Continuous Improvement – Track key metrics (lead time, MTTR, MTTD, defect density) and drive process enhancements within the digital‑experience delivery pipeline.
* Build a positive and inclusive work environment with transparency, collaboration, and accountability
* Effectively partner with org and cross\-org leaders to strategically drive successful results
* Identify and resolve problems with urgency and proactively solve issues ahead of time
* Ensure ongoing compliance with IT Security policies and procedures and leverage data\-driven decision\-making


**Qualifications**
**Minimum requirements:**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Electrical or Electronics Engineering, Information Systems, or related field. Master’s degree preferred.
* 6 \+ years of software development, with at least 4 years in Integration/Enterprise architecture.
* Strong experience working with Web technologies (like Spring, Angular, React, NodeJS), Microservices, Kubernetes, NoSQL DB like Mongo and, authentication methods like OAuth and SAML.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, strong stakeholder‑management, proven mentorship/leadership, analytical mindset, ability to thrive in an agile environment.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Certification on public cloud platforms and/or architectural frameworks like TOGAF
* Experience in institutionalizing best practices around performance tuning, accessibility, Observability and SEO at enterprise scale.
* Technical acumen on CI/CD pipelines and blue/green deployment strategies on\-prem and/or in public cloud environment.
* Working experience with building integrated and automated solution leveraging Gen AII with RAG and/or MCP offering contextual, personalized experiences and outcomes to achieve business outcome.
* Strong track record of implementing best practices and modern technologies to deliver secure, scalable, and reliable digital solutions aligned with enterprise architecture.
* Ability to manage and prioritize a high number of concurrent tasks, while mentoring team members and partnering cross\-functionally
* Demonstrated success in building and scaling high\-performing, engaged engineering teams.
* Ability to take initiative, drive for results, and be adaptable to change
* Strong time management and prioritization skills to drive strong execution
* Ability to work effectively in an interrupt\-driven, fast\-paced and rapidly changing environment
* Demonstrated ability to build strong, influential relationships and manage multiple business partner expectations
* Proven experience influencing opinions and gaining consensus
* Possess curiosity, high energy, and helpful attitude to develop a positive team culture
* Ability to present and get buy\-in with technical and non\-technical audiences alike


**About Us**
**Why TI?**
* Engineer your future. We empower our employees to truly own their career and development. Come collaborate with some of the smartest people in the world to shape the future of electronics.
* We're different by design. Diverse backgrounds and perspectives are what push innovation forward and what make TI stronger. We value each and every voice, and look forward to hearing yours. Meet the people of TI
* Benefits that benefit you. We offer competitive pay and benefits designed to help you and your family live your best life. Your well\-being is important to us. Please find our country\-specific benefits here


**About Texas Instruments**
 Texas Instruments Incorporated (Nasdaq: TXN) is a global semiconductor company that designs, manufactures and sells analog and embedded processing chips for markets such as industrial, automotive, data center, personal electronics and communications equipment. At our core, we have a passion to create a better world by making electronics more affordable through semiconductors. This passion is alive today as each generation of innovation builds upon the last to make our technology more reliable, more affordable and lower power, making it possible for semiconductors to go into electronics everywhere. Learn more at TI.com .
   

  

 Texas Instruments is an equal opportunity employer and supports a diverse, inclusive work environment.
   

  

 If you are interested in this position, please apply to this requisition.
   

  

**About The Team**
 TI does not make recruiting or hiring decisions based on citizenship, immigration status or national origin. However, if TI determines that information access or export control restrictions based upon applicable laws and regulations would prohibit you from working in this position without first obtaining an export license, TI expressly reserves the right not to seek such a license for you and either offer you a different position that does not require an export license or decline to move forward with your employment.

 The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Engagement Manager to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you will lead delivery quality and velocity for programs spanning several concurrent workstreams, orchestrating 50\+ person teams of AWS builders, partners, and customers to deliver transformational AI, data, and enterprise modernization outcomes for the world's leading HCLS organizations.
   

  

 Your objective will be to deliver distinctive customer business outcomes and experience. In doing so, you will lead the implementation of AWS delivery innovations with customers, including re\-designing software development processes to become AI\-native end\-to\-end (“AI\-DLC”). You will bring exceptional stakeholder orchestration and relationship\-building skills, intrinsic problem\-solving ability to proactively shape program direction, anticipate and mitigate risks, and actively manage interdependencies, and the backbone to influence customers and partners when program success demands it. This is an opportunity to shape the future of the industry directly through hands\-on transformation leadership.
   

  

 The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using AWS services. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing and AI transformation initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Build and nurture trusted executive relationships (VP\+), delivering strategic counsel on program direction, health, risks, and trade\-offs to inform executive decisions
* Proactively manage interdependencies, mitigate risks, and drive accountability for program outcomes in ambiguous, fast\-changing environments
* Orchestrate across customer lines of business, IT, and partner teams simultaneously, aligning these stakeholders on priorities, timelines, and definitions of success, and escalating blockers where necessary for resolution
* Define and track measurable customer business outcomes (e.g., time\-to\-market acceleration) as the north star for program success, translating technical delivery progress into executive\-ready value narratives that demonstrate ROI and inform strategic decisions
* Own the program financial health, including forecasting, revenue recognition, commercial management, change request negotiation, and scope management for fixed\-price, milestone\-based delivery constructs
* Influence human builder and agent builder teams effectively, establishing clear operating models and responsible AI guardrails as delivery increasingly incorporates AI\-augmented development workflows and agentic automation
* Drive adoption of AI\-DLC (AI\-Driven Development Life Cycle) methodologies across delivery programs, adapting delivery models and team structures for accelerated scale and pace, establishing outcomes\-based governance frameworks for AI\-native builds, and steering multi\-agent systems at scale to drive delivery productivity across the program

**About The Team**
 Diverse Experiences

If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.

 RSM is seeking a
 **Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (CE) Functional Manager**

465361af.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
465361af.description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Senior Technical Program Manager
   

  

 Technical Program Manager Role Overview
   

  

 Who is Mastercard?
   

  

 We work to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships, and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
   

  

 Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. We cultivate a culture of inclusion for all employees that respects their individual strengths, views, and experiences. We believe our differences enable us to be a better team — one that makes better decisions, drives innovation, and delivers better business results.
   

  

 Technology at Mastercard
   

  

 What we create today will define tomorrow: revolutionary technologies that reshape the digital economy to be more connected and inclusive than ever before — safer, faster, and more sustainable.
   

  

 We need technologists who are energized by the challenges of a truly global network, with the talent and vision to create the critical systems and products that power global commerce and connect people everywhere to the vital goods and services they need every day.
   

  

 Working at Mastercard means being part of a unique culture that is inclusive, diverse, and built on collaboration. It is a place that celebrates your strengths, values your experiences, and offers the flexibility to shape a career across disciplines and continents — while working alongside experts and leaders at every level of the business to improve what exists and invent what’s next.
   

  

**All About You**
 Are you a technical program manager who wants to work for a company that offers above\-and\-beyond benefits, including paid parental leave, flexible work hours, gift matching, and volunteer incentives?
   

  

 Do you want to work in an inclusive and nurturing culture that encourages your professional learning and development?
   

  

 The ideal candidate is passionate about the customer experience journey, highly motivated, intellectually curious, analytical, and possesses an entrepreneurial mindset.
   

  

 Knowledge / Experience
   

  

* 8\+ years leading large\-scale, end\-to\-end technical programs across multiple teams with complex dependencies in enterprise environments.
* Strong expertise in portfolio\- and initiative\-level program management, including governance, execution tracking, reporting, and operational readiness.
* Hands\-on experience with Agile Scrum, SAFe, and blended delivery models, with strengths in work decomposition, sprint planning, backlog management, and delivery acceleration.
* Solid understanding of software engineering, system design, and architecture, with the ability to engage engineers on trade\-offs, scalability, and constraints.
* Proven ability to drive business and customer outcomes through technical execution, measured through metrics and results.
* Demonstrated strength in risk management, ambiguity handling, stakeholder influence, and executive communication.
* Experience building and leading TPM organizations, mentoring leaders, shaping practices, and influencing technology roadmaps.


**About The Role**
* Drive transformational change in end\-to\-end product delivery by applying technical program management and engineering best practices across agile and hybrid environments.
* Lead large enterprise technical programs and products from inception to delivery, operating autonomously in ambiguous problem spaces.
* Maintain a deep understanding of business domains, systems, and architectural decisions, translating complexity into clarity and execution.
* Provide thought leadership, drive problem decomposition, accelerate delivery, and ensure predictable outcomes under tight deadlines.
* Establish trusted partnerships with engineering, business, and executive stakeholders, influencing decisions and aligning execution.
* Build, lead, and mature a high\-performing TPM function, fostering strong delivery culture, empathy, and accountability.


 Major Accountabilities
   

  

* Own program and portfolio execution, optimizing processes, aligning teams and technologies, and ensuring efficient use of resources.
* Drive delivery from planning through production, proactively managing risks, dependencies, escalations, and blockers.
* Establish clear governance, metrics, and reporting to enable transparency, timely decisions, and continuous improvement.
* Foster cross\-team collaboration, accountability for results, and organizational learning.
* Act as the primary program representative, providing clear communication, accurate status, and stakeholder alignment.
* Stay current on technology trends, evaluate designs, and influence long\-term organizational and technical direction.


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

f4c327fe.title: Staff Technical Program Manager
f4c327fe.description:
**Location Details:** 
 Remote, India
 



  





 At GoDaddy the future of work looks different for each team. Some teams work in the office full\-time; others have a hybrid arrangement (they work remotely some days and in the office some days) and some work entirely remotely.
 



  





 This is a remote position, so you’ll be working remotely from your home. You may occasionally visit a GoDaddy office to meet with your team for events or meetings.
 



  





**Join Our Team...** 




  





 This role is for a
 
 Staff Technical Program Manager within GoDaddy’s engineering organization, focused on building scalable, fault\-tolerant systems that power critical customer and platform experiences at massive scale.
 



  





 GoDaddy is empowering everyday entrepreneurs around the world by providing all of the help and tools to succeed online. GoDaddy is the place people come to name their idea, build a professional website, attract customers, sell their products and services, and manage their work. Our mission is to give our customers the tools, insights and the people to transform their ideas and personal initiative into success!
 



  





**What you'll get to do...** 




  





 As a Staff Technical Program Manager, you will be at the forefront of our project management efforts. You will coordinate the seamless delivery of technical programs, ensuring our projects are successfully implemented and meet the highest standards. Your role is pivotal in driving our mission forward by:
 


* Leading and coordinating multiple workstreams across product engineering, legal, and enterprise customer commitments.
* Owning the program layer of cloud environment security efforts, including control rollout, remediation SLAs, and audit readiness.
* Building mechanisms for seamless execution such as product\-style intake, prioritization frameworks, and launch readiness reviews.
* Partnering closely with product management, build, and engineering leadership to ensure successful project launches and smooth deprecation of prior tooling.
* Holding your own in architecture reviews, build documents, and post\-incident debriefs, while reading and reasoning about production code in modern languages (Python, Go, Java, etc.).
* Reasoning about cloud infrastructure at the architecture level, particularly with AWS, to ensure robust security measures.
* Directly reading metrics, logs, and dashboards, querying SIEM data, and interpreting SLO burn to maintain high standards of security and performance.



  





**Your experience should include...** 




  





 To succeed in this role, you should have a proven history of outstanding performance and experience in the following areas:
 


* 10\+ years of technical program management, with at least 5 years in security, cloud, data platform, or infrastructure organizations at scale.
* Prior individual contributor (IC) engineering experience, particularly in software, security, data, or SRE, or comparable background.
* Direct ownership of programs spanning multiple engineering teams, with reporting to Director\-level or higher.
* Experience in shipping products, including GA achievements, launch readiness, and post\-launch operations.
* Proficiency in cloud security and posture management, Kubernetes runtime security, security data pipelines and SIEM, and security automation and SOAR, with deep expertise in at least three.
* Ability to read and critique system build documents, understanding latency, efficiency, cost, and failure modes for distributed systems.
* Familiarity with ML or LLM\-integrated products, including training and evaluation pipelines, and the judgment to ensure GA readiness.
* Proven history of developing lasting program frameworks and excellent written communication abilities.



  





**You might also have...** 




  




* A computer science degree or comparable background in the industry.
* Direct experience with major SIEM and SOAR platforms, cloud provider security services, or Kubernetes\-native security tooling.
* Experience running Sev 1 or Sev 2 incident coordination.
* Prior work on data protection, privacy, or DLP programs.



  





**We've got your back...** 
 We offer a range of total rewards that may include paid time off, retirement savings (e.g., 401k, pension schemes), bonus/incentive eligibility, equity grants, participation in our employee stock purchase plan, competitive health benefits, and other family\-friendly benefits including parental leave. GoDaddy’s benefits vary based on individual role and location and can be reviewed in more detail during the interview process.
 



 We also embrace our diverse culture and offer a range of Employee Resource Groups (
 
 Culture
 
 ). Have a side hustle? No problem. We love entrepreneurs! Most importantly, come as you are and make your own way.
 



  





*We encourage you to apply even if your experience or skillset doesn’t align perfectly with every requirement. We value a wide range of backgrounds and transferable skills, and we are excited to support learning and growth.* 




  





**About us...** 
 GoDaddy is empowering everyday entrepreneurs around the world by providing the help and tools to succeed online, making opportunity more inclusive for all. GoDaddy is the place people come to name their idea, build a professional website, attract customers, sell their products and services, and manage their work. Our mission is to give our customers the tools, insights, and people to transform their ideas and personal initiative into success. To learn more about the company, visit
 
 About Us
 
 .
 



  





 At GoDaddy, we know diverse teams build better products—period. Our people and culture reflect and celebrate that sense of diversity and inclusion in ideas, experiences and perspectives. But we also know that’s not enough to build true equity and belonging in our communities. That’s why we prioritize integrating diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging principles into the core of how we work every day—focusing not only on our employee experience, but also our customer experience and operations. It’s the best way to serve our mission of empowering entrepreneurs everywhere, and making opportunity more inclusive for all. To read more about these commitments, as well as our representation and pay equity data, check out our Diversity and Pay Parity annual report which can be found on our
 
 Diversity Careers page
 
 .
 



  





*GoDaddy is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. GoDaddy will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with local and federal requirements.* 
*Refer to our full* 
*EEO policy.*




  





 Our recruiting team is available to assist you in completing your application. If they could be helpful, please reach out to myrecruiter@godaddy.com.
 



**GoDaddy doesn’t accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies.** 




  





**How GoDaddy Uses AI in its Recruiting Process:** 




  





 At GoDaddy, we use assistive AI tools to help identify how an applicant’s skills and experience align with the job\-related criteria for the role. The tool does not make hiring decisions, automatically reject candidates, or evaluate personal characteristics unrelated to job qualifications, such as age, health, or other legally protected characteristics. The tool supports, but does not replace, our recruiters’ and hiring managers’ independent review and evaluation of applications. Details about the personal data we process as part of your application and your privacy rights are available in our Applicant Privacy Policy:
 
 https://www.godaddy.com/en/legal/agreements/applicant\-privacy\-notice

161d8b9f.title: Technical Program Manager IRC293020
161d8b9f.description:
**Description**
 Scope of Work
   

  

 The Technical program Manager will be responsible for a variety of innovative projects, including but not limited to:
   

  

 Initiatives focused on improving large\-scale data ingestion and processing systems.
   

  

 Projects centered on extracting, structuring, and validating information from unstructured and semi\-structured digital content.
   

  

 Programs designed to ensure high levels of data accuracy and quality for consumer\-facing web applications, particularly in the travel and e\-commerce sectors.
   

  

 Supporting the creation and maintenance of large\-scale knowledge bases that provide intuitive and visually appealing information to users.
   

  

 Overseeing quality assurance and automation initiatives to drive efficiency and reliability.
   

  

**Requirements**
 GlobalLogic is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Technical program Manager to lead a dynamic portfolio of technical projects. This individual will be responsible for overseeing a diverse set of initiatives at the forefront of data processing and web technologies. The ideal candidate will have a strong technical background, exceptional leadership skills, and a proven track record of managing complex operations in a fast\-paced environment. A key requirement for this role is excellent communication skills, as you will be the central point of contact for multiple stakeholders, including clients, engineering teams, and senior management.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Proven Experience: A minimum of 10 years of experience in a technical operations or project management role, with at least 3 years in a managerial capacity.
   

  

 Mandatory Technical Skills: Strong, hands\-on proficiency with Regular Expressions, HTML, and JavaScript is required.
   

  

 Technical Expertise: Strong understanding of web crawling, data parsing, quality assurance, and project management methodologies. Familiarity with technologies like Python and SQL is a plus.
   

  

 Leadership Skills: Demonstrated ability to lead and motivate a diverse team of technical professionals.
   

  

 Communication Skills: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills are a strict mandate. The ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences is essential.
   

  

 Analytical and Problem\-Solving Skills: A data\-driven approach to problem\-solving and a demonstrated ability to make sound decisions under pressure.
   

  

 Stakeholder Management: Proven ability to build and maintain strong relationships with clients and internal stakeholders at all levels.
   

  

 Financial Acumen: Experience with budget management, forecasting, and financial reporting.
   

  

 Job responsibilities
   

  

 Core Responsibilities
   

  

 The Technical Program Manager will be expected to:
   

  

  

* Project Leadership \& Delivery: Oversee the successful execution of all assigned projects, ensuring timely delivery and high\-quality outcomes.
* Team Management: Lead and mentor a team of technical professionals, including software engineers, analysts, and project leads, fostering a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement.
* Technical Oversight: Provide technical guidance on projects involving large\-scale data extraction, data parsing, process automation, and quality assurance.
* Stakeholder Communication: Serve as the primary point of contact for all project\-related communications, ensuring clear and consistent updates to both internal and external stakeholders.
* Process Optimization: Continuously evaluate and improve operational processes to enhance efficiency, reduce costs, and improve the overall quality of project deliverables.
* Financial Management: Manage project budgets, forecasts, and resource allocation to ensure projects are delivered within budget and financial targets are met.
* Recruitment \& Onboarding: Participate in the hiring and onboarding of new team members, ensuring that the team has the necessary skills and expertise to meet project goals.


 What we offer
   

  

**Exciting Projects:** 
 We focus on industries like High\-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
   

  

**Collaborative Environment:** 
 You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!
   

  

**Work\-Life Balance:** 
 GlobalLogic prioritizes work\-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 Our dedicated Learning \& Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
   

  

**Excellent Benefits:** 
 We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
   

  

**Fun Perks:** 
 We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!
   

  

**About GlobalLogic**
 GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward\-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

c574252b.title: Associate Specialist - Presales
c574252b.description:

The team works closely with account managers, business entities, partners, and customers to deliver innovative solutions that address complex business challenges and drive customer success.
   

  

 As a technical sales professional, you will own the technical relationship with customers and partners, helping them achieve their business outcomes through Cisco’s technology portfolio. You will collaborate across sales teams, technical experts, and stakeholders to identify opportunities, design solutions, and expand Cisco's footprint within strategic accounts.
   

  

**Your Impact**
**Role**
 As a Technical Solutions Engineer, you will play a critical role in driving customer success and business growth by aligning technology solutions with customer objectives. You will:
   

  

* Collaborate with account teams to develop and execute customer account strategies, identifying opportunities for growth, cross\-selling, and upselling.
* Serve as a trusted technical advisor to customers, partners, and internal stakeholders.
* Translate customer business requirements into technical solutions leveraging Cisco’s full portfolio.
* Design, present, and demonstrate solutions that showcase the business value and technical capabilities of Cisco technologies.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with technical and business decision\-makers across customer organizations.
* Lead customer engagements and strategic discussions with IT leaders and line\-of\-business stakeholders.
* Identify customer challenges and tailor solutions that address specific business and technical requirements.
* Drive technical aspects of the sales cycle, from opportunity qualification through solution design and deal closure.
* Manage and coordinate virtual teams of technical resources to support customer opportunities.
* Participate in demand generation, enablement programs, and customer\-facing campaigns.

* Strong understanding of enterprise technology domains including Networking, Security, Cloud, Collaboration, and AI.
* Demonstrated ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
* Experience delivering technical presentations, demonstrations, and solution workshops to customers and partners.
* Strong customer engagement, communication, and relationship management skills.
* Proven ability to collaborate across cross\-functional teams and influence stakeholders.
* Commercial awareness with a strong focus on customer success and business outcomes.

* Solution design and architecture experience across Networking, Security, Cloud, AI, Collaboration, and related technologies.
* Experience working with enterprise and strategic accounts.
* Strong competitive positioning and market analysis capabilities.
* Demonstrated success in driving revenue growth, market share expansion, and customer acquisition.
* Self\-motivated professional capable of operating effectively in a fast\-paced and highly collaborative environment.
* Experience leading virtual technical teams and mentoring peers.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and strategic planning skills.

* Increased penetration within existing accounts through cross\-selling and upselling.

* Acquisition of new customers and development of long\-term strategic relationships.

We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

2b51580f.description:

 The Solutions Engineer is a customer\-facing technical expert who bridges the gap between product, engineering, customer service, operations and sales to design, demonstrate, and implement scalable solutions. This role translates business requirements into technical architectures, leveraging APIs, configurations, workflows, and cloud platforms to deliver measurable customer value.
   

  

 You will partner across teams to accelerate revenue, enable successful implementations, and ensure customers fully realize the value of our platform.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Customer \& Pre\-Sales Engagement**
* Lead technical discovery sessions to understand customer business needs, systems, and architecture.
* Design and present tailored solutions aligned to customer use cases and outcomes.
* Deliver compelling product demos, solution walkthroughs, and executive\-level presentations.
* Support RFP/RFI responses and address technical objections throughout the sales cycle.


**Solution Architecture \& Design**
* Architect scalable, secure, and high\-performing solutions leveraging APIs, integrations, and cloud\-native services
* Design end\-to\-end workflows across SaaS platforms, enterprise systems (CRM, ERP, HRIS, etc.), and third\-party services
* Define integration patterns (REST, event\-driven, batch, middleware) and system interoperability approaches
* Create technical documentation, architecture diagrams, and implementation blueprints


**API \& Integration Development**
* Design, implement, and support API\-based integrations between internal and external systems (REST, GraphQL, webhooks)
* Ensure secure, reliable data exchange using modern authentication and authorization methods (OAuth2, JWT, API keys)
* Troubleshoot and optimize integrations for performance, scalability, and resiliency
* Support proof\-of\-concept (PoC) builds and pilot implementations


**Implementation \& Customer Success Enablement**

* Partner with Customer Success and Delivery teams to ensure seamless handoff post\-sale
* Provide best practices for system configuration, automation, and optimization
* Enable customers to adopt advanced capabilities (automation, analytics, AI\-driven features)


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**
* Act as the liaison between customers and Product/Engineering teams, influencing roadmap based on real\-world needs
* Collaborate with Product to refine APIs, integrations, and developer experience
* Support Sales teams with technical enablement and ongoing education
* Contribute to reusable assets (demo environments, integration templates, solution accelerators)


**What You Will Need To Be Successful**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience)

* Experience in SaaS, cloud platforms, or enterprise software environments
* Proven track record supporting complex technical sales cycles and implementations

* Experience with integration platforms (e.g., MuleSoft, Workato, Zapier)
* Familiarity with data formats and transformation (JSON, XML, ETL processes)


**Cloud \& Modern Architecture**
* Strong experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Knowledge of distributed systems, containerization, and serverless architectures
* Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices


**Programming \& Technical Skills**
* Proficiency in one or more languages (Python, JavaScript/Node.js, Java, C\#)
* Experience with SDKs, API documentation tools (Postman, Swagger/OpenAPI)
* Ability to debug complex system interactions and integration issues


**Data \& Automation**
* Experience integrating enterprise systems (CRM, ERP, HRIS, marketing platforms)
* Familiarity with event streaming, messaging systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ)
* Exposure to AI/ML or automation tools (increasingly valuable in modern environments)


**Business \& Soft Skills**
* Strong ability to translate technical concepts into business value and outcomes
* Consultative approach to problem\-solving and solution design
* Excellent communication and presentation skills across technical and executive audiences
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work in fast\-paced, customer\-facing environments
* Strong collaboration across Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success functions
* Accelerates deal velocity by removing technical barriers and building customer confidence
* Delivers scalable, implementable solutions that drive customer adoption and retention

29b3b1a7.title: Platform Infrastructure Architect - Core Apps
29b3b1a7.description:
Overview:
**Platform Infrastructure Architect**
=====================================

**Core Apps** **Location:** Hyderabad, India \| **Remote**

**Experience : 7 \+ years of experience in Infrastructure Engineering**

**About the Role**
------------------


The Platform Infrastructure Architect designs, standardizes, and continuously improves the core infrastructure platforms that support enterprise applications, operational services, and business\-critical environments. This role provides technical leadership for operating systems, virtual machine templates, monitoring and observability platforms, database infrastructure, and automation frameworks.


The ideal candidate has strong infrastructure engineering experience, thinks strategically about architecture, creates clear documentation, applies security best practices, and can turn operational needs into scalable, reliable, and supportable platform standards.

**Your Role Responsibilities? Here's What You'll Do.**
------------------------------------------------------

* Lead the design and improvement of automation solutions using **PowerShell, Ansible, and Python** that reduce manual work, improve consistency, and strengthen configuration control across enterprise infrastructure platforms.
* Design and maintain enterprise standards for **Linux and Windows Server** operating systems, virtual machine templates, baseline configurations, lifecycle management, and patch readiness across production, disaster recovery, and lab environments.
* Create scalable platform architecture patterns that improve reliability, security, efficiency, and consistency; support change management by ensuring infrastructure changes are documented, assessed for risk, communicated, tested, and aligned with operational standards.
* Provide technical leadership for monitoring and observability tools including **Zabbix, LogicMonitor, and PagerDuty**; improve coverage, alert quality, escalation workflows, and operational response across all platform environments.
* Work with services, security, application, and operations teams to define platform requirements, document reference architectures, and guide implementation decisions; create and maintain documentation, runbooks, architecture diagrams, build standards, and operational procedures.
* Support database infrastructure for **SQL Server and Oracle** in production and disaster recovery environments, including availability, recovery, monitoring, capacity planning, and operational standards; promote security, compliance, resilience, and cost\-conscious engineering throughout the platform lifecycle.

**Technology Tools You'll Use**
-------------------------------

**Automation \& Scripting**

* PowerShell, Ansible, Python

**Operating Systems \& Virtualization**

* Linux (RHEL, Ubuntu, CentOS), Windows Server, Virtual Machine Templates

**Monitoring \& Observability**

* Zabbix, LogicMonitor, PagerDuty

**Database Platforms**

* SQL Server, Oracle

**Cloud \& Hybrid Infrastructure**

* Hybrid Infrastructure Platforms, Cloud\-Related Services, Self\-Service Infrastructure Catalogs

**Documentation \& Governance**

* Architecture Diagrams, Runbooks, Build Standards, IT Asset Management Tools

**Role Essentials**
-------------------

* **Bachelor's degree or at least seven years of equivalent work experience**, with extensive experience serving as a Systems Architect, Infrastructure Architect, or senior infrastructure administrator with responsibility for architecture decisions and platform standards in complex production environments.
* **Proficiency in infrastructure automation and scripting** using **PowerShell, Ansible, Python**, or similar technologies, with strong practical experience in **Linux and Windows Server** — including build standards, configuration management, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management.
* **Working knowledge of monitoring and observability platforms**, preferably **Zabbix, LogicMonitor, or PagerDuty**, with demonstrated expertise in capacity planning, performance tuning, backup and recovery, and business continuity planning across enterprise environments.
* **Experience supporting infrastructure dependencies for SQL Server, Oracle**, or other enterprise database platforms in production and disaster recovery environments, along with experience with hybrid infrastructure, virtualization platforms, cloud\-related services, or self\-service infrastructure catalogs.
* Strong spoken and written communication skills with a professional and respectful approach; proven ability to create clear technical documentation, architecture standards, runbooks, and implementation guidance for both technical and non\-technical audiences, with strong collaboration and problem\-solving skills.

**What We'd Like to See**
-------------------------

* **Architecture and systems thinking** — demonstrated ability to evaluate dependencies, tradeoffs, and long\-term impacts to guide infrastructure decisions across virtualization, cloud, compute, storage, data protection, and data center services.
* **Automation mindset** — experience identifying repeatable work, selecting appropriate automation opportunities, and promoting reusable solutions across teams to drive operational consistency and efficiency at scale.
* **Continuous learning and responsible AI use** — proven commitment to keeping technical skills current and evaluating approved AI tools and emerging technologies responsibly before applying them to infrastructure work and platform decisions.
* **Security and compliance expertise** — demonstrated ability to apply risk\-based judgment when balancing security, compliance, resilience, usability, and operational requirements throughout the platform lifecycle.
* **Process and governance alignment** — experience aligning technical work with IT asset management, change management, documentation, operational readiness, and service management requirements in enterprise environments.

**About Hyland**
----------------


Hyland is the pioneer of the Content Innovation Cloud™, delivering ubiquitous enterprise intelligence to organizations with solutions that unlock actionable insights and drive automation.


© Hyland. All rights reserved.


Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, including many of the Fortune 100, Hyland's solutions create the foundation for a connected, agentic enterprise, where teams harness the power of AI to redefine how they operate and engage with those they serve. For additional information on Hyland's platform and services, please visit Hyland.com.

**\#HylandLife**
----------------


Since 1991, it has been Hyland's mission to help our employees, customers and partners exceed their potential with our industry\-leading content services platform. Our employees exude a contagious energy and are passionate about what they do – whether it's helping customers succeed, raising up their fellow Hylanders, or engaging in the communities where they live and work.


The \#HylandLife hashtag encompasses our employee\-centric culture. Our employees live our culture day in and day out by bringing their best self to work. Hyland supports them to do just that through career development resources, wellbeing programs and innovation practices. We thrive on diverse viewpoints and new ideas and believe that a positive, inclusive workplace is imperative to sustainable success.


As we've grown to a company of nearly 4,000 strong, we have the opportunity to make a significant impact on our communities. We strongly support employee initiatives and align our giving campaigns and programs to organizations that are important to them.

**Equal Opportunity Statement**
-------------------------------


Hyland is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and are committed to providing an inclusive workplace for all employees and applicants. Employment decisions are made without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable laws and regulations. Information collected during the hiring process is used solely to assess qualifications, verify identity, and comply with legal requirements.


Let me know if you'd like any further refinements!

2b1f2776.title: Data Architect
2b1f2776.description:
**Shape the Future with Us.**
At Lubrizol, we’re bringing to life the chemistry behind clean water, efficient transportation, reliable infrastructure, critical medicines, and the products people rely on every day through science, sustainability, and a culture of inclusion.

As part of our global team, you’ll be empowered to make a real impact \- on your career, your community, and the world around you.**Data Architect – Data Intelligence**  



We are seeking an experienced Data Architect to join our Data Intelligence team. This role will work in close partnership with cross functional teams to design, optimize, and govern the enterprise data ecosystem. The successful candidate will bring strong expertise in SAP and Microsoft data technologies, designing sustainable data architecture in data platforms while also supporting robust integration, scalability, and alignment with enterprise business strategies.



The Data Architect will play a key role in shaping our enterprise\-wide data strategy, ensuring data assets are well\-structured, secure, and accessible to support analytics, reporting, and innovation across the organization.



Key Responsibilities


* Design and maintain data models, data flows, and integration architectures that align with enterprise strategy and enable interoperability across systems.
* Establish and enforce data governance, quality, and security practices across structured and unstructured data assets.
* Provide data architectural leadership in designing ETL/ELT processes, data warehouses, data lakes, and analytics platforms.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand their requirements and translate them into technical solutions that align with the overall enterprise data strategy and architecture.
* Parter with platform and engineering teams to ensure data platforms support data ingestion, ETL processes, advanced analytics, reporting, AI/ML, and business intelligence initiatives.
* Stay current on emerging Microsoft, SAP, and cloud\-native data technologies and assess their potential application within the organization.
* Support the evaluation, selection, and implementation of data management and integration technologies, with a focus on Microsoft Azure data services, SQL Server, Power BI, and SAP HANA/SAP BW.
* Supports the designs and implementation of the ETL process from various sources into the organization’s data systems.
* Define and enforce data governance, quality, and security practices across structured and unstructured data assets and platforms to ensure consistency, scalability, and maintainability.
* Translates high\-level business requirements into data models and appropriate metadata, test data, and data quality standards


Qualifications


* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, or a related field.
* 12\+ years of experience in data architecture, data engineering, data modeling or enterprise architecture roles.
* Experience working in manufacturing and/or process manufacturing environments.
* Hands\-on experience with SAP data ecosystems (e.g., SAP HANA, SAP BW, SAP DataSphere, SAP Data Services, SAP integration with Microsoft platforms).
* Expertise in Microsoft data technologies (e.g., Azure Synapse, Azure Data Factory, MS Fabric, SQL Server, Power BI).
* Experience with data lakehouse architectures and modern data platforms.
* Strong knowledge of data modeling (conceptual, logical, physical) and database design.
* Strong knowledge of SAP data structures, CDS views, models and use in downstream applications, especially for analytics.
* Experience with cloud\-based data platforms (Azure and Microsoft Fabric preferred).
* Familiarity with data governance frameworks, metadata management, and master data management (MDM).
* Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to lead cross\-functional teams and influence data strategy at the enterprise level.


Preferred Skills


* Understanding of AI/ML data requirements and enabling infrastructure.
* Knowledge of data security, compliance, and privacy regulations (GDPR, HIPAA, etc.).
* TOGAF, DAMA, or similar enterprise architecture or data management certifications.


Lubrizol: Imagined for Life. Enabled by Science. ™ Delivered by You. For nearly 100 years, The Lubrizol Corporation, a Berkshire Hathaway company, has been at the forefront of innovation to enhance everyday life, advance mobility, and make the modern world work better. Our specialty chemistry solutions—from engine oils, performance coatings, and skincare to medical devices and plumbing systems —are powered by the expertise, passion, and commitment of people like you. We tackle the world’s toughest challenges with science\-based solutions, deeply understanding our customers to deliver innovative chemistry and differentiated value. Our inclusive culture, dedication to safety, and incredible global talent drive our success. Our solutions meet the evolving needs of the modern world—brought to life by science and, most importantly, delivered by you. Whether you're in the lab, on the production floor, or in the office, you'll be part of a team around the world that empowers you to think boldly, drive results, and contribute to solutions that shape a better, more sustainable future. We win because of you. Let’s build the future together.

  

  

**Job Segment:** Data Architect, SAP, Developer, Information Technology, Data Modeler, Data, Technology

8bd72828.title: Solution Architect - ITS, IT/ITES Vertical
8bd72828.description:
**Description**
 Sales, Marketing and Global Services (SMGS)
   

  

 AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector.
   

  

 AWS Solutions Architects are trusted advisors to our customers, helping them solve some of their largest business challenges by designing and advising on some of the most scalable, flexible and resilient solutions in the world.
   

  

 Working closely with internal teams at AWS, you’ll identify how our customers push the boundaries and how we can improve our services to obsess over our customers.
   

  

 Being a thought leader who creates and presents content you’ll help all of our customers scale and grow in non\-linear ways, using AWS as their building blocks.
   

  

 In this role, you will push technology boundaries and help scale some of the Emerging companies across various Verticals in India. You will have the opportunity to partner with customers early in their cloud journey and help them scale as well as customers further in their cloud journey where you can have visible and measurable impact in their growth ambitions.
   

  

 You will test traditional thinking by pushing the boundaries for your customers and AWS to dream and deliver beyond what they think is possible.
   

  

 Our customers’ needs are moving fast, so you will too. Be part of the team helping our Emergin customers find innovative and transformative ways to reinvent their business!
   

  

 \#aws\-ags\-India
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Work directly with customers to accelerate their business outcomes and recommend best\-practice cloud architectures in line with their long\-term business needs.
   

  

* Drive technical solutions discussions with your customers, diving deep into the details to solve complex technical problems and use your knowledge to craft scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures.
* Scope and own customer engagements, with attention towards clear and well\-defined objectives and success criteria.
* Work backwards from your customer's business needs to accelerate adoption of the most appropriate AWS technology
* Define and execute on the strategy by engaging highly technical teams (Solutions Architects, Technical Account Managers, AWS professional services consultants and consulting/managed services partners).
* Act as a thought leader in the wider community, playing a key role in educating, sharing best practices, presenting at events, writing white papers, blogs, and running workshops.
* Share the voice of the customer to influence the roadmap of new features and services for the AWS platform. Proactively work within the organisation to influence the evolution of the platform.
* Serve as a key technical member of the Solutions Architecture team through influencing decision makers across multiple domains to ensure customer success in building applications and services on the AWS platform which align to long\-term business goals.


 A day in the life
   

  

 Our solutions architects are experienced technologists with technical breadth and depth coupled with strong interpersonal skills. The variety of customers is huge as we work across all industries within the SMB segment, like FSI, Retail , IT\& ITeS , Media and Entertainment to name a few. On a daily basis you will work alongside people who are leading the way in designing cloud bases architecture. We are the trusted advisor to our customers, so challenge our customers to think differently, learn more build elegant, transformative solutions!
   

  

 As a Solutions Architect you’ll own the overall technical relationship between customers and AWS and make recommendations on security, cost, performance, reliability and operational efficiency. They work to understand the customer's business needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with technology. To do this they collaborate with other teams such as account management, professional services, support, product teams and the AWS partner ecosystem.
   

  

 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree
* Knowledge of cloud architecture
* 3\+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* 7\+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience
* 7\+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data \& analytics) experience


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking experience
* Experience working with end user or developer communities
* 3\+ years of relevant field experience


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
   

  

  

**Company** 
 \- AWS India \- Maharashtra

66749e5b.description:
**Description**
 AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector.
   

  

 Are you an experienced Cloud architect/developer who can assist our customers in Application modernization, Design and development of cloud native applications and/or re\-engineering applications that can fully leverage the AWS Cloud? Do you like to work on a variety of game changing projects, at the forefront of application development and cloud technology adoption? This role is open for Delhi/NCR.
   

  

 As an architect you would champion applications to be cloud optimized by making them well\-architected ,enabling them to reap the benefits of elasticity, horizontal scalability, automation and high availability. You should have a knack of GenAI tooling to driving application modernization at scale with GenAI tools.
   

  

 On the AWS platform services such as Amazon EC2, Auto Scaling, Elastic Load Balancing, AWS Elastic Beanstalk, Amazon Elastic Container Services to name just a few, provide opportunities to design and build cloud ready applications.
   

  

 AWS ProServe India LLP is looking for highly talented hands on technical architects to help accelerate our growing Professional Services business in India. 039194ad.title: Membership Engagement Manager - India
039194ad.description:
**Membership Engagement Manager**  

**Location**: India

**About TM Forum**


TM Forum is an association of more than 850 member companies, which include the world’s top 10 network and communications providers and spans 180 countries. Our members tap into each other’s collective experiences and abilities to collaboratively solve complex industry\-wide challenges, deploy new services, and create technology breakthroughs to accelerate change. We help communications service providers (CSPs) and their suppliers to digitally transform and thrive in the digital era. We do this by providing an open, collaborative environment and practical support that enable CSPs and suppliers to rapidly transform their business operations, IT systems, and ecosystems to capitalise on the opportunities presented in a rapidly evolving digital world.


You can learn more at www.tmforum.org


Our vision is to drive the next wave of digital business growth – the digitisation of every industry by providing a common innovation platform that connects businesses, industries, and ecosystems. We do this in a highly practical and agile way through collaboration programs and communities that lead to rapid prototypes, ranging from digital business models to interconnectivity APIs that lead to real world commercial applications. Complementing our collaboration programs, the Forum provides thought\-provoking digital business research and publications, industry best practices and standards as well as training programs designed to accelerate adoption. We also deliver events and workshops that bring together leading business \& IT executives to learn, network, and develop meaningful partnerships.

**Responsibilities:**

* Meet or exceed the revenue targets for sales of member renewals (primary focus), support the sale of TM Forum services and programmes, including training, coaching, tools, conformance, and certifications and new memberships (secondary focus) – this is primarily an account management role focusing on member retention and services sales within those members. There is some scope for new member acquisition but that is not the primary function of this role.
* Primary focus on the India market (a mix of CSP’s, Global Systems Integration firms and technology vendors), with select account responsibilities extending beyond the region (i.e. global accounts).
* Build and maintain a strong pipeline of qualified sales opportunities in line with regional targets.
* Manage member renewals and engagement across named accounts. Maintain accurate Salesforce records and reporting to support effective pipeline management and forecasting.
* Broaden and deepen relationships with existing members through effective communication, face\-to\-face meetings, calls, and targeted use of marketing collateral.
* Raise the profile of TM Forum through active participation in relevant industry conferences and events.
* Work closely with regional teams, Engagement Managers, and colleagues to share best practices, support account development, and deliver consistent member experiences.
* Support the Global Research \& Media and Events Sales Teams to unlock opportunities in existing members and beyond.
* Work closely with our Program Management, Marketing and Sales Enablement teams to ensure the voice of the members is clearly understood and reflected in our value propositions, marketing positioning, and collateral.
* Create and maintain accurate and comprehensive opportunity records, ensuring the organisation can effectively forecast revenue volume and timing.
* Develop a strong understanding of the telecommunications and technology landscape, staying abreast of industry trends and emerging challenges to become a trusted advisor to members and identify new opportunities for TM Forum.
**Experience and Requirements:**

* Working experience in the telecoms industry is essential.
* Previous account management and sales experience is essential, with the ability to build trusted relationships, identify opportunities for growth, and manage a sales pipeline effectively – this is not an entry level role.
* Familiarity with the digital economy is advantageous. Experience of the Indian market and the wider telecommunications ecosystem is essential.
* Results\-oriented, highly organised and able to manage multiple priorities effectively while maintaining a strong focus on outcomes.
* A customer\-focused individual who can understand member needs and develop appropriate solutions that deliver value.
* Strong interpersonal, communication, and organisational skills, with the ability to engage confidently with stakeholders at all levels and collaborate effectively across different countries, cultures, and time zones.
* Excellent digital and analytical skills, including proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint, and the ability to work confidently with CRM, reporting and business support systems.
* Experience of structured sales processes, with working knowledge of Salesforce or similar CRM platforms and other business intelligence platforms being advantageous.
* Self\-disciplined, proactive, and able to work independently while contributing as part of a close\-knit and highly collaborative team.
* Curious, adaptable, and committed to continuous learning. This role offers the opportunity to develop deep expertise in the telecommunications industry, TM Forum's frameworks and programmes, and the challenges facing our members. The successful candidate will be willing to invest time in building this knowledge and expertise.
* Comfortable working within a small, geographically distributed regional team. Success in the role requires proactive collaboration, knowledge sharing, and a willingness to learn from experienced colleagues across different markets and areas of expertise.
**Diversity \& Inclusion at TM Forum**

*At TM Forum, we’re building a workplace where everyone can belong, feel respected, supported and able to do their best work. We welcome talent from all walks of life to join our global community, which is made stronger by the different perspectives, backgrounds and experiences each person brings. We hire based on skills, potential and values, never on assumptions about who someone is or where they come from. We actively work to ensure our recruitment and people practices are fair, inclusive and free from bias.*

**Description**
 Sales, Marketing and Global Services (SMGS)
   

  

 AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector.
   

  

 As a Customer Solution Manager you will work with the largest and most complex enterprises in the world, to enable their multi\-year journey to the cloud. In this new, highly visible, role you will ensure that all AWS teams work together effectively and efficiently to deliver migration, modernization and GenAI outcomes for the customer in relation to Amazon Web Services (AWS) Cloud.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 You will be a trusted advisor to the customer. You will leverage your complex program management, technical, organizational, and transformation expertise to understand customer's business and strategic goals, translate them into an executable plan, and drive the implementation to success by working with the customer, AWS, and our partners. You will understand your customers' biggest IT challenges and provide prescriptive guidance, based on AWS best practices, to guide them through their migration and modernization journey to AWS at scale.
   

  

 You will take end\-to\-end ownership of multiple migration, modernization and GenAI projects within a single enterprise or across several enterprises, utilizing your communication skills to interface with and influence a broad range of multi\-disciplinary teams (Business development, solutions architecture, support, product, professional services, and partners). The Customer Solution Manager role is responsible for cloud migration and modernization programs (incl. technical, operational, organizational, and education) that span across traditional IT teams and business units.
   

  

 Engaging from the inception stage onwards, you will have a deep understanding of your customer's business vision, culture, and processes, you will be your customer's voice within AWS, ensuring that their needs are accurately communicated to AWS leadership, product, and engineering teams. Engaging during the latter stages of the business cycle you will be responsible for ensuring consistent best\-practices are applied, including: (1\) ensuring Migration Readiness Assessment (MRA) is conducted and bringing in SMEs to deliver the migration foundations (e.g. landing zone build, security controls, operating model, training etc.), (2\) Migration kick off workshops are conducted (including stakeholder alignment), and (3\) Executive Steering Committees and reporting are established, including customer, partner, and AWS Cloud exec sponsors and ensure mechanisms are in place to identify and mitigate any identified risks. You should be passionate about delivering a great customer experience by delivering successful IT transformation programs. You will ensure that the customer IT and business stakeholders are aligned, to ensure broad adoption of the migration and modernization across the customer organization. You will use AWS mechanisms to inform the customer migration journey. Where required, you will lead the interaction with specialist teams, ProServ and Partners for handoffs, especially with respect to migreation, modernization and GenAI implementation.
   

  

 In addition to your customer facing responsibilities, you will help shape the rapidly growing Customer Solution Management function, where your passion to define and implement standard processes, methodologies, and tools will be highly valued. Passionate about customer value creation, you will be adept at measuring and quantifying customer value realization and ensuring it stays on path. Successful candidates will have a technical program management background, technology foundation and consultative mindset, be detail driven, and have experience in managing teams to deliver complex programs. You will be a passionate and proven leader with the ability to gain stakeholder buy\-in, communicate confidently at both the executive and project team level, and collaborate with a wide range of technical and non\-technical teams, regardless of geographical or organizational boundaries to ensure compliance with AWS Standards, policies and best practices. You will be comfortable in working with diverse teams to ensure appropriate partners are on\-boarded and involved in the migration as required. Be an active participant of steering committees and governance structures regardless of who is leading the migration and modernization and act as the point of contact for escalations if the migration and modernization hits barriers. You will be proactive in assessing Migration and modernization progress and design and implement plans to mitigate any risks or delays. Along with project management cadence, you will support the people and process pillars of migration including CCOE design and be the overall owner of reporting and system updates related to the health of migration. You will be a natural problem solver with a cool head that can deal with ambiguity, work autonomously to drive the deliver results for your customer, build IP, and share best practice across geographies.

 Network \& Security Fundamentals
